entries.zh: 我们推荐§S$GRAND_ARCHIVE_TITLE$§!，因为你所选的部分选项与其主题相符。
entries.en: We're recommending §S$GRAND_ARCHIVE_TITLE$§! as some of the choices you've selected suit its content.

entries.zh: 这座轨道结构专门用来收容和展示我们在星系中收集到的，包括活体§Y太空兽群§!在内的各种值得一提的['concept_specimen', 样本]。
entries.en: A dedicated orbital structure designed to house and display noteworthy ['concept_specimen', Specimens] we have collected throughout the galaxy, including live §YSpace Fauna§!.

entries.zh: §Y$grand_archive$§!用于保存和展览我们在星系各处收集来的最有价值的文物。其中也预留了一个专门的生态园，用于饲养和观察活体§Y太空兽群§!。
entries.en: The §Y$grand_archive$§! preserves and exhibits the most valuable artifacts we have collected throughout the galaxy. Reserved within is also a dedicated vivarium for live §YSpace Fauna§! containment and observation.

entries.zh: 需要一颗拥有至少§Y2500§!£pop£§H人口§!的天体。
entries.en: Requires a stellar body with at least §Y2500§! £pop£ §HPops§!.

entries.zh: 可以非致命地捕获并转运§Y太空兽群§!。建成§Y$grand_archive$§!之后，该装置会将所有捕获的生物储存到生态园中。
entries.en: Allows for the non-lethal capture and transport of §YSpace Fauna§!. If a §Y$grand_archive$§! is constructed, this device will deposit any captured creatures to the Vivarium.

entries.zh: 重力陷阱捕获§Y太空兽群§!数量翻倍
entries.en: Gravity Snares capture double the amount of §YSpace Fauna§!
§R$TRIGGER_FAIL$ Gravity Snares are on cooldown for §Y[This.GetGravitySnareCooldownForFleet] days§!.§!

entries.en: §R$TRIGGER_FAIL$ We have not gathered enough information on these Space Fauna to capture them.§!

entries.zh: §R$TRIGGER_FAIL$我们尚无能力捕获该类型太空兽群。§!
entries.en: §R$TRIGGER_FAIL$ We are not capable of capturing this type of Space Fauna.§!

entries.zh: 我们用一个§Y$gravity_snare$§!可以一次性捕捉最多$VALUE|0G$只§Y太空兽群§!。
entries.en: With a single §Y$gravity_snare$§!, we can capture up to $VALUE|0G$ §YSpace Fauna§! at once.

entries.zh: 我们用一个§Y$gravity_snare$§!可以一次性捕捉一整队§Y太空兽群§!。
entries.en: With a single §Y$gravity_snare$§!, we can capture an entire fleet of §YSpace Fauna§!.

entries.zh: 重力陷阱能维持局部量子引力的爆发，从而阻止所有不具备超光速推进能力的物体逃脱。这种力可以长时间维持并用来捕获§Y太空兽群§!，将其送回我们的恒星系进行进一步分析。
entries.en: Gravity Snares are capable of sustaining localized bursts of quantum gravity, preventing any known object lacking a hyperdrive from escaping. These forces can be maintained long enough to capture and return §YSpace Fauna§! to our systems for further analysis.

entries.zh: 重力陷阱的设计无法执行紧急超光速跃迁。
entries.en: Gravity Snares are not designed to perform an emergency FTL jump.

entries.zh: 随着最近§Y$tech_gravity_wells$§!的发现，现在[root.GetAdjective]科研船可以发射$gravity_snare_plural$。
entries.en: Following the recent discovery of §Y$tech_gravity_wells$§!, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch $gravity_snare_plural$.

entries.zh: 这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获并将太空兽群转运到我们的§Y生态园§!里，让它们得以继续繁衍生息。\n\n屠宰分解这些生物可以用来收获其§Y$genetic_material$§!以进行克隆以及获得其他资源。
entries.en: These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna to our §YVivarium§!, where they can continue to reproduce new specimens of their kind.\n\nCulling and dissecting these creatures will allow the harvesting of their §Y$genetic_material$§! for cloning purposes as well as other resources.

entries.zh: 这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获以及转运太空兽群用于研究及解剖，从而收获其§Y$genetic_material$§!和其他资源。\n\n如果我们打算豢养并进一步繁育这些生物，我们需要建立一座§Y生态园§!。可以通过建造一座§Y$grand_archive$§!或是在恒星基地上建造建筑§Y[GetHatcheryPlural]§!来实现。
entries.en: These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna for study and dissection, harvesting their §Y$genetic_material$§! and resources.\n\nIf we are to keep them alive for further breeding, we will need to establish a §YVivarium§!. We can do this by constructing a §Y$grand_archive$§! or by building §Y[GetHatcheryPlural]§! at our starbases.

entries.zh:
我们的§Y$gravity_snare_plural$§!无法准确地追踪收容§Y$NAME_Prethoryn_Scourge$§!。基于其运动模式，我们怀疑这些物种应该是被某种更高级的意识所控制着，不具备真正意义上的独立个体。

尝试将一只该生物收容进生态园会威胁到其他物种甚至整个[this.GetName]。

我们已无限期地暂停了对这些生物的捕获行动。
entries.en:
Our §Y$gravity_snare_plural$§! are unable to properly track and contain the §Y$NAME_Prethoryn_Scourge$§!. Based on their movement patterns, we suspect these beings are being controlled by some form of higher consciousness and are not truly individual entities.

Attempting to contain one of these organisms within a Vivarium would endanger our other specimens and even [this.GetName] as a whole.

We have suspended capture operations for these organisms indefinitely.

entries.zh: 当修缮星系历史，以古鉴今。建造一座最宏伟的档案馆恰如其分。
entries.en: The history of our galaxy warrants proper preservation in order to learn from those who came before us. An archive on the grandest scale would fit such a purpose.

entries.zh: 定域化的高浓度的量子质量可以用于制造瞬间的重力爆发。只要操作得当，这种引力理论上可以捕获并控制任何大小的生物而不造成伤害。
entries.en: Localized concentrations of quantum mass can be used to create short bursts of extreme gravity. If manipulated correctly, such a gravitational force could theoretically capture and contain a creature of any size without harm.

entries.zh: 重力陷阱捕获§Y太空兽群§!数量翻倍。
entries.en: Gravity Snares capture double the amount of §YSpace Fauna§!.

entries.zh: 岩居兽的外壳并不只是矿物而已，其中还有生物纤维补强。我们可以使用先进冶金技术来人为合成这种流程。
entries.en: The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. We can synthesize this process using advanced metallurgic techniques.

entries.zh: 重力陷阱捕获的§Y太空兽群§!数量增加§G1§!
entries.en: Increases the amount of §YSpace Fauna§! captured by Gravity Snares by §G1§!

entries.zh: §H重力陷阱容量之道§!\n§E这项科技将进一步推进重力陷阱捕获能力的发展。§!
entries.en: §HGravity Snare Capacity Path§!\n§EThis technology will lead to further advancements in Gravity Snares capture capacity.§!

entries.zh: 在精心控制的环境中，我们可以将从屠宰的太空兽群身上收集的$genetic_material$进行孵育，并产出这些物种的新成员纳入我们的麾下。
entries.en: In a carefully controlled environment, we can incubate the $genetic_material$ collected from culled Space Fauna and produce new members of each species under our command.

entries.zh: §H解锁功能：§!护卫舰尺寸太空兽群克隆
我们可以改进建立在孵化场的人工繁育流程，加速早期发育阶段，以创造更成熟的克隆体。
entries.en: We can improve the artificial growth processes established in our hatcheries, accelerating the early developmental stages in order to create more mature clones.

entries.zh: §H解锁功能：§!驱逐舰尺寸太空兽群克隆
孵化场现在可以克隆更大的§Y太空兽群§!样本，其尺寸可匹敌传统的驱逐舰。
entries.en: Hatcheries can now clone larger specimens of §YSpace Fauna§!, rivalling the size of more traditional Destroyers.

entries.zh: 在孵化场中对代谢气体进行改进可以在各种物种降生之前进行进一步的催熟。
entries.en: Improvements to the metabolic gases within our hatcheries will further mature each specimen before it is brought into this world.

entries.zh: §H解锁功能：§!战列舰尺寸太空兽群克隆
孵化场现在可以克隆所有发育阶段或尺寸的太空兽群舰船。
entries.en: Hatcheries can now clone Space Fauna Ships of any maturity stage or size.

entries.zh: 有很小的机会窃取一艘敌舰或俘虏一名指挥官以索要赎金。
entries.en: Gives a small chance to steal an enemy ship or capture an enemy Commander for ransom.

entries.zh: 用改装的小口径火炮发射连着弹性碳纤维缆索的刺钩，非常适合用于固定敌舰并进行跳帮作战。
entries.en: Repurposed small-caliber artillery that fire piercing hooks attached to resilient carbon fiber cables, perfect for immobilizing and boarding enemy ships.

entries.zh: 我们可以通过基因组修改来提升太空兽群舰船的效率，也让我们可以将人造科技整合进其生物质中。
entries.en: We can increase the effectiveness of our Space Fauna Ships by modifying their genomes, allowing us to integrate artificial technology into their biomass.

entries.zh: 我们可以更进一步。对太空兽群基因的先进操纵以整合更多样的特化部件。
entries.en: We can go further. Advanced manipulation of Space Fauna genetics allows for integrating a wider variety of specialized components.

entries.zh: 优化克隆太空兽群的流程可以大幅度提高效率。
entries.en: Optimizing the process for cloning Space Fauna can lead to massive efficiency gains.

新生成的晶体无法分裂，并且在战斗结束后湮灭。
entries.en: Newly formed crystals cannot split, and perish at the end of combat.

entries.zh: 草叶婆娑，夜静如尖啸。猎户之志，冷锐如星光。\n\n这个文明与荒野有着原始的联系。他们把自己看作是当地各种致命野生动物的管家，现在又把目光投向了苍穹。他们善于管理和牧养动物，这种与动物群的联系是根据他们的思潮发展起来的。而这种联系将如何在星系尺度上演变还有待观察。
entries.en: The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...\n\nThis civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to their world, they now turn their gaze skyward. Masters of animal handling and ranching, this relationship with fauna has developed according to their ethics. How this bond will evolve on a galactic scale remains to be seen.

entries.zh:
尽管技术进步迅速，但我们仍然与我们星球上的种种野生动物紧紧地联系在一起。在进化的过程中，它们亦师亦友，而我们则是尽责的管家。我们不会过度贪婪过度求取，它们的牺牲受到了我们的尊敬。

在浩瀚无垠的太空中，我们很可能会发现其他野生动物。若是如此，我们就会像对待自己星球的动物一样尊重它们。它们应该会像我们一样认清自己的位置，如此便能共同成就强大。

一种原始的欲望在我们内心燃烧。不管天上有什么，我们都会坚定地面对。
entries.en:
Despite rapid technological progress, we remain bound to the wild creatures of our world. Unwavering companions throughout our evolution, they are as much our teachers as we are their stewards. We do not take from them more than they can afford to give, and their sacrifices are venerated.

In the untamed expanse of space, we may well discover other wild things. If so, we will treat them with the same respect as the creatures of our world. They will learn their place as we learn ours, so that together we may grow stronger.

Called to the stars, a primal desire burns within us. Whatever is out there, we will meet it with conviction.

entries.zh:
我们与生活的世界同行。在我们这艘方舟舰的巨大舱室内，那些塑造了我们进化历程的生物依然存在；它们是良师益友，见证着我们的如今和过往。我们不会过度索取，而是尊重着它们的奉献。

在浩瀚无垠的宇宙中，我们很可能会发现其他奇异的生命体。倘若如此，我们将像对待我们船上的生物那样，以同样的尊重去对待。它们也会像我们一样确立自己的位置，从而让我们共同变得更加强大。

我们被召唤向星海，原始的渴望在心中燃烧。无论将有何种遭遇，我们都会带着坚定的信念去面对。
entries.en:
We carry our world with us. Within the great holds of our arkship, the creatures that shaped our evolution persist; companions, teachers, living reminders of what we are and where we came from. We do not take from them more than they can afford to give, and their sacrifices are venerated.

In the untamed expanse of space, we may well discover other wild things. If so, we will treat them with the same respect as the creatures that share our vessel. They will learn their place as we learn ours, so that together we may grow stronger.

Called to the stars, a primal desire burns within us. Whatever is out there, we will meet it with conviction.

entries.zh: 历经磨难，饱经世事，这位指挥官对太空兽群有着非凡的理解。成功的狩猎关键在于知己知彼，当然，只有完美的射击才能获得完美的战利品。
entries.en: Tempered by hardship and armed with a lifetime of experience, this commander has an uncanny understanding of Space Fauna. The key to a successful hunt is to think like one's prey, but of course, only the perfect shot will produce a perfect trophy.

entries.zh: 这名熟练的研究人员在安全捕获和运输活体标本时非常小心。这位领袖对生物福利的承诺激励着其他人不断提高各个学科的学术标准。
entries.en: A skilled researcher who takes the utmost care in the safe capture and transportation of live specimens. This leader's commitment to creature welfare inspires others to improve research standards across all disciplines.

entries.zh: 一位经验丰富的猎手，擅长猎杀大型猎物。他们耐心接近，出手精准。
entries.en: A knowledgeable hunter, well-suited for taking down big game. Patient in their approach, and precise when they strike.

entries.zh: 这位领袖在高效安全地捕捉太空兽群方面有着无与伦比的天赋。
entries.en: This leader's talent for capturing wild Space Fauna efficiently and safely is unparalleled.

entries.zh: 值得注意的是，每个§H缇扬奇§!群体都以母系等级制度为中心，由一头雌兽领导。雌性优先享用所有食物资源，以便为幼崽生产气态母体物质，并引导群体迁徙。因此，雄兽在资源匮乏时会放弃进食，鼓励它们在群体休息时寻找更多食物。
entries.en: Of note, there is a matriarchal hierarchy at the center of each §HTiyanki§! pod, with a singular cow leading the group at any one time. Females are given priority to all food resources, allowing them to produce maternal gases for their young and direct the pod's migrations. As such, bulls will forgo nourishment whenever resources are scarce, encouraging them to scout for more food while the pod rests.

entries.zh: 除了最年轻的个体外，其他所有个体都伴随有通过RNA掺杂分泌物控制的准独立生物体。这些“鞭毛”以复杂的攻击模式进行攻击，因此尽管它们看似缺乏智慧，但§H“太空变形虫”§!却是非常熟练的自然捕食者。
entries.en: All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms controlled via RNA-laced secretions. These "flagella" strike in complex attack patterns, so despite their apparent lack of sapience, §H"Space Amoeba"§! are highly adept natural predators.

entries.zh: 这些生物似乎通过折射光线的色度变化来相互交流。虽然这种媒介具有表达复杂信息的巨大潜力，但这些半智慧生命体只以基本的方式使用它。颜色的变化可以用来表示社会地位、攻击性，甚至生育状况。
entries.en: These creatures seem to communicate with one another via chromatic changes in refracted light. While this medium has high potential for complex expressions, it is only utilized in a basic manner by these semi-sentient lifeforms. Changes in color can be used to indicate social status, aggression, and even fertility conditions.

entries.zh: 这些寄生生物天生无法繁殖，必须依赖从星球上的宿主获取养分。为了让§H“虚空虫”§!产生三头虫成长必不可少的激素，它们必须从有人居住的星球上获取足够的有机物质。作为雌雄同体的生物，它们选择伴侣主要取决于互补的物理特征和相似的体型。
entries.en: These parasitic creatures lack the natural ability to reproduce and must rely on the acquisition of planet-borne hosts. Sufficient organic matter must be harvested from inhabited planets for the §H"Voidworms"§! to produce a crucial hormone within their mating trios, known as "troikas". As hermaphroditic creatures, the selection of partners is determined primarily by complementary physical traits and comparable size.

entries.zh: 我们认为这些生物会根据大小和矿物成分来选择用哪颗小星星来作为巢穴。虽然我们遇到的第一个样本对[GetCommonMineral]具有生物学偏好，但每个个体很可能随着时间的推移根据其当前环境发展出不同的适应性。扫描显示这种金属的痕迹遍布宿主小行星，以及§H“岩居兽”§!本身的神经系统和消化道。
entries.en: We believe that the creatures select their asteroids based on mineral composition as well as size. While the first specimen we encountered possesses a biological preference for [GetCommonMineral], it is likely each individual develops this adaptation over time based on their current environment. Scans show that traces of this metal are present throughout the host asteroid, as well as within the nervous system and digestive tract of the §H"Cutholoid"§! Itself.

entries.zh:
宇宙中充满了生命。我们已经发现了[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]的存在，但那里还有其他什么？

我们与[capital_scope.GetName]上的野生动物的密切关系可能不适合星系尺度。辽阔的太空代表着一个全新的生态系统，我们发现自己站在十字路口。

这些生物对我们来说是什么？

无论我们做出什么选择，其后果都将在未来几年内显现。
entries.en:
The void is full of life. We have discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], but what else is out there?

Our close relationship with the wildlife on [capital_scope.GetName] may not be appropriate on the galactic scale. The void of space represents an entirely new ecosystem, and we find ourselves at a crossroads.

What are these creatures to us?

Whatever choice we make, the consequences will be felt for years to come.

entries.zh: 宇宙中可能充满了生命——我们有权消灭它们，或利用它们。我们已经发现了[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]的存在，并渴望找到更多。新鲜的猎物或役畜，选择权在我们手中。
entries.en: The void may well be full of life - ours to extinguish, or to use. Having discovered the existence of [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we are eager to find more. Fresh prey or beasts of burden, the choice is up to us.

entries.zh: 一片广袤的保护区，野生动物在这里茁壮成长，可持续地供养着当地生物。
entries.en: Vast expanses of protected territory where wildlife is left to thrive, providing a sustainable supply of native creatures.

entries.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]的殖民地学会了如何尊重当地§Y泰坦巨兽§!自然领地的边界。\n\n随着我们的边界扩张和土地开发，这些巨大野兽将继续为我们的殖民地带来好处。
entries.en: Our colony on [Root.GetName] has learned to respect the boundaries of the native §YTitanic Life§!'s natural territory.\n\nThese massive beasts will be a continued benefit to our settlement as we expand borders and develop the land.

entries.zh: 对当地动物进行妥善保护、研究和管理对我们星球的福祉至关重要。
entries.en: The proper preservation, study, and management of local fauna is vital to the success of our worlds.

entries.zh: 管理我们建立的陆生动物牧场既要辛勤劳作，同时也要对其生物需求进行深入了解。
entries.en: The management of our established terrestrial fauna ranches requires hard work and intimate knowledge of their biological needs.
If it bleeds, we can kill it.

entries.zh: 为了所有物种的利益，管理生态系统时最好只使用最低限度的直接干预。
entries.en: The best ecosystems are managed with minimal direct intervention for the benefit of all species.

entries.zh: 最伟大的斗兽士可以吸引成百上千的观众。对大众而言没有比这更棒的娱乐来源了。
entries.en: The greatest of the beastfighters attract hundreds of thousands in attendance. There is no greater source of entertainment for the masses.

猎杀太空兽群的成功额外收获了$energy_icon$$energy|Y$$minerals_icon$$minerals|Y$$food_icon$$food|Y$$unity_icon$$unity|Y$$exotic_gases_icon$$exotic_gases|Y$$rare_crystals_icon$$rare_crystals|Y$
entries.en: Successfully hunting down space fauna has earned $energy_icon$$energy|Y$$minerals_icon$$minerals|Y$$food_icon$$food|Y$$unity_icon$$unity|Y$$exotic_gases_icon$$exotic_gases|Y$$rare_crystals_icon$$rare_crystals|Y$ as an additional reward.

entries.zh: 虚空诱饵向太空深处发送信号，吸引着深居虚空的生物。
entries.en: Voidlures transmit signals into deep space that are capable of attracting organisms that take shelter in the void.

entries.zh: 虚空诱饵能够向深空发送特定信号，随时间推移吸引相应种类的太空兽群。每个装置都需要建造在目标生物偏好的恒星系中。受引诱的生物将在一年内保持温顺状态。
entries.en: Voidlures transmit signals into deep space that are capable of attracting specific types of Space Fauna over time. Each installation must be built in the preferred system type of the creature. Lured creatures will be rendered temporarily docile for one year.

entries.zh: 我们的一个虚空诱饵吸引到了太空兽群。
entries.en: Space Fauna have been attracted to one of our Voidlures.

entries.zh: 搭载在方舟舰上的多种虚空诱饵发射器组合。通过锁定与太空兽群的栖息地偏好相符的恒星系，可将它们诱骗至该恒星系。
entries.en: A consolidated array of voidlure emitters mounted on the Arkship. By targeting systems that match the habitat preference of Space Fauna, they can be lured to the system.

entries.zh: $SYSTEM_EFFECTS_HEADER$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—将§H太空兽群§!引诱到一个恒星系。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—我们只能引诱已经遭遇过的生物。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—只能锁定有效的['concept_space_fauna_home_systems']。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—受到引诱的生物变为§H暂时温顺§!。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—受到引诱的生物会在引诱完成的§H30-90天§!后抵达。$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—所有诱饵共用§H冷却时间§!。
entries.en: $SYSTEM_EFFECTS_HEADER$ $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Lures §HSpace Fauna§! to a System. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- We can only Lure creatures we have encountered. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Only valid ['concept_space_fauna_home_systems'] can be targeted. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Lured creatures are rendered §Htemporarily docile§!. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Lured creatures arrive §H30-90 days§! after the lure completes. $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- All lures share a single §HCooldown§!.

entries.zh: §G星系地图：右键点击选中一个有效的恒星系。§!
entries.en: §GGalaxy Map: Right-Click to target a valid System.§!

entries.zh: §L这座阵列向着虚空歌唱，栖居其中的生灵被它的召唤所吸引。§!
entries.en: §LThe array sings into the void, and the creatures that dwell there are drawn to its call.§!

entries.zh: 虚空诱饵阵列正在§Y重新装填§!
目标恒星系必须是该类太空兽群的§Y家园§!
entries.en: The target system must be §Yhome§! to this type of Space Fauna

entries.zh: 太空兽群只能被引诱到与其偏好栖息地相符合的恒星系：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$tiyanki$：§H气态巨行星§!恒星系$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$space_amoeba_plural$：§H星云§!恒星系$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$crystalline_entity_plural$：§H脉冲星§!系$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$voidworms_plural$：§H黑洞§!星系$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—$cutholoids_plural$：§H小行星§!恒星系
entries.en: Space Fauna can only be lured to a system matching their preferred habitat: $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $tiyanki$: §HGas Giant§! systems $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $space_amoeba_plural$: §HNebula§! systems $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $crystalline_entity_plural$: §HPulsar§! systems $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $voidworms_plural$: §HBlack Hole§! systems $TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $cutholoids_plural$: §HAsteroid§! systems

entries.zh: 我们与本土生物和谐共处，竭尽全力保护它们的栖息地，并促进其物种的可持续发展。
entries.en: We live in partnership with our native creatures, taking the utmost care in the protection of their habitat and the sustainable growth of their species.

entries.zh: 精心设计的生态系统管理改善了本地生物的生存条件，并促进了畜牧业的发展。
entries.en: Careful ecosystem management improves the conditions for native creatures and facilitates ranching efforts.

entries.zh: 这是一个广阔的设施，动物可以自由漫步。为了最大限度地提高动物提供的资源质量，这里为它们提供了舒适和奢华的环境。
entries.en: A vast facility where animals are allowed to roam freely. They are offered comfort and luxury in an effort to maximize the quality of the resources they provide.

entries.zh: 这是一个训练中心，用于掌握各种狩猎技巧。从现代能量武器到传统武术器械，无与伦比的灵巧和技巧才能战胜可怕的猎物，并将它们作为战利品。
entries.en: A training complex used to master all manner of hunting techniques. From modern energy weapons to traditional martial implements, unmatched dexterity and skill is required to best fearsome predators and claim them as trophies.

entries.zh: 一个可以为狩猎地动物的提供最佳条件的训练和监控设施。热成像技术有助于识别动物的最新踪迹，并获取优质的猎物。
entries.en: A training and surveillance facility providing optimal hunting conditions for local fauna. Heat-mapping technology helps identify recent animal trails and acquire trophy-quality game.

entries.zh: 这是一个广阔的区域，支持大规模的行星狩猎队伍。这里配备了最高质量的武器和追踪设备，猎人接受了高级训练，以最大限度地提高猎杀的猎物数量和质量。
entries.en: A vast expanse supporting planetary hunting parties on a massive scale. Stocked with the highest quality weapons and tracking equipment, hunters are given high level training in maximizing the quantity and quality of game killed.

entries.zh: 这是一个保护区，野生动物在自然栖息地内被研究。这里有保障措施来防止种群不稳定或过度疾病。研究这些生物本身就是一项有价值的学术工作，但最重要的是，它让我们更多地了解我们自己的本质。
entries.en: A protected reserve where wild animals are studied within their natural habitats. Safeguards are in place to prevent population instability or excessive disease. Studying these creatures is in itself a worthy academic endeavor, but crucially it teaches us more about our own nature.

entries.zh: 这里的生物都得到个性化的照顾，它们的独特饮食和医疗需求得到满足，同时最大程度地减少对自然栖息地的干扰。专门的生态系统允许濒危物种的繁殖和重新引入。
entries.en: Creatures here are cared for on an individual basis, their unique dietary and medical needs provided with minimal disturbance to their natural habitats. Specialized ecosystems allow for the propagation and reintroduction of endangered species.

entries.zh: 这里的动物受到精心设计的、看似不存在的基础设施的监控和照顾。研究人员被禁止干预受试者的自然行为，从而保证收集到质量最高的科研数据。
entries.en: Animals here are monitored and cared for using a carefully engineered infrastructure designed to seem as if it doesn't exist. Researchers are forbidden from interfering with the subjects' natural behavior, guaranteeing the collection of the highest possible quality research data.

entries.zh: 一座角斗场，我们的最强战士与凶猛的野兽进行原始的战斗。没有什么比观看英雄战胜野兽，或者战死沙场更令人兴奋的娱乐了。
entries.en: A colosseum where our strongest warriors are pitted against ferocious creatures in primal combat. There is no greater entertainment than watching heroes triumph over savage beasts - or die trying.

entries.zh: 在这座巨大的体育场里，一群群动物在训练有素的驯兽师的指导下，训练着它们的攻击技巧。兽斗士不再能依靠蛮力制服猎物：他们必须比他们的驯兽师更聪明才能生存。
entries.en: In this massive stadium, packs of animals are trained by skilled handlers in coordinating their attacks. No longer can beastfighters rely on simply overpowering their quarry: they must use out-think even their trainers in order to survive.

entries.zh: 一座令人敬畏的竞技场，专为举办史诗级的猎兽战斗而设计。每次战斗都需要数周的准备，可容纳数百万观众。
entries.en: An awe-inspiring arena designed to host beast-slaying battles of monumental proportions. Each engagement takes weeks of preparation and can support the attendance of millions of individuals.

entries.zh: 一个可以容纳野生伙伴们加入我们大家庭的自然保护区。每个生物都为心灵编织贡献着独特的价值。
entries.en: A natural preserve where wild partners are welcomed into our fold. Each creature has something unique to offer the mindweave.

entries.zh: 一个中央保留地，用于将我们的野生生物伙伴分组到能够自我维持的小种群中。协调他们较低的精神能力，为更大的思维网络提供思想稳定性。
entries.en: A central reserve that serves to group our wild partners into self-maintaining pods. Coordinating their lesser mental capacities provides stability of thought to the greater mindweave.

entries.zh: 一个广阔的中心枢纽，旨在汇聚所有生物的心智，为我们集体意识提供动力。
entries.en: An expansive hub that serves to unite the minds of every creature in powering our collective thought.

entries.zh: 来自星系各世界的牧场主们将展示他们珍爱的牲畜，并角逐梦寐以求的“最佳展示”奖。
entries.en: Ranchers from across the galaxy exhibit their prized livestock and compete for the coveted "Best in Show."

entries.zh: 我们最耐劳的牲畜应该承担一些最费力的工作。
entries.en: Our hardiest livestock should do their part in some of our most labor-intensive duties.

entries.zh: 我们有责任确保我们照护的生物拥有最高的生活质量。
entries.en: It is our responsibility to ensure the highest quality of life for the creatures within our care.

entries.zh: 无论物种，所有生物对疼痛的反应都相似。关键在于学会如何正确地施加疼痛。
entries.en: No matter the species, every organism has a similar response to pain. The trick is learning how to inflict it correctly.

entries.zh: 我们照管的低等有机生命体，其思维能力足以在更复杂的计算中提供带宽。
entries.en: The minds of the lesser organisms in our care are of sufficient capacity to lend bandwidth in more demanding calculations.

entries.zh: 我们是一体的，让我们的本能在这冰冷的深空中交织在一起。
entries.en: We are as one. Let our instincts entwine in the cold of deep space.

entries.zh: 通过安装合适的脑神经受体，我们可以将低等生物逼到极限。
entries.en: Our lesser creatures can be pushed to their absolute limits with the proper neural receptors installed.

entries.zh: 与[from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural]建立联系后，我们在[fromfrom.GetName]中发现了一具他们物种的腐烂尸体。遗骸在长时间暴露于太空后变得干枯并冻得梆硬。\n\n我们推测这具尸体是吸引了该物种其他成员的首要因素；也许他们一直在寻找他们[from.GetSpaceFaunaGroup]中失踪的成员。这是一个难得的机会，可以研究在虚空中自然死亡的[from.GetSpaceFaunaName]的生物学特性。
entries.en: After establishing contact with the [from.GetSpaceFaunaNamePlural], we detected a decaying corpse of one of their kind in [fromfrom.GetName]. The remains are withered and frozen after prolonged exposure to open space.\n\nWe postulate that this carcass is what initially attracted other members of their species; perhaps they had been searching for a lost member of their [from.GetSpaceFaunaGroup]. This is a rare opportunity to study the biology of a [from.GetSpaceFaunaName] that has died of natural causes in the void.

entries.zh: 在[contact_system.GetName]发现了一具[met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName]的尸体。对这些野生生物遗骸的研究将加深我们对这些太空生物的了解。
entries.en: The carcass of a [met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName] was discovered in [contact_system.GetName]. Studying these remains in the wild will broaden our understanding of these spaceborne creatures.

entries.zh: 对[contact_system.GetName]的[met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName]尸体所进行的尸检已经完成。我们从遗骸中提取了一个保存完好的生物样本，它为我们提供了对其生理结构的独特见解。
entries.en: The autopsy on the [met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName] corpse in [contact_system.GetName] is complete. We have recovered a well-preserved biological specimen from within the remains that provides unique insight into their physiology.

entries.zh: 这艘船装饰着成年的缇扬奇卷须，一排排虚空虫的牙齿，以及一个我们从未见过的生物的头骨。它配备了各种精密武器，显得杀气腾腾。
entries.en: The ship is adorned with tendrils of mature Tiyanki, rows of Voidworm teeth, and the skull of a creature we have never seen before. It is bristling with an array of precision weapons.

entries.zh: 我们与一艘来自[from.GetName]的奇怪改装太空船取得了联系。$NAME_BoneShip_desc$\n\n在天真地接受了我们的谈判邀请后，这位驾驶员被立即[GetExecuted]。我们已经夺取了他的古怪飞船，并将其加入了我们的军事序列。我们在他的个人物品中发现了一本有用的猎人工具指南。
entries.en: We were contacted by a strangely modified spacefaring vessel in [from.GetName]. $NAME_BoneShip_desc$\n\nAfter naively accepting our invitation to parlay, the pilot was summarily [GetExecuted]. We have claimed their peculiar ship and added it to our military ranks. We have discovered a useful hunter's field guide among their personal effects.

entries.zh: 我们收到了来自[from.GetName]的一艘奇怪改装的星际飞船的联络。$NAME_BoneShip_desc$\n\n他们正在所有频率上向我们打招呼。
entries.en: We were contacted by a strangely modified spacefaring vessel in [from.GetName]. $NAME_BoneShip_desc$\n\nThey are hailing us on all frequencies.

entries.zh: 一位在星系中游荡，寻找大型猎物的熟练猎手。
entries.en: A proficient hunter that roams the galaxy in search of big game.

entries.zh: §L“我要为我的展柜找下一个战利品。”§!
entries.en: §L"I seek another trophy for my collection."§!

entries.zh:
§H瑟里兹低沉的声音干涩而沙哑，仿佛已经好几周没有说话了。此人直言不讳，保持着冷静的眼神接触，既显得尊重，又让人感到一丝威慑。§!

作为一名猎物收藏家，要让我印象深刻可不容易。你们做到了。

我愿意加入你们的狩猎队伍，但前提是我们的合作将基于便利和相互学习。
entries.en:
§HThe brooding Ceriz's voice is dry and cracking, as if they had not spoken in weeks. Their manner is direct and they maintain stoic eye contact in a manner that feels in equal part respectful and intimidating.§!

As a trophy hunter, it takes a lot to impress me. Your people have.

I am willing to join your hunting parties with the understanding that our partnership will be one of convenience and mutual instruction.

entries.zh: 我是$NAME_PrimalHunter$，我在这些恒星系中狩猎多年。我正在寻找新的猎物，而你们的人民似乎是能干的追踪者。\n\n我的动机很简单：狩猎的快感。
entries.en: I am $NAME_PrimalHunter$. I have hunted within these systems for many years. I seek new quarry, and your people seem to be capable trackers.\n\nMy motivation is simple: the thrill of the hunt.

entries.zh: 你船上的那个颅骨是什么？
entries.en: What is that skull on your ship?

entries.zh: 它是同类中最后的，它奋力抵抗。
entries.en: It was the last of its kind. It put up quite a fight.
How long have you been watching us?

entries.zh: 很明显，你们的人还有很多东西要学。\n\n一个优秀的猎手可以长时间潜行追踪猎物。真正的致命，需要在开枪前保持隐形。我在阴影中度过的时间并不重要，重要的是我选择何时现身。
entries.en: It is obvious that your people have much to learn.\n\nA good hunter can track their quarry for as long as required in perfect stealth. To be truly deadly, one must remain unseen until the shot is fired. The time I have spent in the shadows is of no concern, my choice to reveal myself is what counts.

entries.zh: 我并不寻求在猎场上的竞争。虽然我不愿分享领地，但我宁愿与你的猎手并肩作战，而不愿为同一猎物大打出手。\n\n无论你追踪什么，我都会杀死。
entries.en: I seek no competition in the field. Though I am loath to share territory, I would rather work alongside your hunters than fight over the same prey.\n\nWhatever you track, I will kill.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_PrimalHunter$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入我们帝国。
一艘独立的星际研究船联系了我们位于[from.GetName]的恒星基地。这艘船配备了一系列捕获装置和分析工具，专门用于捕获和研究太空生物。\n\n他们正在所有频率上向我们打招呼。
entries.en: We have been contacted by an independent research vessel at our starbase in [from.GetName]. Outfitted with an array of snaring devices and analytical tools, this ship is specifically adapted for the capture and examination of spaceborne life.\n\nThey are hailing us on all frequencies.

entries.zh: 她是一位对实地考察充满热情的异星生物学家，研究过各种各样的太空生物。
entries.en: A xenologist with a passion for field work, she has studied all manner of spaceborne beasts.

entries.zh: §L“每个生物都有故事要讲，而我是一个热心的倾听者！”§!
entries.en: §L"Every creature has a story to tell, and I'm a keen listener!"§!

entries.zh: §H茹克的眼睛不停地闪烁，注视着一个小巧的手持设备，她那探究和分析的目光让人印象深刻。即使在向我们打招呼时，她也似乎在做着笔记。尽管如此，她的态度还是友好而专业，只是略带疏离。§!\n\n我发现自己对太空生物的兴趣并非孤例。我研究了[root.GetName]正在进行的研究，它简直是启迪人心。我非常希望能加入你们的科学部门，为这些努力贡献力量。当然，如果你们愿意的话。
entries.en: §HInquisitive and analytical, Ruuk's eyes flicker constantly to a small, handheld device. Even as she greets us, she appears to be taking notes. Despite that, her manner is cordial and professional, if slightly detached.§!\n\nI see that I'm not alone in my interest in spaceborne creatures. I have studied the research the [root.GetName] has been conducting and it is positively illuminating. I would love nothing more than to aid these efforts as part of your science department. If you'll have me, of course.

entries.zh:
抱歉，我有点儿太着急了。

我叫茹克，是一名专门研究太空兽群的野外实地考察员。我和我的团队收集有关迁徙模式、身体组成和星系生物多样性的数据。

我从小就喜欢动物。我无论去哪里都带着我的宠物芙芙。
entries.en:
Sorry, I'm getting ahead of myself.

My name is Ruuk. I'm a researcher specializing in the field study of spaceborne fauna. My team and I gather data about migration patterns, body composition, and galactic-level biodiversity.

Personally, I've loved animals since I was a chick. I never go anywhere without Fuluff.

entries.zh: 整个星系我最爱的小朋友！\n\n我本来想把它展示在屏幕上，但它现在睡着了。在我的家乡行星，我们把这种生物当宠物饲养，我上次回去的时候领养了它。真是太可爱了：听到小蹄子在金属地板上哒哒地跑，啃我的羽毛的样子，还有两只小眼睛之间那撮毛。我相信它也会让你着迷的，当……如果我们开始合作的话。
entries.en: Only my favorite guy in the whole galaxy!\n\nI'd show him on-screen, but he's asleep right now. On my home planet, we breed this species as pets and I adopted him on my last visit. He's just the cutest; hearing his little hooves skitter on the metal floors, the way he nibbles on my feathers, the tuft of wool that sticks up between his little eyes. I'm sure he'll win you over too when... if we start working together.

entries.zh: 我们追踪的一份样本出现了异常行为，于是我们追寻它的踪迹。在那里，我们发现您的科研团队正在与我们的研究对象互动。您对这些生物的细致照料体现了对太空生命的真正尊重，这激励我去了解您的研究，而您的研究更是让我印象深刻。我一直在寻找志同道合的同行。
entries.en: One of the specimens we were tracking showed some anomalous behavior, so we followed its trail. There we found your scientific team engaging with our subject. The great care you took with the creatures showed a real respect for spaceborne life, and that inspired me to look into your research, which impressed me even more. I'm always looking for like-minded peers in the field.

entries.zh: 说实话，自由科学研究并不能可靠地提供收入。我坚信自己的工作，但花费一生寻找资金会占用太多时间，无法专注于核心科学本身。\n\n加入[root.GetName]，我将能够将所有时间投入到我最擅长的领域：研究太空生命。我将获得更多资源，并能与贵国现有的科学团队合作，共同实现我们的目标。
entries.en: Honestly, freelance scientific research is not a reliable source of income. I believe in my work, but spending my life looking for funding simply takes too much time away from the core science itself.\n\nBy joining the [root.GetName], I would be able to commit all of my time to do what I do best: studying spaceborne life. I would gain access to greater resources and could collaborate with your existing science team to further our mutual goals.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_PrimalRancher$§!作为一名§H领袖§!加入我们帝国。
我们探测到来自未知空间的大量古怪电磁波。\n\n初步分析表明，这些波动与§Y虚空虫§!的通讯信号相似，但更加不规则，振幅也高得多。我们将对此进行进一步调查。
entries.en: We have detected a huge number of peculiar electromagnetic waves coming from uncharted space.\n\nInitial analysis indicates a resemblance to §YVoidworm§! communication signals, albeit more irregular and with a greatly elevated amplitude. This will be investigated further.

entries.zh:
我们已经探测到这些动物般的尖叫声的来源：一个隐藏的恒星系，里面住满了§Y虚空虫§!，位于[frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]附近。

这个恒星系中的虚空虫与我们之前遇到的不同。这些生物发生了变异；没有形成三头虫，单个成熟的个体正在进行的行为，只能被描述为狂暴的交配狂欢。

这令人担忧：这种非寄生行为意味着这个虫群可以独立繁殖，无需行星宿主。
entries.en:
We have detected the source of these animalistic screeches; a hidden system populated by §YVoidworm§! near [frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName].

The Voidworms in this system are unlike those we have encountered previously. These creatures are mutated; there are no troikas formed and the individual mature specimens are engaging in what can only be described as a violent mating frenzy.

This is concerning: this non-parasitic behavior means this hive can breed independently without the need for planet-borne hosts.

entries.zh: \n如果任由这种变异物种不受控制地蔓延，它可能会彻底破坏星系生态系统的平衡。根据它们不断升级的侵略行为，我们认为这些生物正在准备对[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]发动攻击。
entries.en: \nIf this variant species were allowed to spread unchecked, it could upset the balance of the galactic ecosystem entirely. Based on their mounting aggression, we believe that these creatures are preparing for an assault on [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName].

entries.zh: \n我们必须准备好自己的防线。

我们发现了一个巨大的、明显发生过变异的虚空虫的巢穴。它们具有高度的攻击倾向，并且似乎能够以非寄生方式繁殖。

我们的存在似乎激怒了它们的巢穴。我们必须谨慎行事。

[GetVoidwormsHostility]
entries.en:
We discovered a large hive of obviously mutated Voidworms. They exist in a heightened state of aggression, and apparently have the ability to reproduce in a non-parasitic manner.

Our presence seems to be agitating their nests. We must proceed with caution.

[GetVoidwormsHostility]

entries.zh: 侵略性的虚空虫可能会攻击我们的首都。
entries.en: Aggressive Voidworms may attack our capital.

entries.zh: 我们目前不会采取任何特殊行动。
entries.en: We will take no special actions here.

entries.zh: 我们恒星系中所有最靠近其家园星系的建筑活动将被暂停。
entries.en: All construction activities in our system nearest their home system are halted.

entries.zh: 激怒这些生物会加剧它们对我们的敌意。
entries.en: Provoking the creatures will raise their hostility toward us.

entries.zh: 如果我们能降低其攻击性到足够程度，就有可能赢得它们的信任。
entries.en: If we lower their aggression enough, it's possible we can gain their trust.

entries.zh: 变异的虚空虫表现出§P极高的侵略性§!。
变异的虚空虫表现出§S一定侵略性§!。
变异的虚空虫表现出§B温顺§!。
我们保存了这些奇特变异体的巢穴中最大的那一个。在我们的控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而无需担心它们在星系中不受控制地蔓延。
entries.en: The largest nest of the strange mutants was preserved. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们不愿坐等它们迟早要来的攻击，因此对变异的虚空虫在其家园星系发起了一场成功的军事行动。这些生物的威胁将不再笼罩[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]，我们星球的安全
entries.en: Unwilling to wait for their inevitable attack, we launched a successful military campaign against the mutated Voidworms in their home system. The threat of these creatures will no longer loom over [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName], and the safety of our planet

entries.zh: $grand_archive.1165.desc.common$和整个星系的生态平衡得到了保障。\n\n$frenzied_voidworms_killed.desc.common$
entries.en: $grand_archive.1165.desc.common$ and the galactic ecosystem has been secured.\n\n$frenzied_voidworms_killed.desc.common$

entries.zh: 变异的虚空虫已被歼灭。这些生物的威胁将不再笼罩[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]，我们星球的安全
entries.en: The mutated voidworms have been eliminated. The threat of these creatures will no longer loom over [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName], and the safety of our planet

entries.zh: $grand_archive.1170.desc.common$和整个星系的生态平衡得到了保障。\n\n$frenzied_voidworms_killed.desc.common$
entries.en: $grand_archive.1170.desc.common$ and the galactic ecosystem has been secured.\n\n$frenzied_voidworms_killed.desc.common$

entries.zh:
在消灭了巢穴附近的一窝虚空虫之后，我们发现这些生物发生了独特的变异。

它们似乎能够以非寄生方式繁殖，并且处于高度攻击状态，这解释了它们非自然的强大和耐久性。

幸运的是，我们保留了一个它们的巢穴作为战利品。在我们控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而不会冒它们不受控制地蔓延到整个星系的风险。
entries.en:
After eliminating a clutch of Voidworms near their nests, we discovered that these creatures had undergone a unique mutation.

It seems that they were able to reproduce in a non-parasitic manner and were in a heightened state of aggression, which would explain their unnatural strength and durability.

Fortunately, we preserved one of their nests as a trophy. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们已经得知，威胁我们殖民地的变异虚空虫已被消灭。\n\n这是一个意外但令人欣慰的结果。我们可以安心的是，这些生物将不再对我们的恒星系构成威胁。
entries.en: We have learned that the mutated Voidworms threatening our colony have been eliminated.\n\nAn unexpected, but welcome conclusion. We can take solace in the fact that these creatures shall no longer antagonize our systems.

entries.zh:
狂暴的虚空虫正在攻击[frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]！

它们的侵略性已经达到顶峰，目前它们的主虫群正在直奔[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]而去。

我们认为它们不会留下任何幸存者。
entries.en:
The frenzied Voidworms are attacking [frenzied_voidworms_target.solar_system.GetName]!

Their aggression has risen to a fever pitch, and the current trajectory of their main swarm is heading directly for [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName].

We do not believe they intend on leaving any survivors.

entries.zh: 尽管我们尽了最大努力，变异的虚空虫还是彻底摧毁了[this.GetName]。这些狂暴生物的对地轰击太过猛烈，导致行星地核破裂，整个星球最终裂成碎片。没有幸存者。\n\n它们已经回到了巢穴，不再对我们的存在感到激怒。希望它们能一直待在那里。
entries.en: Despite our best efforts, the mutated Voidworms have completely overwhelmed [this.GetName]. The frenzied creatures' bombardment was so violent that it cracked the planet's core, causing it to fragment and break apart. There were no survivors.\n\nThey have since returned to their nests and are no longer agitated by our presence. With any luck, they will remain there.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.1205.desc_common$\n\n面对这场悲剧，我们别无选择，只能继续前进，从错误中吸取教训。
entries.en: $grand_archive.1205.desc_common$\n\nWe have no recourse in the face of this tragedy except to live on and learn from our mistakes.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.1205.desc_common$\n\n我们主巢的陷落对于[event_target:victim_country.GetName]来说是一次重大的打击，但我们必须学会接受。
entries.en: $grand_archive.1205.desc_common$\n\nThe loss of our primary hive is a blow to [event_target:victim_country.GetName], but we live on.
Now is the time to rebuild.

entries.zh:
在[From.GetName]发现的变异虚空虫已被消灭。[avenged_homeworld.GetName]的毁灭得到了报复。

我们保留了这些奇怪变异生物的巢穴中最大的那一个。在我们控制下，我们可以培育更多这种独特的生物，而不会冒着它们不受控制地蔓延到整个星系的风险。

这样，我们一度失去的世界依旧能够传承下来。
entries.en:
The mutated Voidworms discovered in [From.GetName] have been eliminated. The destruction of [avenged_homeworld.GetName] has been avenged.

The largest nest of the strange mutants was preserved. Under our control, we can raise more of these unique creatures without risking their unchecked spread throughout the galaxy.

In this way, the legacy of our lost world will live on.

entries.zh: 通过向[frenzied_home_system.GetName]的变异虚空虫巢穴直接输送大量矿物，我们成功地与它们建立了联系。这些生物的威胁将不再笼罩[frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]。我们星球的安全
entries.en: After sending significant amounts of mineral sustenance directly to their nests, we were able to develop a relationship with the mutated Voidworms in [frenzied_home_system.GetName]. The threat of these creatures will no longer loom over [frenzied_voidworms_target.GetName]. The safety of our planet

entries.zh: 我们经验最丰富的动物饲养员一直在努力管理这些野兽，现在它们似乎愿意同我们进行互相合作。\n\n我们已经收容了它们最大的巢穴之一。有了它，我们可以培育更多这些原本会留在野外的变异虚空虫。
entries.en: Our most experienced animal handlers have been at work managing the beasts, and we are at a point where they seem to be willing to mutually cooperate.\n\nWe have taken in one of their largest nests. With this, we can cultivate more of these mutated Voidworms that would otherwise have been left to the wild.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.1220.desc.common$和整个星系的生态平衡得到了保障。\n\n$grand_archive.1220.desc.common_2$
entries.en: $grand_archive.1220.desc.common$ and the galactic ecosystem has been secured.\n\n$grand_archive.1220.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: 对于舰队来说是备受欢迎的补充。
entries.en: A welcome addition to the fleets.

entries.zh: 所有狂暴的虚空虫舰队都将由你的帝国控制
entries.en: All Frenzied Voidworm fleets are added to your empire's control

entries.zh: 我们对太空有机生物的掌握促成我们开发出被称之为§Y虚空诱饵§!的东西。
entries.en: Our mastery of spaceborne organisms has led to the development of what we are calling §YVoidlures§!.

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

这些恒星基地建筑必须建造在每种特定太空兽群的原生恒星系中。建成后，它们将定期吸引呈舰队般集群的生物前往该恒星基地。

我们应该谨慎，因为某些类型的生物可能会变得具有攻击性。
entries.en:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

These starbase buildings must be built within the native systems of each particular kind of Space Fauna. Once established, they will periodically attract fleets of creatures to the starbase.

We should be cautious, as certain types of organisms could become aggressive.

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

这些模块必须安装在各种太空兽群对应原生恒星系内的驿站上。建成后，它们将周期性地吸引生物种群到驿站来。安装有虚空诱饵阵列的方舟舰可以召唤我们遇到的生物，将它们引诱到任何它们所能栖息的恒星系。

我们应保持警惕，因为某些类型的生物可能会变得具有攻击性。
entries.en:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

These modules must be installed on Waystations within the native systems of each particular kind of Space Fauna. Once established, they will periodically attract fleets of creatures to the Waystation. An Arkship equipped with a Voidlure Array may instead call to fauna we have encountered, drawing them to any system that is home to their kind.

We should be cautious, as certain types of organisms could become aggressive.

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

这些设备旨在呼唤太空中的野生生物，吸引在虚空中避难的有机生命体。我们不确定会吸引什么，但目前我们正在广播的频率正在返回规律且镜像的响应。

有东西正向我们而来。
entries.en:
$grand_archive.7010.desc.common$

These devices are designed to call into the wilds of space and attract organisms that take shelter in the void. We are not sure what we might attract, but the current frequencies we are broadcasting are returning regular and mirrored responses.

Something is coming to us.

entries.zh: 我们之前研发的§Y虚空诱饵§!吸引了一群来自其他恒星系的太空鲸鱼，这些恒星系类似[This.Capital.System.GetName]，均含有§Y气态巨行星§!。\n\n看来我们的设备必须在这些环境中建造才能正常工作。如果我们发现其他野生动物，我们应该也能在它们的自然栖息地附近建造虚空诱饵。
entries.en: The §YVoidlure§! we had previously developed attracted a group of space whales native to systems with §YGas Giants§! akin to [This.Capital.System.GetName].\n\nIt seems our devices must be built in those environments to work properly. Should we discover other wild fauna, we should be able to construct Voidlures near their natural habitats as well.

entries.zh: 怀揣着对冒险的渴望，这个文明已经准备好踏上他们最伟大、最具挑战性的探险之旅。他们只手持一张神秘的地图，现在正跨越星辰，去争夺传说中的海盗宝藏。
entries.en: Instilled with a thirst for adventure, this civilization is ready to set forth on their greatest and most challenging expedition. Armed only with a mysterious map, they now race across the stars to secure a legendary pirate treasure.

entries.zh:
我们的文明，其本质在于对冒险的渴望。

发现失落的宝藏，探索古老的遗迹，挖掘超越我们时代的文物；这些事件构成了我们最著名的故事，并激励着我们的社会代代相传。

那么，当我们首次进军太空时，出现的冒险号召是巧合还是命运？一颗神秘的、来源不明的太空舱被发现环绕着我们的星球。舱内是一张指向星辰的加密星图。

经过多年的努力，我们终于拥有了解密这张星图并规划航线的技术。当我们向星系边疆进发时，我们团结一致，决心踏上我们有史以来最伟大、最艰巨的探险之旅。
entries.en:
Our civilization is defined by its thirst for adventure.

Discovering long-lost treasures, exploring ancient ruins, and unearthing artifacts from times beyond our own; such events comprise our most celebrated stories and have inspired our society for generations.

So was it coincidence or fate when our first foray into space produced a call to adventure? A mysterious capsule of unknown providence was discovered orbiting our planet. Within was an encrypted chart to the stars.

After years of hard work, we now have the technology to decipher this map and chart a course to the unexplored. As we cast off towards the galactic frontier, we are united in our determination to embark on the greatest and most daunting expedition we have ever faced.

entries.zh:
我们的文明以对冒险的热衷而著名。

寻找失传已久的宝藏、探索古老的遗迹、发掘远古时代的遗物……如此种种构成了我们最广为流传的传奇故事，并激励着我们的社会数代人。

那么，当我们在漫无目的中撞见了冒险的召唤，这究竟是巧合还是命运的安排呢？在探索未知星系的过程中，我们找到了一个天意难测的神秘胶囊，里面有一份引向群星的加密星图。

经过多年的研究，我们终于破译了这张星图，并规划出了前往未被探索区域的路线。我们团结一致，朝着星系的边疆启航，决心踏上有史以来最伟大、最艰巨的探险之旅。
entries.en:
Our civilization is defined by its thirst for adventure.

Discovering long-lost treasures, exploring ancient ruins, and unearthing artifacts from times beyond our own; such events comprise our most celebrated stories and have inspired our society for generations.

So was it coincidence or fate when our wanderings led us to a call to adventure? Exploring an uncharted system, we recovered a mysterious capsule of unknown providence. Within was an encrypted chart to the stars.

After years of study, we have at last deciphered this map and charted a course to the unexplored. As we cast off towards the galactic frontier, we are united in our determination to embark on the greatest and most daunting expedition we have ever faced.

entries.zh: 一个安全的保管库，用于整理、恢复和保存贵重物品。
entries.en: A secure repository where valuables can be organized, restored, and preserved.

entries.zh: 他们受过训练，能够评估各种稀有和珍贵的商品，可以从星系各地发现的宝藏中提取最有价值的东西。
entries.en: Trained to appraise all manner of rare and valuable goods, they can extract the highest value from treasures found across the galaxy.

entries.zh: 他们能够评估各种稀有和珍贵的商品，可以从星系发现的宝藏中提取最有效用的东西。
entries.en: Able to appraise all manner of rare and valuable goods, they can extract the highest possible utility from treasures found across the galaxy.

entries.zh: §Y$celestial_chart$§!为我们提供了宝贵的评估信息档案，有助于我们从发现的宝藏中提取更大的价值。我们应该在我们的一个殖民地上建立一座§Y珍宝馆§!，用于对珍贵的小物件进行分类、修复和保存。根据目前的物流情况，以下殖民地适合建造这个新的设施。
entries.en: The §Y$celestial_chart$§! has provided us with archived appraisal information useful for extracting greater value from the treasures we discover. We should establish a §YTreasure Vault§! on one of our colonies where valuable trinkets can be sorted, restored, and preserved. Based on current logistics, the following colonies are suitable for this new installation.

entries.zh: 传感器检测到[This.System.GetName]星系中存在一个向整个星系发出原始信号的物体。这些相同的信号模式也曾在来自未知区域的长程扫描仪上被记录到。虽然目前尚不清楚这些信号是否具有意图，但需要进一步调查。
entries.en: Sensors indicate a presence in the [This.System.GetName] system that is sending rudimentary signals across the galaxy. These same patterns have been registered on long-range scanners originating from parts unknown. Though it is not clear whether these signals are intentional in nature, it warrants further investigation.

entries.zh: §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!被鉴定为叫做“虚空虫”的星际寄生虫。
entries.en: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! were identified as galactic parasites known as "Voidworms".

entries.zh: 我们发现，这些远距离信号源于一种简单的太空生物，我们将其命名为§H“$NAME_Voidworms$”§!。似乎整个星系都充满了这种生物。根据信号的不同波长，我们确定这些生物在达到最终成熟之前会经历多个生长阶段。虽然它们表面上看起来并不具有攻击性，但它们的交流模式表明它们在星系范围内进行着协调。
entries.en: We have discovered that the far-reaching signals originate from a simple spaceborne organism we have taken to calling §H"$NAME_Voidworms$"§!. It appears that the galaxy is riddled with these creatures. From the varying wavelengths of the signals, we have determined that the creatures develop through several stages of growth before reaching final maturity. Though they do not appear outwardly aggressive, their patterns of communication indicate coordination on a galactic scale.

entries.zh:
虚空虫以三只为一组交配，这种形态被称为“三头虫”。这些生物的一生都被绑定在永无止境的交配仪式中。然而，它们需要外部生物宿主才能繁殖后代。

它们是寄生虫。

虚空虫成熟后，会在其生殖系统内发育出一窝囊肿。这些保护性囊肿包含高腐蚀性的配子，当与三头虫中的其他配子结合时，可以被发送到具有合适生物量的星球上，以产下更多幼虫。它们的宿主无法在这一过程中存活。我们已经看到证据表明，虚空虫会协调它们的轰炸，以便在整个星系中维持可持续数量的可用宿主。

无论如何，我们相信我们可以利用它们的生殖酶的力量来造福我们自己。我们甚至可以对它们的繁殖活动产生免疫力。
entries.en:
Voidworms mate in groups of three, a formation known as a "Troika." These creatures become bound for life in a never-ending mating ritual. However, they require an external biological host to produce offspring.

They are parasites.

Upon reaching maturity, each Voidworm develops a clutch of cysts within their reproductive systems. These protective cysts contain highly caustic gametes that, when combined with others in a Troika, can be sent to planets with suitable biomass in order to give birth to more of their nymphs. Their hosts do not survive this process. We've seen evidence that the Voidworms coordinate their bombardments so as to maintain a sustainable amount of viable hosts throughout the galaxy.

In any case, we believe that we can harness the power of their reproductive enzymes to our own benefit. We may even develop an immunity to their reproductive efforts.

entries.zh: 利用他们的生育能力来满足我们自己的需求。
entries.en: Harness their fertility for our own needs.

entries.zh: 虚空虫的肉富含营养，每次战斗后都可以进行收获，每支被摧毁的舰队带来§G$@voidworms_hunting_buff_food_reward|0$§! £food£。
entries.en: Highly rich in nutrients, Voidworm flesh is harvested after every battle, bringing in §G$@voidworms_hunting_buff_food_reward|0$§! £food£ for every fleet destroyed.

entries.zh: 虚空虫的生物学特性和繁殖模式值得进一步研究。
entries.en: The biology and reproductive patterns of the Voidworms warrant further study.

entries.zh: 我们可以研发出治疗虚空虫寄生感染的药物。所有殖民地将对它们目前使用的孢子轰炸免疫。
entries.en: We can develop a cure for Voidworm parasitic infection. All of our colonies would be rendered immune to their current strain of spore bombardment.

entries.zh: 殖民地不受虚空虫轰炸的影响。\n$mod_damage_vs_country_type_voidworms_mult$：§G+$@vaccine_damage_vs_country_type_voidworms_mult|0%$§!

§R虚空虫瘟疫期间，轨道轰炸免疫不生效。§!\n$mod_damage_vs_country_type_voidworms_mult$：§G+$@vaccine_damage_vs_country_type_voidworms_mult|0%$§!\n§Y$situation_voidworm_plague$§!局势进度推进§G+$@vaccine_situation_advancement|0$§!
entries.en: §RBombardment immunity is ineffective during the Voidworm Plague.§!\n$mod_damage_vs_country_type_voidworms_mult$: §G+$@vaccine_damage_vs_country_type_voidworms_mult|0%$§!\nAdvances the §Y$situation_voidworm_plague$§! Situation by §G+$@vaccine_situation_advancement|0$§!

entries.zh: 虚空虫用来抚育和保护幼虫的巢穴遗迹。
entries.en: The remains of a nest created by Voidworms as a place to raise and protect their young.

entries.zh: 虚空虫的最后一个家园星系已经被摧毁，它们物种也已灭绝。\n\n我们不再需要担心它们的寄生攻击。
entries.en: The last of the Voidworm home systems has been destroyed, and their species has been eradicated.\n\nWe need no longer concern ourselves with their parasitic bombardments.

entries.zh: 我们已经铲除了一个虚空虫的母星系。\n\n它们将无法再利用这些产卵地来抚育幼虫。
entries.en: We have eradicated a Voidworm home system.\n\nThey will no longer be able to make use of these spawning grounds to raise their young.

entries.zh: 有寄生天性的虚空虫是星系的祸害，对有人居住的世界构成威胁。它们的自然生命周期破坏了星系生态系统的平衡，应该被彻底消灭。
entries.en: The parasitic Voidworms are a blight on the galaxy and a threat to populated worlds. Their natural lifecycle offsets the balance of the galactic ecosystem and all should be eliminated.

entries.zh: 任何国境内有§Y$NAME_Voidworms$§!居住的国家都将被视作§R违反星系法§!，直到这些生物自行离开或被彻底摧毁。
entries.en: Any empire with §Y$NAME_Voidworms$§! inside their borders are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the creatures either leave on their own or are destroyed.
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should not have the right to annihilate the Voidworm species.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有虚空虫不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。\n\n在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[this.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that all Voidworms are no longer permitted within member nation systems.\n\nUntil they are eliminated or leave our space of their own accord, the [this.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: 一支虚空虫舰队已进入[from.GetName]星系内的我们的空间。作为[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员，我们有法律义务立即处决在我们边界内的任何虚空虫。\n\n[this.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!，直到虚空虫离开我们的空间或被消灭。
entries.en: A fleet of Voidworms has entered our space in the [from.GetName] system. As a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member, we are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Voidworms present within our borders.\n\nThe [this.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Voidworms have either departed our space or are exterminated.

entries.zh: 虚空虫一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重§R违反了星系法§!中关于$resolution_voidworm_eradication$决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[this.GetName]实施制裁。
entries.en: The continued Voidworm presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant §RBreach of Galactic Law§! under the $resolution_voidworm_eradication$ resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [this.GetName].

entries.zh:
$bombardment_voidworm_invasion$将摧毁人群，创建新的虚空虫幼体。
—对§Y陆军§!造成§Y中度§!伤害
—对§Y行星§!造成[GetVoidwormFleetBombardmentDamageIntensity]伤害，直到§Y25%§!破坏度
—对§Y人口§!造成§Y中度§!伤害
entries.en:
$bombardment_voidworm_invasion$ destroy population and create new Voidworm Nymphs.
- §YModerate§! damage to §YArmies§!
- [GetVoidwormFleetBombardmentDamageIntensity] damage to §YPlanet§! until §Y25%§! devastation
- §YModerate§! damage to §YPops§!

entries.zh: 虚空虫正在轰炸我们的殖民地！
我们的殖民地正在遭受星际寄生虫的轰炸！\n它们携带有限数量的孢子，准备在人口稠密的殖民地传播，很快就会离开。
entries.en: Our colony is being bombarded by galactic parasites!\nThey carry a limited amount of spores to distribute on populated colonies and will soon depart.
$PLANET_NAME|Y$ in $SYSTEM_NAME|Y$. Pops remaining to be consumed: §Y$POPS_TO_KILL$§!.

entries.zh: [from.GetName]正在遭受攻击。\n\n一大群虚空虫正在殖民地轨道上，用寄生囊肿进行轰炸。
entries.en: [from.GetName] is under attack.\n\nA large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

entries.zh: 生物分析表明，每窝虚空虫都拥有有限数量的囊肿，它们很可能在囊肿耗尽后离开。但在那之前，我们会遭受严重的人口损失。
entries.en: Biological analysis indicates that each clutch of Voidworms has a limited supply of these cysts to distribute, and it is likely they will depart once all are depleted. Until then, we are suffering significant population loss.

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$

每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对我们的殖民者以及所有生命都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫体内有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，在那里它们会本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$
entries.en:
$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly not only to our colonists, but all life. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. These nymphs contain a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$

每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对所有本地动物群都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫通常以小行星为食，以获取珍贵的金属，但它们也会伺机捕食我们脆弱的[this.GetColonistPlural]。每个幼虫体内都含有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，并本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$
entries.en:
$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_1$

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly to all native fauna. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. The nymphs, which normally feed on asteroids for their precious metals, opportunistically hunt and feed upon our vulnerable [this.GetColonistPlural].  Each hatchling contains a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend to the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.

$grand_archive.2195.desc.common_2$

entries.zh:
星系中$NAME_Voidworms$的数量已达到临界值，它们的习性正在发生显著变化。

它们生命周期中原本会放任宿主物种繁衍一段时间的阶段已打破，它们似乎不再顾及这些产卵地是否能够维持可持续性。

我们所有殖民地都已进入红色警戒状态。在任何星系中发现$NAME_Voidworms$，都应极其谨慎地应对。

一场泛星系级的繁殖狂潮正在向我们袭来。
entries.en:
The population of $NAME_Voidworms$ in the galaxy has reached a critical mass. Their behavior is noticeably changing.

The typical stage of their lifecycle where host populations would be spared has been disrupted. There seems to be no further regard for the sustainability of their spawning grounds.

All of our colonies are on red alert. The presence of $NAME_Voidworms$ in any system should be met with extreme caution.

A breeding frenzy on the galactic scale is upon us.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.2310.desc.default$\n\n我们之前针对这些寄生虫建立的免疫力，现在已经不再像以前那样有效了。我们需要重新开始研究。
entries.en: $grand_archive.2310.desc.default$\n\nThe immunity we have previously developed against these parasites is no longer working to the same degree. We will need to go back to the drawing board.

entries.zh: 整个星系都在疯传一个令人不安的消息：一种此前不为人知的太空兽群“虚空虫”正在疯狂繁殖。据说，对于那些防御系统不够完善的恒星系来说，这些生物构成了巨大的威胁。我们所有的殖民地现在都已经进入了最高警戒状态。
entries.en: Disturbing reports are being intercepted across the galaxy that a previously unknown species of space fauna known as "Voidworms" have entered a reproductive frenzy. These creatures are reportedly a significant threat to planets without adequate system defenses. All of our colonies are now on red alert.

entries.zh:
$NAME_Voidworms$瘟疫正在肆虐。

这些生物不再将宿主星球作为繁殖地。我们必须消灭它们，否则我们的殖民地将面临风险。

§Y每消灭一个虚空虫都会加速局势进展。§!
entries.en:
A plague of $NAME_Voidworms$ is upon us.

These creatures will no longer spare host planets as breeding grounds. We must work to eradicate them or our colonies will be at risk.

§YEach Voidworm destroyed accelerates Situation progress.§!

entries.zh: 你的殖民地将不再受到虚空虫的轰炸影响。
entries.en: Your colonies will no longer be vulnerable to Voidworm bombardment.

entries.zh: 我们目前不会采取任何特殊行动。
entries.en: We will take no special actions here.

entries.zh: 为了对抗虚空虫的威胁，我们可以牺牲一小部分生活品质来支援我们的军事舰队。\n局势$SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$：§G+0.5§!
entries.en: We can sacrifice a small amount of quality of life in support of our military fleets against the Voidworm menace.\nSituation $SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$: §G+0.5§!

entries.zh: 被$NAME_Voidworms$轰炸过的殖民地不会产生新的$NAME_Voidworms$。\n局势$SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$：§G+0.7§!
entries.en: $NAME_Voidworms$ bombarding your colonies will no longer spawn new $NAME_Voidworms$.\nSituation $SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$: §G+0.7§!

entries.zh: 如果我们能打破它们的生物循环，$NAME_Voidworms$就无法在这个星系中继续繁殖了。\n局势$SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$：§G+1.0§!
entries.en: If we can break their biological cycle, the $NAME_Voidworms$ will no longer be able to reproduce in this galaxy.\nSituation $SITUATION_MONTHLY_CHANGE$: §G+1.0§!

entries.zh: §S采用该应对方案将锁定其他应对方案，持续§Y$@voidworm_plague_approach_cooldown_years|0$年§!。§!
entries.en: §SAdopting this approach will lock other approaches for §Y$@voidworm_plague_approach_cooldown_years|0$ years§!.§!

entries.zh: §S再次更改局势的应对方案还为时过早。§!
entries.en: §SIt is too early to change Situation Approaches again.§!

entries.zh: 星系中的虚空虫数量已达到无法继续维持的水平，必须将其彻底消灭。\n\n我们已经找到了所有剩余的§Y虚空虫巢穴§!，必须将其摧毁。
entries.en: The Voidworm population in the galaxy has reached unsustainable levels, and they must be eradicated.\n\nWe have located all remaining §YVoidworm Nests§! that must be destroyed.

entries.zh: 在该恒星系检测到§Y虚空虫巢穴§!。\n\n摧毁它们可以防止生成更多的寄生虫。
entries.en: §YVoidworm Nests§! have been detected in this system.\n\nDestroy them to stop more parasites from being created.

entries.zh: 我们在对抗$NAME_Voidworms$的行动中，由于改良了维护协议，舰队支援力度提升，意外获得了大量额外的零件。我们有机会将这些材料投入到提高新舰队的短期生产中。
entries.en: Our increased fleet support in efforts against the $NAME_Voidworms$ has yielded an unexpected windfall of additional components due to improved maintenance protocols. We have an opportunity to invest these materials into improving our short-term production of new fleets.

entries.zh: 我们持之以恒抵御虚空虫威胁的准备工作，激励了新一代的指挥官。[this.GetName]的经验丰富的公民选择贡献他们的才能，以消除这个全星系的威胁。
entries.en: Our continued preparations against the Voidworm menace has inspired a new generation of Commanders. Experienced citizens of [this.GetName] have chosen to offer their talents toward the elimination of this galactic threat.

entries.zh: 我们针对虚空虫威胁进行了持续的准备工作，使我们能够生产出额外的指挥官级领袖节点。由于我们为舰队提供额外的支援，这些战斗型节点能够获得更多资源，以促进其快速融入我们的军事行动之中。
entries.en: Our continued preparations against the Voidworm menace has allowed us to produce additional Commander-class leadership nodes. By providing additional support to our fleets, these Combat-focused nodes have received increased resources to facilitate their swift integration into our military efforts.

entries.zh: 刷新§H$RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$§!，并添加3位额外§H指挥官§!，每位指挥官额外提升一级。
entries.en: Refresh our §H$RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$§! and add 3 additional §HCommanders§! with an extra level.

entries.zh: 驻扎在[random_shipyard.GetName]的工程师开发了一种新的舰船防御概念蓝图。[random_shipyard.leader.GetHeSheCap]在对抗虚空虫的战斗中进行例行维修时，[random_shipyard.leader.GetHeShe]灵机一动，想出了一个可以提高舰船坚固性的新组件。该想法提交给我们的研究部门后，我们认为它具有巨大的潜力。
entries.en: An engineer stationed on [random_shipyard.GetName] has developed a new conceptual blueprint for ship defenses. [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeSheCap] was carrying out routine repairs in the fight against the Voidworms when [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeShe] came up with an idea for a new component that would increase the hardiness of our vessels. After the idea was presented to our research department, we believe that it has great potential.

entries.zh: 驻扎在[random_shipyard.GetName]的维修[root.GetIndividualName]激发了新的研究观点，能够改进舰船防御。在例行维修期间的一次误操作中，该[root.GetIndividualName]使用了一种奇特的材料和方法组合，创造了一种新的防护组件。经过对研究可能性进行论证，这一意外发现经过改进后可以展现出巨大潜力。
entries.en: A repair [root.GetIndividualName] stationed on [random_shipyard.GetName] has inspired new research insights to improve ship defenses. After a miscommunication during routine repairs, the [root.GetIndividualName] used a peculiar combination of methods and materials to create a new protective component. After investigating the research possibilities, this accidental discovery has shown great potential once refined.

entries.zh: 在履行[infected_leader.GetHisHer]的职责期间，[infected_leader.GetName]感染了活跃的虚空虫孢子。新的若虫很快就会出现并摧毁它们的宿主。\n\n这可能是一场徒劳的战斗，但医务人员推测，在幼虫完全融入[infected_leader.GetHisHer]的神经系统之前，可能可以将其取出。这是一场风险很大的手术，但[infected_leader.GetName]似乎愿意让我们尝试。
entries.en: In the performance of [infected_leader.GetHisHer] duties, [infected_leader.GetName] [infected_leader.GetHasHave] become infected with active Voidworm spores. It will not be long until new nymphs emerge and destroy their host.\n\nIt could be a lost cause, but the medical staff speculate it may be possible to extract the larva before they have fully integrated into [infected_leader.GetHisHer] nervous system. It's a risky procedure, but [infected_leader.GetName] seems willing to let us try.

entries.zh: 一小群被感染的[infected_planet_pop.species.GetName]从[infected_planet.GetName]的净化行动中逃脱，并分散到我们的恒星系中。如果不加控制，这会导致虚空虫感染蔓延到整个[this.GetName]。
entries.en: A small group of infected [infected_planet_pop.species.GetName] have fled from the purge on [infected_planet.GetName] and dispersed throughout our systems. Left unchecked, this could cause Voidworm infection to spread across the entire [this.GetName].

entries.zh: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$必须赶在这些逃亡者威胁到我们所有人之前尽快处理掉。
entries.en: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$ Those who fled must be dealt with before they endanger us all.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$必须赶在这些逃亡者威胁到我们其他的活体陈设之前尽快处理掉。
entries.en: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$ Those who fled must be dealt with before they endanger our other bio-trophies.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$必须赶在这些逃亡者威胁到我们的大集体意识之前尽快处理掉。
entries.en: $grand_archive.2425.desc.common$ Those who fled must be dealt with before they endanger the greater collective.

entries.zh: 用于分析的受感染动植物样本被错误地当作普通食物进行处理。由于这个错误，大量有机物被虚空虫的寄生虫污染，必须进行处理。
entries.en: Samples of infected flora and fauna marked for analysis were somehow erroneously processed as typical foodstuffs. Following this error, a large quantity of organic matter has been contaminated by Voidworm parasites and must now be disposed of.

entries.zh: -1所有所属殖民地内有机体人口
entries.en: -1 Organic Pop on each owned colony

entries.zh: 所有未受感染的行星获得$@infected_devastation|0$破坏度
我们的殖民地附近可能会出现更多虚空虫的若虫！
entries.en: Additional voidworm nymphs may appear near our colonies!

entries.zh: 虽然清除感染者被认为是最明智的行动方针，但许多士兵却难以执行命令。尽管虚空虫的寄生虫危险性很高，但许多士兵仍然无法为了更大的利益而消灭自己的同胞。\n\n必须采取措施阻止虚空虫感染在我们的殖民地蔓延。我们可以尝试将清除过程的某些环节自动化，从而减少对士兵的需求。或者，我们可以发起短暂的宣传活动，宣传我们清除行动的道德标准，并重申其必要性。
entries.en: While it is agreed that purging the infected is the wisest course of action, many soldiers are struggling to carry out orders. Despite the danger of the Voidworm parasite, many are simply unable to eliminate their fellow citizens for the greater good.\n\nSomething must be done to prevent the Voidworm infection from spreading through our colonies. We may be able to automate certain parts of the purging process so as to require fewer soldiers. Alternatively, we can launch a short publicity campaign to promote the ethical standards of our purging efforts and reaffirm their necessity.

entries.zh: 我们对虚空虫瘟疫的治疗方法的探索，也促进了其他生物学领域的平行研究。虽然寄生虫目前仍是我们的首要任务，但这一新的突破在未来研究中具有巨大潜力。
entries.en: Our search for the cure to the Voidworm plague has allowed research in other biological fields to progress in parallel. While the parasites remain our current priority, this new breakthrough has tremendous potential for future study.

entries.zh: 我们对虚空虫疫的理解正在提高，并且已经开发出治愈方法的基础。
entries.en: Our understanding of the Voidworm Plague is improving and the foundation of a cure has been developed.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.2445.desc.common$然而，如果能在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]参与者身上进行早期活体测试，我们的研究进度将会快得多。\n\n撇开伦理考量不谈，为了更大的利益，绕过某些安全措施或许是明智之举。
entries.en: $grand_archive.2445.desc.common$ However, our research could progress at a much quicker pace with early-stage live testing on [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] participants.\n\nEthical considerations aside, it may be wiser to bypass certain safety measures for the sake of the greater good.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.2445.desc.common$然而，测试过程非常耗时，主要原因是需要不断地将未分配的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]作为测试对象。如果[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以简单地重新分配成为测试对象，那么治愈方案的开发速度将会加快。\n\n然而，这种做法会对整个集体造成其他影响，重新分配的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]将导致其先前角色陷入混乱。
entries.en: $grand_archive.2445.desc.common$ However, the testing process is time-consuming, primarily due to the constant need for idle [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] as subjects. If [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] could simply be reassigned to become test subjects, the cure would develop at a faster rate.\n\nThe consequences would be felt elsewhere throughout the collective, with reassigned [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] leaving their previous role in disarray.

entries.zh: 对毫无察觉的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]进行测试。
不能做有违道德的测试。
我们发现了虚空虫繁殖周期中的一个规律，这可能在合成治疗虚空虫疫的药物方面带来重大突破。\n\n为了验证这一假设，必须从一只野生$voidworms_titan$中采集其生殖腺进行分析。至关重要的是，这只$voidworms_titan$必须在轰炸星球的过程中被杀死，才能保存活跃的生殖配子。
entries.en: We have discovered a pattern in the reproduction cycle of Voidworms that could lead to a huge breakthrough in synthesizing a cure to the Voidworm Plague.\n\nTo confirm this hypothesis, the reproductive glands of a wild $voidworms_titan$ must be harvested for analysis. Crucially, this $voidworms_titan$ must be killed while bombarding a planet in order to preserve the active reproductive gametes.
We have no time for this.

entries.zh: 我们在寻找虚空虫疫的治疗方法方面取得了突破性进展。唯一需要的是处于活跃繁殖状态的虚空三头虫的生殖腺。
entries.en: We have made a breakthrough discovery in the search for a cure to the Voidworm Plague. All that is required are the reproductive glands of a Voidworm Troika in an active state of fertility.

entries.zh: §R收集正在轰炸行星的虚空三头虫的尸骸。§!
entries.en: §RHarvest the debris of a Troika actively bombarding a planet.§!

entries.zh: 这种虚空三头虫的残骸可以收获其具有繁殖能力的生殖腺。\n\n这些器官将极大地扩展我们对这些生物的生物学理解，并帮助我们彻底消灭虚空虫疫。
entries.en: The remains of this Voidworm Troika can be harvested for their fertile reproductive glands.\n\nThese organs would greatly expand our understanding of the creatures' biology and assist in eradicating the Voidworm Plague once and for all.

entries.zh:
从可育的“三头虫”形态的虚空虫身上取回的腺体揭示关于它们生殖循环的新信息。

每一只处于繁殖拥抱中的虚空虫都会将遗传物质均匀分布，有效地形成一个全新的有机体，深锁于交配仪式中直到死亡。

我们可以利用这些展现出遗传延展性的过程来对付他们。
entries.en:
The glands recovered from the fertile Voidworm Troika revealed new information about their reproductive cycles.

Locked in a mating ritual until death, each of the three Voidworms in reproductive embrace distribute their genetic material equally between themselves, effectively becoming a new organism entirely.

We can use these processes of genetic malleability against them.

entries.zh: 我们终于研制出了彻底根治虚空虫寄生感染的方法。从此以后，我们的殖民地再也不用担心那些可怕的孢子袭击了，星系中这些虫子的存在也不再是我们需要操心的问题了。
entries.en: We have completed the development of an ultimate cure to the Voidworm parasitic infection. Our colonies are no longer susceptible to their spore bombardments, and we need no longer be concerned about their presence in the galaxy.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.2500.desc.default$\n\n我们确信，这一次，我们开发的治疗方法已经能够防范他们生物学上的任何未来突变。
entries.en: $grand_archive.2500.desc.default$\n\nWe are certain that, this time, the cure we have developed is safeguarded against any future mutation of their biology.

entries.zh: 虚空寄生虫对星系构成了威胁。如果我们不团结起来阻止它们，它们会将我们吞噬殆尽。我们应该把应对这场天灾作为星系的焦点。
entries.en: The Voidworm parasites are a danger to the galaxy. If we do not unite to stop them, they will consume us all. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.

entries.zh: 虚空虫疫威胁着整个星系。我们必须团结起来，战胜这种寄生虫的威胁。
entries.en: The Voidworm Plague is a threat to the entire galaxy. We must unite and defeat this parasitic menace.

entries.zh: 虚空虫对领土内的人群造成了重大损失。
entries.en: The Voidworms have dealt significant damage to populations within their territory.

entries.zh: 不应该容许吞噬舰船的岩居兽在文明的星系内存在。必须不惜一切代价消灭这些生物。
entries.en: Vessel-devouring Cutholoids should not be permitted to exist freely within civilized systems. These creatures must be exterminated at all costs.

entries.zh: 任何国境内有§Y$cutholoids_plural$§!居住的国家都将被视作§R违反星系法§!，直到这些生物被彻底摧毁。
entries.en: Any empire with §Y$cutholoids_plural$§! inside their borders are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the creatures are destroyed.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的存在并不是为了不分青红皂白强行消灭岩居兽物种的。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] does not exist to mandate the indiscriminate eradication of the Cutholoid species.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有岩居兽不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。\n\n在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that Cutholoids are no longer permitted within member nation systems.\n\nOnce discovered, these creatures must be destroyed, else the [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: [from.GetName]恒星系内发现了一只岩居兽。在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]将其指定为危险害兽之后，成员国有法律义务立即处决在边界内的所有岩居兽。\n\n[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!，直到岩居兽离开我们的星系或被消灭为止。
entries.en: A Cutholoid has been discovered in the [from.GetName] system. Following their designation as a dangerous pest, all [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Cutholoids present within their borders.\n\nThe [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Cutholoid has been exterminated or otherwise driven from our systems.

entries.zh: 岩居兽一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重§R违反了星系法§!中关于$resolution_cutholoid_eradication$决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[Root.GetName]实施制裁。
entries.en: The continued Cutholoid presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant §RBreach of Galactic Law§! under the $resolution_cutholoid_eradication$ resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们的一艘科研船在[cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName]调查一颗奇怪的小行星时失去了联系。\n\n在他们最后失踪的地点探测到了微弱的应急信号，我如果要找回这艘失踪的舰船就需要进一步调查。
entries.en: Contact has been lost with our Science Ship while investigating a strange asteroid in [cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName].\n\nWe are detecting weak emergency signals from their last known location, and should investigate further if we intend to recover the missing vessel.

entries.zh: 在§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!进行例行探索的过程中发现了另一个奇怪的小行星状生物。\n\n我们应该避免让§H科研船§!接近这个星系，直到我们对这个危险的物体有更多的了解为止。
entries.en: Another of the strange asteroidal creatures have been discovered in §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! during routine exploration.\n\nWe should avoid this system with our §HScience Ships§! until we know more about these dangerous objects.

entries.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]中的小行星只是一只栖居在里面的巨大有机体的外壳。

我们成功地将其摧毁，并找回了[this.GetName]。此后调查小行星的时候可得小心了。

可能还有其他的这种生物潜藏于此，等待着不小心的猎物。
entries.en:
The asteroid in [fromfrom.GetName] served only as a shell for a massive organism living inside.

We have successfully destroyed it and recovered [this.GetName]. Caution should be taken in further investigations of asteroids.

More of these creatures may be out there, lying in wait of easy prey.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.3016.desc.default$不幸的是，[leader.GetName]遭受到了一些不可修复的损伤。

entries.en: From the Belly of the Beast

entries.zh:
我们在§H[current_system.GetName]§!失踪的科研船回来了！

§H[leader.GetName]§!发回的报道称，他们被一个藏在小行星中的太空实体整个吞下，最后在船体就要承受不住的时候意外地被吐了出来。似乎有什么别的东西把这个生物吓了一跳让我们侥幸逃脱。

在有更多的认知之前，探索这片小行星带可要多加小心了。
entries.en:
Our Science Ship lost in §H[current_system.GetName]§! has returned!

Reports have come in from §H[leader.GetName]§! that they had been swallowed whole by a spaceborne entity hiding inside of an asteroid, and were at the limits of hull integrity before being unexpectedly ejected to safety. It appears something else has surprised the creature before we could intervene.

We should be cautious in our approach of certain asteroid belts until we can learn more.

entries.zh: [from.GetName]的应急通讯戛然而止。我们只能相信[from.GetName]科研船已经永远离我们而去了。
entries.en: The emergency transmissions from [from.GetName] have ceased. We can only assume the science ship [from.GetName] has been lost for good.

entries.zh: 我们的一艘科研船在调查一颗小行星时失去了联系。在他们最后失踪的地点探测到了微弱的应急信号。
entries.en: Contact has been lost with our Science Ship while investigating an asteroid. We are detecting weak emergency signals from their last known location.

entries.zh:
我们与一艘在[cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName]的科研船[this.GetName]失去了联系。

最后的通讯表明他们当时正在调查一颗附近的小行星，[cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]。

建议靠近这个恒星系的话一定要小心点。
entries.en:
We have lost communication with our science ship [this.GetName] in [cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName].

Their last transmission indicated they were beginning a survey on a nearby asteroid, [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName].

Caution is advised when re-entering this system.

entries.zh: [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]小行星不可貌相。我们需要派遣一支小有规模的军队前去，在[this.GetName]科研船永远离开我们之前将其救出。
entries.en: The asteroid [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName] is not what it seems to be. We should approach with a sizable military force and attempt to recover our science ship [this.GetName] before it is gone for good.

entries.zh: 轨道上有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$支战斗力至少为600的舰队。
entries.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ fleet(s) with at least 600 fleet power in orbit.

entries.zh: [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]小行星不可貌相。我们有了合适的科技，可以将其整个捕获并在[this.GetName]永远离开我们之前将其轻易地救出。
entries.en: The asteroid [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName] is not what it seems to be. With the right technology, we could capture it entirely and easily recover our science ship [this.GetName] before it is gone for good.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[This.System.GetName]§!发现的异常小行星似乎具有感性。靠近这种物体的轨道是非常危险的，在我们有更多的了解之前，建议科研船立刻远离受其影响的恒星系。
entries.en: The irregular asteroid we encountered in §H[This.System.GetName]§! appears to be sentient in nature. Approaching the orbit of such objects is highly dangerous, and Science Ships are advised to leave affected systems immediately until we know more about these entities.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一种居住在小行星外壳内的太空生物，将其命名为§H岩居兽§!。它们是一种可以埋伏数年只为给猎物致命一击的伏击掠食者。它们极度危险，能吞下整艘舰船，所以在探索那些未调查的小行星带时务必格外小心。\n\n好消息是，它们的数量非常稀少，而且无性繁殖流程可能要花费上百年。
entries.en: We have discovered a spaceborne organism that shelters inside of asteroids. Known to us as "§HCutholoids§!", these creatures are ambush predators that are capable of lying in wait for several years to capture their prey. Capable of engulfing entire ships, we should be very careful when approaching unsurveyed asteroid belts as they are found to be extremely dangerous.\n\nThe good news is that they appear to be quite rare, and their asexual reproductive processes can take hundreds of years.

entries.zh: 我们应该进一步研究这些生物。
entries.en: We should study these creatures further.

entries.zh: 伏击猎食者吗。全部摧毁。

岩居兽的外壳并不只是矿物而已，其中还有生物纤维补强。这些纤维一直都在生长，这种外壳中估计包含了超过一半的生物质。

当岩居兽长得住不下小行星时，他们会寻找下一个新家并再次开始整合流程。虽然它们通常具有很强的领地意识，但在极佳的外壳候选品的轨道上也会出现多只岩居兽，其中最大的一只将占据这颗新的小行星，而其他个体将按大小排序，和平地交换外壳。通过这种方式，它们居住的小行星往往会交换十几手之多。

最终的结果是，最小的小行星会因为交换频繁反而得到了最多的生物强化。这些样品具有重要的科学价值。
entries.en:
The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. These fibers never stop growing, and the composition of some shells is estimated to be over fifty percent biomass.

When a Cutholoid grows too large for its asteroid, it will seek another home and begin the integration process again. While they are normally highly territorial, multiple Cutholoids have been observed in orbit of a prime shell candidate. The largest of the creatures will occupy the fresh asteroid, while others will order themselves by size and peacefully swap with the next in line. In this way, the asteroids they inhabit have often been occupied by dozens of previous organisms.

The end result is that the smallest asteroids have the highest amount of biological reinforcement, as they have been exchanged most often. These samples contain significant scientific value.

entries.en: The asteroidal shell structure of the Cutholoid is an impressive piece of biological engineering. There is more for us to learn from them.

entries.en: We have destroyed a massive creature hidden inside an asteroid. Harvesting its remains could prove valuable to us.

entries.en: This leader was trapped for some time in the digestive system of a spaceborne Cutholoid. While no longer whole of body, they have gained some unique insight into molecular Biology.

entries.en: An advanced machine that can compress space in a manner that can be restored at a later time. Its makers used it to imprison beings far too powerful to be subdued. While it can no longer accept inputs, it has many secrets left to share.

entries.en: This self-replicating material fortifies the chemical bonds of any metal it comes in contact with. Integrating flowmetal into our assembly process can greatly enhance large-scale machine production.

entries.en: A machine capable of converting synthesized crystals into an extremely potent performance-enhancing drug. In its purest form, the resulting chemical is biologically volatile and can cause multiple organ system failure in a small percentage of its users.

entries.en: An engineered gemstone that shifts in color and chemical composition based on its surroundings. When placed next to any object, it mimics elements of its material and allows us to better understand the subject's molecular composition.

entries.zh: 一种高放射性石头，会产生危险的磁力波。它有可能彻底改变我们对场操控的理解，但它释放的能量几乎无法控制。
entries.en: A highly radioactive stone which creates dangerous waves of magnetic force. It has the potential to revolutionize our understanding of field manipulation, but the energy it emits is almost impossible to contain.

entries.zh: 这把槌柄上刻着古代三巨头智者的名字，他们曾统治着一个如今已消亡的星系。虽然它对于我们任何人都过于庞大，无法握持，但它仅仅存在就足以让人敬畏。
entries.en: Inscribed on the handle of this gavel are the names of an ancient triumvirate of minds which governed a now dead galaxy. Though it is far too large for any of our kind to wield, its mere presence evokes no small amount of awe.
