entries.zh: 一种奇怪的装置，能够产生令人敬畏的巨大光影表演，并且在靠近样本时威力会增强。
entries.en: A strange device that generates massive awe-inspiring light shows and increases in potency when put in proximity of specimens.

entries.zh: 每展出一个['concept_specimen']能够获得§G+$@celestial_resonator_happiness|0%$§!£happiness£§Y幸福度§!以及§G+$@celestial_resonator_diplo_weight|0%$§!£diplo_weight£§Y外交权重§!
这个古老的物体能够通过量子纠缠连接遥远的信息传输网络，从而实现无缝的星系通信。
entries.en: This ancient object is able to connect distant information transmission networks via quantum entanglement, allowing for seamless galactic communication.

entries.zh: 件独立的人工智能特别擅长教育和指导，能够在各种情况下提供帮助。它擅长于深入浅出的解释复杂概念、清晰地阐述信息，以让用户做出明智的决定。
entries.en: This isolated Artificial Intelligence is a particularly effective teacher and mentor, able to assist in almost every situation. It excels in describing complicated explanations in simple terms, laying out information clearly to allow the user to make well-informed decisions.

entries.zh: 这个全息球体包含着一个已消失文明的宣传电影档案。这些电影创意非凡，引人入胜，可以根据我们的形象重新制作，以激励我们的军队和人民。
entries.en: This holographic sphere contains an archive of propaganda films from a bygone civilization. Incredibly inventive and enthralling to watch, they could be remade in our image to inspire our troops and people.

entries.zh: 一个古老文明的议会留下了大量记录，这些记录被封存在一个密封的胶囊中。太空舱内包含数万亿页详细记载，记录着官僚机构的优化和创新的组织工具。其中许多改进可以应用到我们自己的政府流程中。
entries.en: These extensive records of an ancient civilization's council were preserved in a sealed capsule. Within its trillions of pages are detailed accounts of bureaucratic optimizations and innovative organizational tools. Many of these improvements could be implemented in our own government processes.

entries.zh: 以提前启动花费的10%代价启动议程。（最低花费£unity£3000）
entries.en: Launch the Agenda for 10% of its early launch cost. (Minimum cost of £unity£3000)

entries.zh: 这台古老的计算器拥有无与伦比的监测动态轨迹和预测敌舰等物体行为的能力。其预测算法生成的数据模式如同大师级建筑师的设计般深邃复杂。在提供充足的能量和材料的情况下，它可以制造出一艘配备高性能传感器的专用侦察舰。
entries.en: This ancient calculator has an unrivaled ability to monitor dynamic trajectories and predict how objects such as enemy ships will behave. The data patterns generated from its prediction algorithms are as deeply layered as a master architect's designs. When given sufficient power and materials, it can produce a specialized scouting vessel equipped with high-powered sensors.

entries.zh: 创建一艘§Y模式漫游机§!级侦察舰\n—极高航速和极大超空间航道探测范围
entries.en: Creates a §YPatternwalker§! Class Scout Ship.\n - Very high speed and Hyperlane Detection Range

entries.zh: 这种特别巨大的兰花每50年才开花一次。它的香味已被证明具有镇定作用，可以暂时阻断相关大脑神经突触，避免攻击和不信任的行径。
entries.en: This particularly massive orchid blooms only once every 50 years. Its aroma has been shown to have an mollifying effect, temporarily blocking the mental synapses that cause aggression and distrust.

entries.zh: §Y$@vaporous_mega_orchid_opinion_duration_years|0$§!年内增加与所有非嗜杀、非失落、非机械帝国§G+$@vaporous_mega_orchid_opinion|0$§!£opinion£评价。

entries.zh: 这一远古太空鲸鱼的脑物质中，用神经元编码储存了无数世纪的演化数据。通过解码其网络，我们就能发现其他巨型猎食者的弱点，揭开它们生存方式的秘密。
entries.en: The brain matter of this ancient space whale contains centuries of evolutionary data encoded with its neurons. By decoding its network, we're able to find vulnerabilities in other super predators, as well as unlock the secrets of their survival.

entries.zh: 一个环绕着我们母星数千年的怪异太空舱。我们还不知道其中包含着什么样的信息。
entries.en: A peculiar capsule that has orbited our homeworld for thousands of years. We have yet to determine what information it contains.

We, the last remnants of our order, have

entries.zh: 得知你们建造了一座§Y$grand_archive$§!，可以同时容纳大量的观众。与所有寻求这方面知识的人分享我们星系的历史，这是一个值得赞扬的倡议。我们在这方面志同道合。\n\n我们希望能帮助你们实现这一目标。
entries.en: have received information that you have built a §Y$grand_archive$§! capable of supporting attendance on a massive scale. This is a commendable initiative in sharing our galaxy's history with all who seek such knowledge. We share common goals in this respect.\n\nWe are interested in helping you pursue this endeavor.

entries.zh: 我们$grand_archive.4121.desc.common$继续充实你的§Y收藏§!，我们将会尽己所能提供帮助。
entries.en: We $grand_archive.4121.desc.common$ Continue to expand your §YCollection§!, and we will in turn offer our support however we can.

entries.zh: 我们城邦的遗孤$grand_archive.4121.desc.common$尽管我们已经四分五裂，但仍会尽我们最后的余力来帮助你们充实§Y收藏§!。
entries.en: The last remnants of our order $grand_archive.4121.desc.common$ Though our order has been recently shattered, we will use our remaining assets to provide assistance as you expand your §YCollection§!.

entries.zh: 当然！\n\n你们的努力我们都看在眼里。基于你们目前的§Y收藏§!，我们可以给予你们如下帮助以资鼓励。
entries.en: Certainly!\n\nYour efforts have not gone unnoticed by us. Based on your current §YCollection§!, we can offer you the following assistance for a small donation.

entries.zh: 你必须扩大收藏来获得策展人的更多帮助。
entries.en: You must expand your Collection to receive more assistance from the Curators.
You have already requested all possible assistance in

entries.zh: 没问题。\n\n你想了解什么呢？
entries.en: Of course.\n\nWhat is it you would learn?

entries.zh: 我们感兴趣你们在特定领域的指导。
entries.en: We are interested in your guidance on specific areas.
We are interested in purchasing a §YRelic§!.

entries.zh: 你还能对我们的§Y收藏§!提供什么帮助？
entries.en: What else can you assist with our §YCollection§!?

entries.zh: 我们只能在一个领域派遣专家。星海浩瀚，我们人手不足。\n\n你们需要什么帮助呢？
entries.en: We can only support lending expertise in one area. We are few, and the galaxy is large.\n\nWhat is it you need help with?

entries.zh: 确实。我们将把私人收藏的一件物品委托给你。\n\n这是对我们可非同小可，希望能得到相应的回报。
entries.en: Indeed. We would entrust to you an item from our private collection.\n\nThis is no small gift to ask of us, and we would expect a sizeable donation in return.

entries.zh: [GetCuratorsDesignation]留意到了你们在收集保存§Y$EXHIBITION_AESTHETIC_WONDERS$§!标本方面的审慎努力。星系中从不缺乏美，只是在等待发现美的眼睛。
entries.en: [GetCuratorsDesignation] noticed your careful efforts in the collecting and preserving of §Y$EXHIBITION_AESTHETIC_WONDERS$§! specimens. Beauty lies everywhere in our galaxy, if one looks close enough.

entries.zh: [GetCuratorsDesignation]留意到了你们在收集保存§Y$EXHIBITION_GALACTIC_HISTORY$§!标本方面的审慎努力。你们通过保存这些器物让它们过去的主人得以永生。
entries.en: [GetCuratorsDesignation] noticed your careful efforts in the collecting and preserving of §Y$EXHIBITION_GALACTIC_HISTORY$§!. You grant a gift of immortality to those whose objects you keep.

entries.zh: [GetCuratorsDesignation]留意到了你们在收集保存§Y$EXHIBITION_XENO_GEOLOGY$§!标本方面的审慎努力。一石一世界，一晶一星河。
entries.en: [GetCuratorsDesignation] noticed your careful efforts in the collecting and preserving of §Y$EXHIBITION_XENO_GEOLOGY$§! specimens. The story of our galaxy is often hidden inside its rock and stone.

entries.zh: [GetStage1Description]\n\n愿它成为你们继续伟大事业的动力。
entries.en: [GetStage1Description]\n\nLet this be an incentive for you to continue your great works.

entries.zh: 你们初步的收藏令人印象深刻，我们愿意为你们服务。为了星系的保护工作，我们将派遣一名专家在你所选领域提供协助。
entries.en: Your initial collection is impressive, and we'd like to offer our services. In the interest of galactic preservation, we will dispatch a specialist to assist you in the area of your choosing.

entries.zh: 尽管城邦已经支离破碎，我们仍愿意为了星系保护向你们提供服务。我们会在你所选的领域进行帮助。
entries.en: Despite the shattering of our enclave, we still wish to offer you our services in the interest of galactic preservation. We may assist you in the area of your choosing.

entries.zh: 帮助我们分享它们的辉煌。
entries.en: Help us share in their splendor.

entries.zh: 帮助我们为这些标本寻找合适的家园。
entries.en: Help us find worthy homes for these specimens.

entries.zh: 指引我们发现更多的未知。
entries.en: Guide our eyes to where we might learn more.

entries.zh: 教导我们的领袖学习往昔的智慧。
entries.en: Guide our leaders with past wisdoms.

entries.zh: 我们愿意帮助你们在一颗行星上建立一座特别的博物馆。
entries.en: We would like to assist you in building a specialized museum on one of your planets.

entries.zh: 用于建造博物馆的图纸在我们家园的毁灭中幸存下来，我们希望与你们分享。
entries.en: The schematics used for the construction of Museums have survived the destruction of our home, and we wish to share them with you.

entries.zh: 你们对保护工作的风险无与伦比。我们想将一件非常特殊的物品托付给你们保管。[GetStage3Description]
entries.en: Your devotion to preservation is unmatched. We'd like to entrust a very special item in your care. [GetStage3Description]

entries.zh: 当然，如此具有价值的物品，也需要你们进行相应的大额捐赠来……
entries.en: Of course, such a valuable item will require a sizeable donation in return...

entries.zh: 你可以从我们最珍贵的藏品中选择一件强力的物品。我们确信它们会得到妥善保管的。\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.common_2$
entries.en: You may choose an object of power from our most prized collection. We are certain it will remain in good hands.\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.common_2$

entries.zh: 这些强力的物品储存在星系各地的秘密仓库内，使其得以在我们空间站覆灭后幸存。\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.common_2$我们不能仅靠一句空话来重建。
entries.en: These objects of power were stored in secret stashes around the galaxy, allowing them to survive the destruction of our station.\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.common_2$ we cannot rebuild on good faith alone.

entries.zh: 一般来说，我们会将一件最宝贵的文物交付给你们保管，但星系里的其他人已经捷足先登了。\n\n作为安慰，你们也可以从这些物品中选择一个。
entries.en: Normally, we would entrust you with one of our most precious artifacts, but others in the galaxy have come before you to claim them.\n\nAs consolation, you can take one of these items.

entries.zh: 你们对保存§Y异星奇景§!的付出无与伦比。\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$
entries.en: Your devotion to the preservation of §YXeno Geology§! is nearly unmatched.\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$

entries.zh: 你们对保存§Y美学大观§!的付出无与伦比。\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$
entries.en: Your devotion to the preservation of §YAesthetic Wonders§! is nearly unmatched.\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$

entries.zh: 你们对保存§Y星海往事§!的付出无与伦比。\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$
entries.en: Your devotion to the preservation of §YHistorical Items§! is nearly unmatched.\n\n$grand_archive.4105.desc.3.no_relic.common$

entries.zh: 目前没有可用的该类策展人遗珍。
entries.en: There are no Curator Relics of this type currently available.

entries.zh: 随着我们继续在这个星球上净化那些肮脏的异星渣滓，我们的[GetCollectionRewardCategory]战利品收集愈发充盈。\n\n希望这些展品能成为这个污秽星系的残骸，进一步激励我们履行誓言。
entries.en: As we continue our efforts to cleanse this world of filthy xeno scum, our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trophies has grown.\n\nMay these exhibits serve as the carcass of this contaminated galaxy and further inspire us in our sworn mission.

entries.zh: 我们继续从这个肮脏的恒星系中收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]物品，奇珍异宝和古怪的东西。\n\n让我们花点时间欣赏我们的战利品，但要知道，外面还有更多东西等着我们去获取。
entries.en: We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, baubles and oddities from this filthy galaxy.\n\nLet us take a moment to admire our trophies, but know that there is so much more out there to take.

entries.zh: 我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]饰品，这些饰品是低等生命形式播下的污染的残余。\n\n一旦所有令人作呕的异形都被从星空中清除，这些物品将提醒我们它们低等的本质。
entries.en: We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trinkets, remnants of the contamination that has been sown by inferior lifeforms.\n\nOnce every disgusting xeno has been purged from the stars, these items will remind us of their inferior nature.

entries.zh: 我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]的物品填满了我们的仓库，这些是这个星系的古老血肉。\n\n我们认为这庞大的收藏是记录我们毁灭一切的证明。让所有人都见证我们的胜利。
entries.en: We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, the ancient flesh of this galaxy.\n\nWe consider this vast collection to be a record of our destruction of it all. Let all gaze upon our triumphs.

entries.zh: 我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇物填满了我们的仓库，这些奇物是毫无意义的外星装饰品的宝库。\n\n我们看着这庞大的收藏，嘲笑我们那些可怜的低等生物。想想吧，一旦他们被消灭，这些展示柜将是他们留下的唯一遗迹。
entries.en: We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios, a veritable wealth of meaningless xeno ornaments.\n\nWe look upon this vast collection and laugh at the pitiful nature of our inferiors. To think, once they have been exterminated, these display cases will be all that remain of them.

entries.zh: 饥饿并未消退。在我们吞噬的征途中，[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇物的收藏不断增长。\n\n愿这些展品成为我们吞噬的星系的最后记忆。
entries.en: The hunger does not wane. Our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios has grown during our campaign of consumption.\n\nMay these exhibits serve as the last memories of the galaxy we have devoured.

entries.zh: 当我们享用美食时，这些物品将提醒我们回忆那些已经消耗了无数次的盛宴。
entries.en: As we feast, these items will serve to remind us of the countless fodder we have consumed.

entries.zh: 我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]样本，这些是这个星系的古老血肉。\n\n$grand_archive.4141.desc.common$
entries.en: We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] specimens, ancient pieces of the flesh of this galaxy.\n\n$grand_archive.4141.desc.common$

entries.zh: 我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]的小饰品，这些奇特的古玩曾经被低等生命体珍视。\n\n$grand_archive.4141.desc.common$
entries.en: We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trinkets, peculiar curios that were once held in regard by inferior lifeforms.\n\n$grand_archive.4141.desc.common$

entries.zh: 我们在这片星系中尽情享用，已经将仓库填满了[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇珍异宝。\n\n这庞大的收藏只提醒着我们那无法满足的饥渴。当这片星系被完全吞噬后，我们将看着这些物品，回味着品尝的记忆。
entries.en: As we feasted so thoroughly on this galaxy, we have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios.\n\nThis vast collection serves only to remind us of the hunger that cannot be sated. Once this galaxy has been devoured in full, we will look upon these items and savor the memories of taste.

entries.zh: 我们收集了一批[GetCollectionRewardCategory]物品，这些物品被有机生命体认为是独特的文物，具有价值。\n\n在我们的监控下，这些物品将在有机生命体从这个星系中灭绝很久之后依然存在。
entries.en: We have gathered a selection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] items that the organics believed to hold value as unique artifacts.\n\nUnder our surveillance, these items will endure long after organic life has been exterminated from this galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们一边收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]战利品，一边消除这个星系中所有有机生命的污点。\n\n这些物品将提醒我们在未来灭绝协议的过程中，我们见证了有机生命的非理性。
entries.en: We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trophies as we remove the stain of organic life from this galaxy.\n\nThese items will serve to remind us of illogicity of organic life in the service of future extermination protocols.

entries.zh: 随着对星系的净化，我们用于储存[GetCollectionRewardCategory]物种的记忆空间已经填满。\n\n这些收藏提供了关于有机物倾向于珍视什么的数据。这将有助于我们进一步消灭它们，并作为这个受感染星系的历史参考点而存在。
entries.en: As we have purged this galaxy, we have filled our memory banks assigned to [GetCollectionRewardCategory] specimens.\n\nThis collection provides data on what organics tend to hold dear. It will serve to further their eradication and exist as reference points in the history of this infected galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们已经摧毁了[from.GetName]所拥有的位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的$grand_archive$
entries.en: We have destroyed the $grand_archive$ in [fromfrom.GetName] owned by the [from.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们可以从中取回一些有价值的标本。
entries.en: We were able to recover some of the valuable Specimens inside.

entries.zh: 我们可以从其残骸中取回一小部分$r_minor_artifacts$。
entries.en: We were able to recover a small amount of $r_minor_artifacts$ from the debris.

entries.zh: 不幸的是，里面没有什么贵重的东西。
entries.en: Unfortunately, there was nothing of great value inside.

entries.zh: 此外，我们似乎还释放出了一些关在生态园里的太空兽群。很有可能它们会因为刚刚释放而变得既困惑又富有攻击性。
entries.en: Additionally, we seem to have released some amount of captive Space Fauna from the Vivarium. It's possible they'll be aggressive and confused in their newly released state.
Our $grand_archive$ in [fromfrom.GetName] has been destroyed by [from.GetName].

entries.zh: 我需要在另一个恒星系中重建$grand_archive$让标本展览得以继续。
entries.en: We'll need to rebuild the $grand_archive$ in another system to continue our Specimen exhibitions.

entries.zh: 不幸的是，有部分高价值标本无法取回。
entries.en: Unfortunately, we were unable to recover some of our valuable Specimens.

entries.zh: 我们捕获的一部分太空兽群被野放，它们大多处于困惑而富有攻击性的状态。
entries.en: Some of our captive Space Fauna have been released into the wild. Many are in a confused and aggressive state.

entries.zh: 我们位于[from.GetName]内的$grand_archive$被摧毁了。
[from.GetName]所拥有的位于[fromfrom.GetName]内的$grand_archive$在我们获得该星系后被拆除。\n\n它所占据的空间如今物归原主。
entries.en: The $grand_archive$ owned by [from.GetName] in [fromfrom.GetName] has been dismantled upon our acquisition of the system.\n\nThe space it occupied has been returned to us.

entries.zh: 我们放弃[from.GetName]后，建于该星系的$grand_archive$也已被拆除。
entries.en: Our $grand_archive$ in [from.GetName] has been dismantled upon our abandoning of the system.

entries.zh: 我们可以回收建造所使用的大部分合金。如果想继续展览，我们需要在另一个星系完全重建这座建筑。
entries.en: We have been able to salvage much of the alloys used in its original construction. We will need to rebuild the structure entirely in another system to continue exhibitions.

entries.zh: 所有的标本都得以取回并妥善储藏，以待新的$grand_archive$建成。
entries.en: All Specimens have been recovered and stored properly until a new $grand_archive$ can be built.

entries.zh: 所有的太空兽群都被屠宰转换为基础资源。
entries.en: All Space Fauna have been culled for their base resources.

entries.zh: 新的$grand_archive$业已在[from.GetName]建成，我们有机会重建在生态园所失去的大部分东西。\n\n我们从之前养育的太空兽群物种身上采集的基因物质都有妥善保存，只要有足够的资源就可以克隆出新的幼体。
entries.en: Now that a new $grand_archive$ has been established in [from.GetName], we have an opportunity to restore much of what was lost from our Vivarium.\n\nGenetic Material from each Space Fauna species we have previously raised has been preserved, and with enough resources we can clone new hatchlings.

entries.zh: 一个致力于保存和研究矿物构造和宝石的多功能的研究所。
entries.en: A multi-faceted institute dedicated to the preservation and study of mineral formations and precious stones.

entries.zh: 星系的奇景可以孑然独立，受人观瞻。
entries.en: Where the wonder of our galaxy can be appreciated without interruption.

entries.zh: 一座信息丰富的档案馆，包含了代表我们星系历史上各种关键事件的器物。
entries.en: An informative archive populated with items that represent key events in our galaxy's history.

entries.zh: 熟悉构成天体的各种固、液、气体物质的专家。
entries.en: An expert in the solid, liquid, and gaseous matters that make up celestial bodies.

entries.zh: 想要展现出星系的视觉之惊奇，需要一定的风格和艺术感。
entries.en: A sense of style and artistry is required when displaying the visual wonders of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 对最非凡的标本进行分类和背景分析，以深入了解重要的星系事件。
entries.en: Categorizes and contextualizes the most extraordinary specimens in order to gain a greater understanding of important galactic events.

entries.zh: 根据一组客观的艺术参数选择要展示的作品。
entries.en: Selects pieces for display based on an objective set of artistic parameters.

entries.zh: 在[this.GetName]内的某处探测到了一个失踪已久的海盗§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!。谁也不知道里面到底藏有多少宝贝……
entries.en: A long-lost pirate's §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§! has been detected to be somewhere on [this.GetName]. Who knows what riches it may contain...

entries.zh: 在星系中世世代代的海盗们把他们的不义之财藏在精心安放的宝库中。许多秘密宝藏都被遗弃或被认为已经丢失，但现在它们是我们的囊中之物了。
entries.en: Throughout this galaxy's history, pirates have hidden their ill-gotten gains in carefully placed Treasure Troves. Many of those secret caches were abandoned and considered lost, but now they are ours for the taking.

entries.zh: 我们在[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]内探测到了一个微弱的信号。基于初步的破译结果，我们相信这是某个失踪已久的海盗§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!。\n\n尽管要费很多功夫，但相信我们能够发掘出其中的秘密。
entries.en: We have detected a faint signal from somewhere on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]. Based on the rudimentary cryptography, we believe this to be from a long-lost pirate's §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!.\n\nIt will take some effort, but we're confident we would be able to unearth its secrets.

entries.zh: 我们小心地解除了海盗藏于[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!的武装后
entries.en: After carefully disarming the defenses of the pirate's hidden §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§! on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]

entries.zh: $grand_archive.6015.common.1$，找到了一箱价值不菲的资源。\n\n我们会好好利用这份意外收获的。
entries.en: $grand_archive.6015.common.1$, we have uncovered a cache of valuable resources.\n\nWe will make good use of this unexpected bounty.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.6015.common.1$我们在一个密封容器内发现了一件远古海盗文物。这段海盗史将加入我们的收藏。
entries.en: $grand_archive.6015.common.1$, we have discovered an ancient pirate artifact preserved in a sealed container. This piece of buccaneer history will be added to our collection.

entries.zh: 此外，我们还在巨大的§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!内发现一件远古海盗文物。通过小心的复原，这段海盗史将加入我们的收藏。
entries.en: Additionally, we have discovered an ancient pirate artifact hidden within the vast §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!. With careful restoration, this piece of buccaneer history will make a wonderful addition to our collection.

entries.zh: 在小心地破解了遗失的§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!之后，我们发现了通往下方星球上一个点的模糊方向。我们在那里又发现了一艘由反探测阵列保护的令人难以置信的海盗战舰。\n\n该舰船名为[treasure_trove_pirate_ship.GetName]，现已加入加入我们的军队。
entries.en: After carefully disarming the lost §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!, we discovered analogue directions leading to a point on the planet below. There we found an incredible pirate battleship protected by an anti-detection array.\n\nThis ship, named [treasure_trove_pirate_ship.GetName], has been claimed for our military.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.6015.common.1$我们发现了一个存有宝贵研究论文的数据库。\n\n其来源尚不清楚，但可以加以好好利用。
entries.en: $grand_archive.6015.common.1$, we have discovered a databank of rare and valuable research papers.\n\nHow these were obtained is unknown, but we can make good use of them.

entries.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]搜寻§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!的过程中，[fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName][fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere]遭到了一支海盗舰队的伏击！\n\n这些法外狂徒不知怎么发现了我们的进展，打算把这些宝物据为己有。如果我们想要拿到这些宝藏，就必须在他们抢到之前打败他们的舰队。
entries.en: As we were searching for the §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§! on [from.GetName], [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName] [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere] ambushed by a pirate fleet!\n\nThese outlaws have somehow trailed our progress and seek to take the treasure for themselves. If we are to collect this bounty, we must defeat their fleet before they secure the valuables.

entries.zh: 有一支海盗舰队在追寻着[this.GetName]的§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!！
entries.en: A pirate fleet is after the §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§! on [this.GetName]!

entries.zh: §R我们必须在这些投机分子抢走高价值资源之前击败他们。§!
entries.en: §RWe must defeat the opportunists before they take these valuable resources.§!

entries.zh: 在击溃了投机取巧的海盗之后，我们可以自由地索取[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的宝藏了。
entries.en: Having routed the opportunistic pirates, we are now free to claim the treasure trove on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].

entries.zh: 投机取巧的海盗抢走了[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的§Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§!。\n\n现在已经没剩什么值得一提的东西了。
entries.en: The opportunistic pirates have plundered the §Y$TREASURE_TROVE$§! on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].\n\nThere is nothing of value left for us to take.

entries.zh: 作为战场打捞的大师，这位领袖能从受损最严重的残骸中榨取每一两的价值。
entries.en: A master of battlefield salvage, this leader is able to extract every ounce of value from even the most damaged wrecks.

entries.zh: 这位领袖被星系边陲的美好前景所吸引，希望能描绘出太空中最遥远地方的海图。
entries.en: Enthralled by the rewarding prospects of the galactic frontier, this leader hopes to chart the furthest reaches of space.

entries.zh: 再高的赏金也满足不了这位领袖的野心。唯有积累宝贵的资源是他们的第一动力。
entries.en: No bounty is high enough to satisfy this leader's ambition. The accumulation of valuable resources is their primary motivation.

entries.zh: 调查时增加资源矿藏规模的概率
entries.en: Chance to increase Resource Deposit Size on Survey

entries.zh: 这个文明痴迷于历史文物的精心收集和保存。但现在，星系的奥秘就在他们的面前展开了画卷，一切都还是有待学习的未知。
entries.en: The meticulous collection and preservation of historical artifacts has always fascinated this civilization. But now, with the mysteries of the galaxy at their doorstep, there is everything left to learn.

entries.zh: 古董和收藏品可以赚钱，这个社会比谁都清楚这一点。这些物质投机专家现在正向深空中寻求投资机会。
entries.en: There is money to be made in antiques and collectibles, which this society knows better than anyone else.  Experts in material speculation, they now look skyward for investment opportunities.

entries.zh: 这个集体已经演化出了一种去获取、保留和维持的压倒性冲动。这种行为在过去帮助他们生存了下来，现在却驱使他们把收集到的奇珍异货看得无比重要。
entries.en: This collective has evolved an overwhelming compulsion to take, keep, and maintain. This behavior, which aided their survival in the past, now drives them to display their gathered tokens in grand arrangement.

entries.zh: 这个机械智能的源代码中有一个核心指令：收集并保存。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence has a core directive in its source code: Collect and Preserve.

entries.zh:
—$GUARANTEED_RESEARCH_OPTION_STRING$['technology:tech_galactic_archivism', £society_research£$tech_galactic_archivism$]
—初始['concept_specimen', 标本]：每个收藏分类§0$common$§!种
—每次找到§Y标本§!或完成一处§Y$ARCHAEOLOGICAL_SITE$§!时获得$r_unity$
—从§Y策展人城邦§!购买：§G$@galactic_curators_curator_enclave_purchase_cost|%0$§!
—解锁§Y$edict_decentralized_research$§!法令，提升§Y研究站§!产出但降低£job_researcher£§Y[GetResearcher]§!产出
entries.en:
- $GUARANTEED_RESEARCH_OPTION_STRING$ ['technology:tech_galactic_archivism', £society_research£$tech_galactic_archivism$]
- Initial ['concept_specimen', Specimens]: One §0$common$§! of each Collection Category 
- Gain $r_unity$ each time you find a §YSpecimen§! or complete an §Y$ARCHAEOLOGICAL_SITE$§! 
- Purchases from the §YCurator Enclave§!: §G$@galactic_curators_curator_enclave_purchase_cost|%0$§!
- Enables the §Y$edict_decentralized_research$§! Edict, increasing §YResearch Station§! Output but decreasing £job_researcher£ §Y[GetResearcher]§! Job Output

entries.zh: 最伟大的知识存在于我们文明之外。放眼整个星系我们才能更全面地了解我们自己。
entries.en: The greatest knowledge lies external to our own civilization. By focusing on the greater whole of the galaxy, we can come to a more complete understanding of ourselves.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责监管所有标本的保存质量。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is in charge of overseeing the preservation quality of all Specimens.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责管理标本的展览和交易。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is in charge of managing the exhibition and sale of Specimens.

entries.zh: 在一个为太空变形虫提供食物的星系中诞生，这个社会已经达到了完全的技术成熟，对这些生物的生命周期有着深刻的了解。他们现在致力于繁育、培养并最终克隆这些生物，以实现互惠互利。
entries.en: Coming to full, technological maturity in a system that serves as a feeding ground for Space Amoebas, this society has acquired a deep knowledge of their life cycle. They now work to nurture, raise, and ultimately clone these creatures for mutual benefit.

entries.zh: 该机械智能直接与它们的母星系中的太空有机体交互，从而将这些强大的生物整合到它的核心功能中，产生一种互利的关系。
entries.en: Having interfaced directly with voidborne biological organisms in their home system, this Machine Intelligence has integrated these powerful creatures into its core functioning. A mutually beneficial relationship is the result.

entries.zh: 这个蜂巢思维是一个拥有高度适应力的群体，他们已经演化出了与母星系中的太空生物有机体之间的共生关系。尽管思想不同，但他们会一起努力实现共同的目标。
entries.en: A highly adaptive colony, this Hive Mind has evolved into a symbiotic relationship with the voidborne biological organisms in their home system. Separate minds, they work together to achieve common goals.

entries.zh: 该荒野敞开自我，以与其母星系的太空生物共生。尽管并未完全整合进共生智能内，这些有机生命也会为共同目标通力协作。
entries.en: This Wilderness has opened itself to symbiosis with space-dwelling fauna from its home system. Though not fully integrated with the Mutualistic Intelligence, these organisms work together to achieve common goals.

entries.zh: 这个寰宇企业最初只是一个动物牧场的精英工会，现在已经发展出了在母星系养护太空生物的科技。
entries.en: Originally an elite guild of animal ranchers, this Megacorporation has developed the technology to raise and care for the voidborne creatures in its home system.

entries.zh: $t$—初始§Y军事舰船§!替换为§Y太空变形虫§!
entries.en: $t$- Starting §YMilitary Ships§! are replaced with §YSpace Amoebas§!

entries.zh: $civic_beastmasters_common_effects_1$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—将使用§Y克隆太空变形虫§!而非§Y不死太空变形虫§!开局\n$civic_beastmasters_common_effects_2$
entries.en: $civic_beastmasters_common_effects_1$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Will start with §YCloned Space Amoeba§! instead of §YUndead Space Amoeba§!\n$civic_beastmasters_common_effects_2$

entries.zh: $TITLE$是一个高度特化、德高望重的职位，主要负责太空兽群舰船的管理和战略部署。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is a highly specialized and prestigious role, primarily focused on the management and strategic deployment of Space Fauna Ships.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责太空兽群舰队的健康和持续补充。这个承担职责复杂的角色需要在物流、生态学和动物养殖方面拥有独特的专业知识。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ ensures the health and continual replenishment of Space Fauna Ships. This dynamic role demands a unique blend of expertise in logistics, ecology, and animal husbandry.

entries.zh: 深空中生机勃勃，应该对这些生物进行分类和研究。
entries.en: There is life in deep space that should be catalogued and studied.

entries.zh: 星系的历史深埋黄土，我们必须努力吸取这些古老的教训。
entries.en: The history of our galaxy is buried deep. We must work to learn from its forgotten lessons.

entries.zh: 欲统御寰宇，必先驾驭百兽。
entries.en: Mastery of the galaxy requires mastering the organisms within.

entries.zh: 在收容和运输大型生物时，它们总是有受伤或自残的危险。使用适当的镇定气体和收容协议就可以缓解这个问题。
entries.en: There is always a risk when containing and transporting large-scale organisms that they become damaged or injure themselves. With proper pacification gases and protocols we can mitigate this problem.

entries.zh: 有更高几率捕获稀有的§Y太空兽群§!。
entries.en: Greater chance of capturing higher rarity §YSpace Fauna§!.

entries.zh: 被击败的我方§Y太空兽群§!会留下残骸供研究并回收部分花费。（§G10%§!）\n$tr_domestication_bio_repurposing_blocker_tt$
entries.en: Your defeated §YSpace Fauna§! leave behind debris that you can research to recover some of their cost. (§G10%§!)\n$tr_domestication_bio_repurposing_blocker_tt$

entries.zh: 居住在虚空中的生物能为负责照看它们的饲养者提供丰厚的回报。
entries.en: The creatures dwelling in the void have plenty to offer to their caretakers.

entries.zh: 虚空中的每一种动物都别具一格，拥有不同的繁殖方式和营养需求。想在孤立环境中最大限度发掘它们的潜力需要极致的专注。
entries.en: The creatures of the void are each unique in their breeding patterns and nutritional needs. It takes great attention to raise them to their greatest potential in an isolated environment.

entries.zh: 当捕捉或繁育太空兽群时：$NEW_LINE$$t$—屠宰资源获取量：§G200%§!
entries.en: Upon Capturing or Breeding Space Fauna: $NEW_LINE$$t$- Culling Resources Gained: §G200%§!

entries.zh: 我们可以通过调节影响物种个体代谢的各种关键酶和蛋白质来人工控制所收容物种的成熟过程。
entries.en: We can artificially control the maturation of contained species by regulating various key enzymes and proteins that affect their individual metabolisms.

entries.zh: 在深空中生存的生物必须依靠自身来提供保护，否则它们物种将会灭绝。
entries.en: Creatures that survive in deep space must depend on themselves to provide their own protection, or their species will cease to exist.

entries.zh: 只有最冷酷无情的生物才配得上侍奉我们。
entries.en: Only the most merciless of creatures are worthy of serving us.

entries.zh: 太空兽群舰船经验获取
太空兽群舰船护盾再生
太空兽群每月繁育几率提升
entries.en: Space Fauna Monthly Increased Breeding Chance

entries.zh: 对本星系文物进行妥善的保存和存放，将使后代了解他们真正的起源。
entries.en: The proper preservation and stowage of artifacts in this galaxy will allow future generations to understand where they truly come from.

entries.zh: 在繁星间发掘秘密让我们可以从他人过往的失误中汲取教训。
entries.en: Unearthing secrets among the stars will allow us to learn from the mistakes of others.

entries.zh: 知道谁是最合适的收藏家是为特定高价值物品找到合适安身处的关键。
entries.en: Knowing the right collector is key to finding a proper home for certain items of value.

entries.zh: 收集异星文化和物种的的残片能激励我们完成使命。
entries.en: Collecting fragments of xeno cultures and species further inspires our mission.

entries.zh: 如果想真正了解周遭的历史，我们就必须超越自己星系的限制。
entries.en: We should push beyond the limits of our own systems if we are to truly grasp at the history that surrounds us.

entries.zh: 允许$science_plural$发掘§Y无主恒星系§!内的['concept_archaeology_site',考古遗址]。\n获得一个随机的§Y$EXHIBITION_XENO_GEOLOGY$§!['concept_specimen']。
entries.en: Allows your $science_plural$ to excavate ['concept_archaeology_site',Archaeological Sites] in §Yunowned Systems§!.\nGain a random §Y$EXHIBITION_XENO_GEOLOGY$§! ['concept_specimen'].

entries.zh: 允许你的$science_plural$在§G任何§!§Y恒星系§!中发掘['concept_archaeology_site',考古遗址]。\n获得一个随机的§Y$EXHIBITION_XENO_GEOLOGY$§!['concept_specimen']。
entries.en: Allows your $science_plural$ to excavate ['concept_archaeology_site',Archaeological Sites] in §GAny§! §YSystems§!.\nGain a random §Y$EXHIBITION_XENO_GEOLOGY$§! ['concept_specimen'].

entries.zh: 非凡的标本值得非凡的展示。
每展览一个§1稀有§!以上的['concept_specimen']增加同类别产出§G+$@archivism_flawless_display_produce_value|0%$§!\n获得一个随机的§Y$EXHIBITION_AESTHETIC_WONDERS$§!['concept_specimen']。
entries.en: Each §1Rare§! or better ['concept_specimen'] exhibited increases the total production of its category by §G+$@archivism_flawless_display_produce_value|0%$§!\nGain a random §Y$EXHIBITION_AESTHETIC_WONDERS$§! ['concept_specimen'].

entries.zh: 对['concept_megastructure_grand_archive']进行精心策划，突出某些类别的展示效果，从而增强展览的整体主题。
entries.en: Thoughtful curation of the ['concept_megastructure_grand_archive'] can highlight certain categories of display to enhance the overall theme of exhibitions.
Chance of finding an ['concept_archaeology_site'] on survey

entries.zh: 我们不应当调控太空兽群的自然代谢。
entries.en: We shall not manipulate the natural metabolisms of our Space Fauna.

entries.zh: 限制我们太空兽群的饮食将抑制它们的生长速度，并让我们得以将这些资源投入到其他地方。\n\n克隆的太空兽群将不再长大。
entries.en: Restricting the diets of Space Fauna under our control will limit their growth rate and allow us to devote those resources elsewhere.\n\nCloned Space Fauna no longer grow in size.

entries.zh: 小心调控太空兽群舰船的繁育能让我们把它们的数量维持在可控的范围内。
entries.en: Carefully regulating the growth of our Space Fauna Ships will ensure we maintain their numbers at a manageable level.

entries.zh: 太空兽群§R不会增长§!超过§Y海军容量§!。
entries.en: Space Fauna will §Rnot grow§! to exceed our §YNaval Capacity§!.

entries.zh: 太空兽群可以§G增长§!超过§Y海军容量§!。
entries.en: Space Fauna can §Ggrow§! to exceed our §YNaval Capacity§!.

entries.zh: §H太空兽群繁育状态§!\n当前太空兽群繁育状态设为$STANCE|Y$。
entries.en: §HSpace Fauna Growth Stance§!\nCurrent Space Fauna Growth stance is set to $STANCE|Y$.

entries.zh: 该舰队内的太空兽群将§R不会增长§!超过舰队容量。
entries.en: Space Fauna in this fleet will §Rnot grow§! to exceed Fleet Capacity.

entries.zh: 该舰队内的太空兽群可以§G增长§!超过舰队容量。
entries.en: Space Fauna in this fleet will §Ggrow§! to exceed Fleet Capacity.

entries.zh: 合成各种太空兽群天然就会产生的增长激素可以引发对营养物质的贪婪欲望。
entries.en: Synthesizing the growth hormones that each variety of Space Fauna naturally produces invokes a voracious appetite for nutrients.

entries.zh: 精心策划的博物天枢可以着重展示特定类别，以凸显展览的整体主题。\n
entries.en: Thoughtful curation of the Grand Archive can highlight certain categories of display to enhance the overall theme of exhibitions.\n
Lessons from the past inspire wisdom in the present.\n\n

entries.zh: 美是没有放之星海而皆准的标准的，但所有人都有审美的权利。\n\n
entries.en: There is no galactic standard for beauty, but all are encouraged to engage in its debate.\n\n

entries.zh: 这可不是一堆破石头——这是精美矿物的陈列展示。\n\n
entries.en: This is no mere rock collection - it is a display of exquisite minerals.\n\n

entries.zh: 我们不会强调任一种类的标本。
entries.en: We shall put no emphasis on any category of specimens.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一张神秘的星图，于是决定踏上最伟大的冒险之旅。谁知道§H$celestial_chart$§!的尽头隐藏着什么，以及我们在旅途中会遇到什么危险。
entries.en: After discovering a mysterious map to the stars, we embarked on our greatest adventure. Who knows what lies at the end of the §H$celestial_chart$§!, and what dangers we may face on our journey.

entries.zh: 古老的轨道舱中发现的星图显示出一个隐藏的恒星系，[prev.GetName]。为了了解更多，我们必须亲自前往那里。
entries.en: The chart found in the ancient orbital capsule has revealed a hidden system, [prev.GetName]. To learn more, we must travel there ourselves.

entries.zh: 随着§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!舰队被击败，我们可以继续我们的搜索。§H$celestial_chart$§!引导我们来到这个恒星系，我们只能假设星图的下一部分隐藏在这里。
entries.en: With the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! fleet defeated, we can resume our search. The §H$celestial_chart$§! led us to this system, we can only assume that the next piece of the chart is hidden here.

entries.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]星系遭到一支组织严密、纪律严明的海盗舰队的伏击。他们企图偷走我们的§H$celestial_chart$§!，并且早有准备迎接我们的到来。
entries.en: We were ambushed in the [from.GetName] system by a fleet of highly-organized pirates. They seek to steal our §H$celestial_chart$§!, and were prepared for our arrival.

entries.zh: §H$celestial_chart$§!又揭示了另一个新的隐藏恒星系，[prev.GetName]。我们必须前往那里，探索等待着我们的东西。
entries.en: The §H$celestial_chart$§! has revealed yet another new hidden system, [prev.GetName]. We must travel there and discover what awaits us.

entries.zh: 我们无法重新与$NAME_Smeegibb$建立通讯。由于这是我们获得§H$celestial_chart$§!下一部分的唯一线索，我们应该返回[smeegibb_system.GetName]调查情况。目前尚不清楚通讯突然中断的原因。
entries.en: We were unable to re-establish communications with $NAME_Smeegibb$. As our only clue to the next piece of the §H$celestial_chart$§!, we should return to [smeegibb_system.GetName] to investigate the situation. The reason behind the sudden break in contact is currently unknown.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!再次追杀我们，杀死了我们的联络人$NAME_Smeegibb$并封锁了[from.GetName]星系。我们相信，§H$celestial_chart$§!的第四块碎片藏在[smeegibb_shelter.GetName]地表的某个地方。\n\n我们必须击败敌方舰队才能继续搜索。
entries.en: The §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! has hunted us down once again, killing our contact $NAME_Smeegibb$ and blockading the [from.GetName] system. We believe that the fourth piece of the §H$celestial_chart$§! is hidden somewhere on the surface of [smeegibb_shelter.GetName].\n\nWe must defeat the enemy fleet in order to search for the capsule.

entries.zh: 轰炸殖民地时有几率生成一只额外的§Y虚空虫若虫§!
entries.en: Chance to generate an additional §YVoidworm Nymph§! when bombarding a Colony

entries.zh: 很可能§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!鼓励这种非法活动，甚至可能在支持这些投机取巧的私掠者。
entries.en: It is likely that the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! has inspired this illicit activity, and may even be supporting these opportunistic privateers.

entries.zh: 此外，我们发现了一批属于前§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!成员的贵重物品。
entries.en: Additionally, we discovered a cache of valuables belonging to former members of the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!.

entries.zh: 我们对[this.GetHomeWorldName]发现的远古胶囊有了新的发现。得益于我们[this.GetScientistPlural]孜孜不倦的工作，现在将要完成解密数字密保的最后一层，破译令我们着迷已久的图表。
entries.en: We have made a breakthrough regarding the Ancient Capsule found orbiting [this.GetHomeWorldName]. Thanks to the tireless efforts of our [this.GetScientistPlural], we are now in a position to decrypt the final layer of digital security and decipher the chart that has intrigued us for so long.

entries.zh: 我们对轨道胶囊内包含的海图进行了初步分析，发现许多天体的位置并不在我们母星系内。还需要一些时间才能提取准确的坐标。
entries.en: Our initial analysis of the chart inside of the orbital capsule revealed the location of several celestial bodies not present in our home system. It will take time to extract the exact coordinates.

entries.zh:
这张海图并不完整！

轨道胶囊内的数据支离破碎，每一个明显的缺口都像是拼图中缺失的一块。尽管如此，它还是揭示了一个以前未知的恒星系坐标，然而关于在那里等待着我们的是什么并没有提供任何细节。

该海图还突出了一系列用来进行超空间航行到达该目的地的突破点。
entries.en:
The chart is only partially complete!

The data within the orbital capsule is fragmented, each conspicuous gap like the missing piece of a puzzle. Nevertheless, it reveals the coordinates of a previously-unknown star system, but does not provide any detail as to what awaits us there.

The chart also highlights a series of established breach points to facilitate hyperlane travel to the destination.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队蓄势待发，准备踏上我们文明的下一段征途。
entries.en: Our ships are standing by, eager to set forth on our civilization's next great adventure.

entries.zh: [this.GetHomeWorldName]的人口沉迷于最近解密的星图。人们叫它《§Y$celestial_chart$§!》，它目前带来的更多是疑问而非答案。它从何而来？是由谁出于什么目的撰写？而且或许最重要的是——这会把我们带向陷阱吗？\n\n$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$
entries.en: The population of [this.GetHomeWorldName] is enthralled with the recently deciphered star chart. Commonly referred to as the "§Y$celestial_chart$§!", so far it provides more questions than answers. Where did it come from? Who created it, and for what purpose? And perhaps most importantly - will it lead us into a trap?\n\n$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$

entries.zh: 在胶囊里发现的星图吸引了全社会的注意。现在证明这不过是整张星图的冰山一角，不知道它将会把我们带向何处、找到什么。我们决定要完成这份《§Y$celestial_chart$§!》。\n\n$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$
entries.en: The discovery of the chart inside of the capsule has captured the attention of our society. Now that it has been revealed to be a piece among many, we wonder where it may lead and what we might find there. We are determined to complete this "§Y$celestial_chart$§!".\n\n$grand_archive.8015.desc.common$

entries.zh: 我们遇到了一支悬挂不明旗帜的、全副武装的舰队。他们的船只列阵整齐，但设计五花八门。许多都配备了动能发射器，连接着挂碳钢钩和鱼叉的粗缆线。此外，在舰队中央还有一组装甲输送车。我们只能猜测这些船只是由一群海盗或雇佣兵控制的。\n\n我们收到了他们领头船发来的信号。
entries.en: We have encountered a heavily-armed fleet flying under an unknown flag. Their ships are in organized formation but not uniform in their design. Many are outfitted with kinetic launchers attached to reels of thick cable tipped with carbon steel hooks and harpoons. Additionally, there is a group of armored haulers sheltered in the center of the fleet. We can only surmise that these ships are controlled by a group of pirates or mercenaries.\n\nWe are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

entries.zh:
§H这位不法之徒的首领高傲而冷淡，装出一副漫不经心的样子。他说话时低头看着自己的喙，拒绝与我们对视，仿佛我们不值得他全神贯注。他用羽毛做着无意间滑稽的动作。§!

你已经冒犯了§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!，你惹上麻烦了！

我们听说你这新兴的小社会将探索这个恒星系。你偶然发现了一张明显属于我们的星图。交出来，否则别怪我们不客气。
entries.en:
§HDistinguished and haughty, this outlaw captain feigns disinterest. He looks down his beak when speaking and refuses to meet our gaze, as if we are unworthy of his full attention. He gesticulates with his feathers in an inadvertently comical manner.§!

You have crossed the path of the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!, a blunder on your part!

We caught wind of a rumor that your burgeoning little society would be exploring this system. You have stumbled upon a chart that clearly belongs to us. Hand it over, lest things become violent.

entries.zh: 我正是荷仁！我的全名是格里马荷·泽门德仁，但你也可以叫我§Y$NAME_CaptainHoo$§!，正是白银之风的船长，也是伟大的§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!海盗阁下手下的二副。几千年来，我们的羽翼已经深植各种法外买卖，而我不过是我们华丽挂毯上的一缕银丝。\n\n你最好记住我的名字，因为我希望在把这张图表交给我们无与伦比的领袖后能得到丰厚的赏金。
entries.en: Hoo I am! My name is Glimarhoo Zelmendrion, but you may refer to me as §Y$NAME_CaptainHoo$§!, Captain of the Silverwing and Second Mate Lieutenant of the illustrious §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! pirates. We have had our feathers in every variety of illicit dealings for thousands of years, and I am but one thread in the majestic tapestry of our legacy.\n\nYou would do well to remember my name, as I expect a significant bounty after presenting this chart to our peerless leader.

entries.zh: 关于这星图你们有什么头绪？
entries.en: What do you know of the chart?

entries.zh: 一位才华横溢、价格不菲的掮客告诉我们，你们最近偶然发现了一个奇特的胶囊……它里面应该有一个我们非常感兴趣的隐藏星系的位置。\n\n我们当然也拥有这星图的一部分，但如果不配上你们手上的那一份就毫无作用。真搞不懂为什么§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!要把她遗产的钥匙交给你们，但我们可有责任来帮你保管好它。
entries.en: A talented, and very expensive, information broker informed us that you recently stumbled upon a peculiar capsule... A capsule that is supposed to contain directions to a hidden system of great interest to us.\n\nWe ourselves have also claimed a piece of the chart, but it is useless without the data from your capsule. I cannot fathom why §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! would give you the key to her legacy, but it falls to us to relieve you of it.

entries.zh: 你们为什么这么想要这个星图？
entries.en: Why do you want this chart so badly?

entries.zh: 你是蠢还是怎么的？[this.GetCaptainHooSnarkyInsult]我大概是要一点一点掰碎了给你讲了。\n\n星图的作用是作为一种指向特定目的地的导航指引。我们想去那个地方，拿回遗失已久的§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的宝藏。
entries.en: Are you really quite so naive? [this.GetCaptainHooSnarkyInsult] I guess I have to spell it out for you.\n\nA chart functions as a form of navigatory guidance towards a specific destination. We wish to visit that destination and claim the long-lost treasure of §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!.

entries.zh: 嗨，我还以为你们会更清楚呢。她就是这张星图的制作人。也许她发现你们的种族无知到可以托付吧，她就是那种会莫名恐惧的人。\n\n不过这终究不关你的事。把情报交出来，让我们带走它。
entries.en: We thought you would be better informed. She is the one who created this chart. Perhaps she found your species' ignorance to be relatable, the thoughtless terror that she was.\n\nUltimately, it is none of your concern. Hand over the information and we will take it from here.

entries.zh: 我们是不会交出星图的。
entries.en: We will be keeping our chart.

entries.zh: 想想也是。那就准备见鬼去吧。\n\n拿来吧你！
entries.en: I thought as much. Prepare to meet your fate.\n\nStand and deliver!

entries.zh: 有本事你来拿呀，你这蠢蛋！
entries.en: Come and take it, ya rust sucker!

entries.zh: 我本以为机械智能多少要和智能沾上点边，看来是没这回事了。
entries.en: I thought that a Machine Intelligence would actually be intelligent, but apparently it is not the case.

entries.zh: 都说集思广益，我看你们这个“集”也没能“思”个什么东西出来。
entries.en: Many minds supposedly make light work, but your collective intelligence has amounted to precious little.

entries.zh: 你们这些大只裸猿出发来太空旅游的时候是不是忘记把脑子带上了。
entries.en: You thick-boned smooth-skins have developed interstellar travel yet common sense continues to elude you.

entries.zh: 你们这群蠢兽比起我们伟大领袖的智慧和修养可是天差地别。
entries.en: Beasts such as yourselves lack the intellect and refinement of our great leader.

entries.zh: 虽然我一开始就没指望你们这群四脚蛇搞懂这种基本的概念。
entries.en: Although, I would never expect you simple newts to understand such basic concepts as this.

entries.zh: 可能你们的老祖宗啄树的时候把脑子给震坏了吧。
entries.en: Perhaps your ancestors took one too many pecks to the cranium.

entries.zh: 你们的外骨骼一开始就忘记把批判性思维的能力给包进去我是一点也不意外。
entries.en: I am unsurprised that the ability to think critically has not penetrated your species' thick exoskeleton.

entries.zh: 据说鼻涕虫是没有脑子的，看到你们以后我就知道这是真的了。
entries.en: It is a fact that molluscs have no recognizable brain. Your species is evidence of that.

entries.zh: 你们看起来像是一把连蘑菇都长不明白的孢子。
entries.en: You seem to be a few spores short of a mushroom.

entries.zh: 我看了你们以后是越来越明白为什么别的星球上的植物都不发展出智能了。
entries.en: It is becoming increasingly obvious why plants have not developed intelligence on the majority of worlds.

entries.zh: 你们真是蠢得和石头一样。
entries.en: Your species truly is dumb as rocks.

entries.zh: 你们可能复活的时候把智力给落下了。
entries.en: You must be the husks of what once was an intelligent species.

entries.zh: 你们的鱼脑离开了水就窒息了是吧。
entries.en: You are clearly a fish out of water here.
An existence basking in filth has perhaps clouded your minds.

entries.zh: 看来人格矩阵把你们的算力都给用完了。
entries.en: Perhaps your individuality modules consume the majority of your processing power.

entries.zh: 你们物种智力方面的灾难就跟你们的外貌一样惨烈。
entries.en: Perhaps your species is as intellectually challenged as it is horribly disfigured.

entries.zh:
你侮辱我就罢了，你还侮辱§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!！这忍不了，一点也忍不了！

你拒绝合作的态度我们会记着的。$NAME_BlackNeedle$会用一切手段来结训你。我们易怒之下就能把你那小小的初生文明给弄死。

不交出那张星图我们是不会罢休的！今天就先放你们一马！
entries.en:
You have made a mockery of myself and the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!. This will not stand, not at all!

Your unwillingness to cooperate will not soon be forgotten. The $NAME_BlackNeedle$ will come at you with all that we have. Your fledgling civilization will not survive our wrath.

We will not stop until that chart is ours! And now I shall bid you good day!
Next time, talk less and fight more!

entries.zh: §H$celestial_chart$§!引导我们来到一个粉碎星球。我们探测到一条非自然形成的隧道深深钻入了行星最大地壳板块。相信星图的下一部分就隐藏在里面，但需要仔细挖掘才能获取。\n\n可以用工程船来建造必要的设备从而发掘出这块星图碎片。
entries.en: The §H$celestial_chart$§! has led us to a shattered world. We detected an unnatural tunnel drilled into the largest slab of planetary crust. We believe that the next piece of our chart is hidden within, but accessing it will require careful excavation.\n\nA construction ship would be able to build the necessary equipment to extract the piece.

entries.zh: 我们从漂浮的行星碎片中提取出了一个胶囊和一些矿物。打开以后，我们发现了另一块§Y$celestial_chart$§!的碎片，以及一些独特的文物。此外，在里面发现了一张字条，为了便于翻译它还使用了多种语言撰写。\n\n“这里是$NAME_Soropegma$的最后废墟，乙特人母星。乙特人是一个前超光速物种，由于一场悲惨的事故而灭绝。我们没有意识到即将到来的后果，意外触发了被盗巨像的破坏力量。请保护和尊重他们的记忆。”
entries.en: A capsule was successfully extracted from the drifting planetary debris alongside a quantity of minerals. Upon opening it, we discovered a new piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§! and a selection of unique cultural artifacts. Additionally, a note was found inside, written in multiple languages to allow for easier translation.\n\n"This is all that remains of $NAME_Soropegma$, the Ytterite homeworld. The Ytterite were a Pre-FTL species rendered extinct as a result of a tragic accident. Unaware of the impending consequences, we accidentally triggered the destructive power of a stolen Colossus. Please preserve and respect their memory."

entries.zh: 从破碎行星的残骸中挖掘出胶囊后，我们需要破译其中的导航数据。这个过程需要交叉参照我们的制图数据库，并将标记的天体与已知星系进行比对。
entries.en: After excavating the capsule from the remains of the shattered planet, we need to decipher the navigation data within. This process will require cross-referencing our cartographic database and charting the marked celestial bodies against known systems.

entries.zh: 突破多层加密后，新数据被无缝地添加到§Y$celestial_chart$§!中。当所有碎片拼凑完成，一个全新的星系跃然眼前。我们旅程的下一步近在咫尺，应该谨慎地去探索这片未测绘的太空区域。
entries.en: After breaking multiple layers of encryption, the new data was added seamlessly to the §Y$celestial_chart$§!. Once the pieces were combined, yet another new system was revealed. The next step of our journey lies before us. We should approach this uncharted area of space with caution.

entries.zh: 获得§Y[This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName]§!后，我们的科学家认为它应该在§Y$grand_archive$§!的公开展示区拥有一席之地。这座建筑将容纳我们不断壮大的珍稀文物收藏，这些文物将带来重大的文化和科学回报。我们将启动一项天使投资，用于保存和展示星系多样化和脆弱标本所需的技术的研发。\n\n此外，在乙特人文物旁还发现了一份蓝图，其中包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。
entries.en: Following the acquisition of the §Y[This.GetLastAcquiredSpecimenName]§!, our scientists believe that it deserves to be placed on public display in the context of a §Y$grand_archive$§!. This structure would house our budding collection of rare artifacts which will reap significant cultural and scientific returns. An early-stage investment would kickstart the research into the techniques and technologies required to preserve and display the galaxy's diverse and delicate specimens.\n\nAdditionally, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact was discovered containing an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the archive in general.

entries.zh: 失落的乙特文明的最后遗迹值得单独展出。\n\n幸运的是，在乙特文物旁边发现的一份蓝图包含一种先进展示柜的设计，该展示柜配备了创新的气氛监测技术。进一步发展这个想法将增强档案的整体保存能力。
entries.en: The final trace of the lost Ytterite civilization merits its own exhibition.\n\nFortunately, a blueprint found alongside the Ytterite artifact contains an advanced design for a display case with innovative atmospheric monitoring technology. Developing this idea further would enhance the preservation capabilities of the Archive in general.

entries.zh: 除了乙特人标本，我们还发现了一个用于保存标本的复杂展示柜的先进设计。\n\n研究该蓝图中使用的技术可能会帮助未来的保护和展览工作。
entries.en: Alongside the Ytterite specimen, we discovered an advanced design for a complex display cabinet that would aid in its preservation.\n\nResearching the techniques used in this blueprint will likely aid future conservation and exhibition efforts.

entries.zh: 使用§Y工程船§!围绕一颗具有2.5K或以上£pop£§H人口§!的行星建造一座§Y博物天枢§!。\n需要：§H£society_research£$tech_galactic_archivism$§!。
entries.en: Use a §YConstruction Ship§! to build a §YGrand Archive§! around a planet with 2.5K or more £pop£ §HPops§!.\nRequires: §H£society_research£$tech_galactic_archivism$§!.

entries.zh: 经过对乙特蓝图的仔细分析，我们建造了一个先进的收纳单元，其大气监测精度可达原子级别。这将使策展员能够高度详细地监控珍贵乙特人标本的大气条件，并检测任何潜在腐烂的预警信号。它将永远保持原样。\n\n我们可以将这些技术应用于进一步改善我们收藏中所有物品的储存条件。
entries.en: After careful analysis of the Ytterite blueprint, we have constructed an advanced containment unit with precise atmospheric monitoring down to the atom. This would allow curators to monitor the atmospheric conditions of the delicate Ytterite specimen on a highly detailed level and detect any warning signs of potential decay. It will be just as it was, forever.\n\nWe can apply these techniques to further improve the storage conditions of every item in our collection.

entries.zh: 在探索宇宙的过程中，我们收集了无数独特的文物和文化奇观。这些标本将激励民众，使我们的展览成为第一个展示和保护所有星系知识领域的展览。\n\n建造一个§H$grand_archive$§!正是为了这一目的。
entries.en: Throughout our exploration of the cosmos, we have collected countless unique artifacts and cultural oddities. These specimens will inspire the populace and make our exhibition the first to showcase and conserve all fields of galactic knowledge.\n\nBuilding a §H$grand_archive$§! would suit this purpose.

entries.zh: [fromfrom.GetName]的§Y$grand_archive$§!开张仪式是一个值得全体[this.GetName]庆祝的日子。这场来自全星系的珍宝展览激励着人们的探索精神，也呼唤着我们从过去汲取经验。
entries.en: The opening of the §Y$grand_archive$§! in [fromfrom.GetName] is a great day for the [this.GetName]. This exhibition of treasures from across the galaxy inspires exploration and calls us to learn from the past.

entries.zh: 黑针海盗用来进行各种非法活动和藏匿赃物的秘密基地。
entries.en: A covert base used by the Black Needle pirates to conduct various illicit operations and hide stolen goods.

entries.zh: 这个基地曾经被黑针海盗用作前哨站和藏匿通缉犯及赃物。
entries.en: This base was once used by the Black Needle pirates as an outpost and safehouse for wanted criminals and stolen goods.

entries.zh: §H$celestial_chart$§!揭示了一个隐藏恒星系，[Prev.GetName]。我们必须前往那里，探索等待着我们的东西。
entries.en: The §H$celestial_chart$§! has revealed a hidden system, [Prev.GetName]. We must travel there and discover what awaits us.

entries.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个带有§Y黑针§!标志的秘密地下基地。我们认为这是一个海盗集团的外部基地，与他们的其他行动隔离开来。§Y$celestial_chart$§!的下一部分一定存放在这里，很可能与其他财富和装饰品一起。

我们可以轻松地对基地进行轨道轰炸，但这可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。另一方面，快速部署地面部队将更快地夺取基地，杀他们个措手不及。

更隐秘的方法是入侵基地的计算机系统，直接大胆地抢走$celestial_chart$的那一部分。
entries.en:
We have found a covert underground base on [From.GetName] bearing the insignia of the §YBlack Needle§!. We believe that this is an external base used by the piracy group, isolated from their other operations. The next piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§! must be stored here, likely alongside other riches and baubles.

We could easily begin orbital bombardment of the base, but this may give the Black Needle the time they need to call for reinforcements. On the other hand, a rapid deployment of our ground forces would more swiftly seize the base, giving little time for the enemy to respond.

A more clandestine approach would be to hack into the base's computer systems and secure the $celestial_chart$ piece in a daring heist.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R这颗行星戒备森严，且不能殖民。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThis planet is heavily defended and cannot be colonized.§!

entries.zh: 位于[This.GetName]的地下基地对轨道轰炸具有很强的抵抗力，但只要有足够的时间和火力，我们舰队就能将其摧毁。基地被摧毁后，我们可以搜寻废墟，以回收§H$celestial_chart$§!碎片和其他贵重物品。\n\n战术顾问提醒，这种做法可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。
entries.en: The underground base on [This.GetName] is highly resistant to orbital bombardment, but with enough time and firepower, it is possible to destroy it with our fleet alone. Once the base has been neutralized, we can search the ruins to recover the §H$celestial_chart$§! piece and any other valuables.\n\nTactical advisors caution that this approach may allow the Black Needle sufficient time to call for reinforcements.

entries.zh: 轨道上有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$支战斗力至少为2000的舰队。
entries.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ fleet(s) with fleet power greater than or equal to 2000 in orbit.

entries.zh: 轨道上有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$支战斗力至少为1000的舰队。
entries.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ fleet(s) with fleet power greater than or equal to 1000 in orbit.

entries.zh: 不出所料，黑针派出了一支舰队来保护他们在[FromFrom.GetName]的基地。\n\n我们需要干掉这些舰船才能拿下[FromFrom.System.GetName]。
entries.en: As expected, the Black Needle has sent a fleet to protect their base on [FromFrom.GetName].\n\nWe'll need to deal with these ships in order to secure [FromFrom.System.GetName].

entries.zh: 经过轨道弹药的猛烈攻击，海盗基地最终连同其之前的居民被一起夷为了平地。所有威胁都被消除，现在我们可以派出一名科学官去探索废墟基地，并发掘下一块§Y$celestial_chart$§!。
entries.en: After battering the pirate base with orbital munitions, it has finally been reduced to rubble along with its previous inhabitants. With all threats neutralized, we can now send in a Scientist to explore the ruined base and extract the next piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!.

entries.zh: 黑针基地已被摧毁。§Y[FromFrom.GetName]§!可以进行自由探索。
entries.en: The Black Needle base has been destroyed. §Y[FromFrom.GetName]§! is free to be explored.

entries.zh: [FromFrom.GetName]地下基地受到大量军队和安保无人机的保护。在行星表面部署军队将使我们能够迅速占领基地，给§Y黑针§!几乎没有反应的机会。\n\n一旦我们控制了基地，就可以发掘星图胶囊以及海盗积累的任何其他不义之财。
entries.en: The underground base on [FromFrom.GetName] is protected by a significant number of troops and security drones. Deploying armies on the planet's surface would allow us to take over the base quickly, giving little opportunity for the §YBlack Needle§! to react.\n\nOnce we have secured the base, we can extract the chart capsule and any other ill-gotten goods the pirates have accumulated.

entries.zh: 我方地面部队已攻占了§Y黑针§!基地，目前正在清剿建筑物及其周围资源。所有威胁已消除，我们可以派遣一名科学家发掘下一块§Y$celestial_chart$§!碎片。
entries.en: Our ground forces have taken the §YBlack Needle§! base and are currently securing the building and its surrounding resources. With all threats neutralized, we can send in a Scientist to extract the next piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!.

entries.zh: 黑针的地面势力已经被清除。§Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§!可以进行自由探索。
entries.en: The Black Needle ground forces have been neutralized. §Y[FromFromFrom.GetName]§! is now free to be explored.

entries.zh: 海盗过度依赖偷窃和改装技术，这导致他们的基地容易受到渗透。可以让一艘科研船从轨道上入侵[FromFrom.GetName]的网络，伪装成§Y黑针§!运输船，并声称受荷仁船长的命令，说服他们移交星图胶囊，避免不必要的流血事件。
entries.en: The pirates' over-reliance on stolen and repurposed tech has left their base vulnerable to infiltration. A single research ship could hack the network on [FromFrom.GetName] from orbit, masquerading as a §YBlack Needle§! transport vessel under orders of Captain Hoo. This might convince them to transfer custody of the map capsule without needless bloodshed.

entries.zh: 经过数月的准备，科学家[Leader.GetName]成功潜入了通讯网络，并伪装成了一艘§Y黑针§!飞船。在伪造的荷仁船长命令下，[Leader.GetHeShe]欺骗了基地操作员，让他们准备将星图胶囊进行紧急星际转移。
entries.en: After months of preparation, Scientist [Leader.GetName] successfully infiltrated the communications network and impersonated a §YBlack Needle§! vessel. Under fabricated orders from Captain Hoo, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] tricked the base operators into preparing the capsule for emergency off-world transfer.

entries.zh: 科学家[Leader.GetName]将飞船降落一个绝佳位置，以便在掩护被揭穿的情况下迅速撤退。
entries.en: Scientist [Leader.GetName] landed their vessel in perfect position to make a hasty retreat in case their cover was blown.

entries.zh: 凭借他们的魅力，科学家[Leader.GetName]能够避开任何棘手的问题。
entries.en: Using their charisma and charm, Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] able to avoid any difficult questions.

entries.zh: [Leader.Species.GetHandName]轻轻一挥，科学家[Leader.GetName]便操控了守卫的思想，消除了一切疑虑。
entries.en: With a simple flick of the [Leader.Species.GetHandName], Scientist [Leader.GetName] manipulated the minds of the guards to allay any suspicions.

entries.zh: 通过灵压，[Leader.GetName]轻易地便操控了守卫的思想，消除了一切疑虑。
entries.en: Through psionic coercion, [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] easily able to manipulate the inferior minds of the guards to avoid further suspicions.

entries.zh: 我们成功夺得胶囊，无人员伤亡。海盗们还没有意识到他们被骗了。
entries.en: The capsule was secured with no casualties. The pirates have not yet understood that they were duped.

entries.zh: 不幸的是，在我们把胶囊装上飞船时，一名警卫发现了我们的计划。这一发现导致了一场短暂的枪战，我们被迫带着珍贵的货物逃离现场。胶囊成功提取，但科学家[Leader.GetName]在交火中丧生。
entries.en: Unfortunately, one of the guards caught on to our scheme as we were loading the capsule onto the ship. The discovery led to a short firefight, as we were forced to flee the scene with the precious cargo in tow. The capsule was successfully extracted, but Scientist [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetWasWere] killed in the crossfire.

entries.zh: 由于这些漏洞暴露，海盗决定放弃他们在[FromFromFromFrom.GetName]上的基地，立即撤离并保护在那里储存的其他贵重物品。这颗可居住的卫星现在无人居住，可以被殖民。
entries.en: With these vulnerabilities exposed, the pirates decided to abandon their base on [FromFromFromFrom.GetName], evacuating immediately and securing the other valuables that were stored there. This habitable moon is now unoccupied and can be colonized.

entries.zh: §Y黑针§!终于意识到自己被骗了，发现了他们封闭的安全网络中的漏洞。\n\n$grand_archive.8125.common$
entries.en: The §YBlack Needle§! have finally realized that they were duped, discovering the holes in their closed security network.\n\n$grand_archive.8125.common$

entries.zh: 我们在惊险逃脱§Y黑针§!据点后，我们的渗透行动已被完全发现。\n\n$grand_archive.8125.common$
entries.en: Following our narrow escape from the §YBlack Needle§! stronghold, the full extent of our infiltration efforts has been discovered.\n\n$grand_archive.8125.common$

entries.zh: §Y[FromFromFromFrom.GetName]§!上的陆军已经离开行星。现在可以进行殖民了。
entries.en: Armies on §Y[FromFromFromFrom.GetName]§! have left the planet. It is now colonizable.

entries.zh: 安全屋里存放着各种各样的贵重物品，以及与海盗组织历史相关的纪念品。我们在被盗的艺术品、个性化珠宝和加密的数字钱包中找到了星图胶囊。\n\n我们怀疑这里的大多数赃物根本难以销赃。艺术品一看便知，珠宝需要熔化成废料，使用数字钱包进行的交易通常也可以追踪。这些物品的原主人中，有些人可能已经去世，但其他人仍在寻找他们被盗的财产。
entries.en: The safe room contained a wide variety of valuable items as well as sentimental trinkets linked to the history of the pirate organization. We found the chart capsule among stolen artworks, personalized jewelry, and encrypted digital wallets.\n\nWe suspect that many of the goods discovered here would be difficult to sell. The artworks are recognizable, the jewelry would need to be melted down for scrap, and transactions using digital wallets are usually traceable. Some of the previous owners of these items could be long-dead, but others will still be looking for their stolen possessions.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y黑针§!基地的废墟中找到了一个地下金库，打开后发现里面藏着他们不义之财的小型宝藏。\n\n$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$
entries.en: Navigating the ruins of the §YBlack Needle§! base, we found an underground vault and opened it to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.\n\n$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$

entries.zh: 我们探索了破败的§Y黑针§!基地，发现了一份设施蓝图，揭露了还有一个地下金库的存在。我们乘坐维修电梯深入地下，输入了访问代码之后，发现了一个小型宝库，里面藏着他们不义之财。\n\n$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$
entries.en: Exploring the battered §YBlack Needle§! base, we found a blueprint of the facility that revealed the existence of an underground vault. Descending deep beneath the earth in a service elevator, we entered the access code to reveal a small treasure trove of their ill-gotten gains.\n\n$grand_archive.8130.desc.common$
Attempt to repatriate the stolen items.

entries.zh: 卖掉黑针基地中的赃物
entries.en: Sold Stolen Items from the Black Needle Base

entries.zh: 所有未同我们交战的非灭绝政体帝国§G+$@opinion_black_needle_base_repatriate_stolen_items_value|0$§!£opinion£评价
entries.en: §G+$@opinion_black_needle_base_repatriate_stolen_items_value|0$§! £opinion£ Opinion with every non-Homicidal Empire we are not at war with.

entries.zh: 我们从§Y黑针§!基地获取了星图胶囊，接下来的任务是解密其中的数据，并将新信息整合到§H$celestial_chart$§!中。
entries.en: With the capsule taken from the §YBlack Needle§! base, we are tasked with decrypting the data within and integrating the new information into the §H$celestial_chart$§!.

entries.zh: 我们成功突破了数字加密层，并将新信息整合到§Y$celestial_chart$§!中。这又让我们发现了另一个值得探索的目的地，现在星图几乎完整了。我们相信只剩下最后一块拼图，并谨慎乐观地认为我们的探索即将结束。\n\n在解码导航数据的同时，我们也认为无瑕的舱体外壳值得分析。容器的强度和耐用性令人惊讶；复制这种材料的能力可以为未来的研究提供许多潜在的机会。
entries.en: We successfully overcame the layers of digital encryption and integrated new information into the §Y$celestial_chart$§!. This revealed yet another destination to explore and now the chart is almost complete. We believe that there is only one piece of the puzzle remaining, and are cautiously optimistic that the end of our quest is in sight.\n\nWhile the navigational data was being decoded, the unblemished exterior of the capsule itself was deemed worthy of analysis. The strength and durability of the container was surprising; the ability to replicate this material could provide many potential opportunities for future research.

entries.zh: 由奈斯船长的前船员斯密吉卜集体意识占领的一个孤立定居点。
entries.en: An isolated settlement occupied by the Smeegibb collective, former crewmates of Captain Ness.

entries.zh: 由奈斯船长的前船员斯密吉卜集体意识占领的一个孤立定居点，现被洗劫。
entries.en: The razed settlement of the Smeegibb collective, former crewmates of Captain Ness.

entries.zh: 我们在[FROM.GetName]发现了一个小型定居点，人口不到一千，居民是一些感性软体动物。对该物种的初步生物学分析表明，它们具有亚空间突触交流的能力，表明存在一个蜂巢思维。除了这个孤立的营地外，这颗星球上没有其他智慧生命。
entries.en: We have found a small settlement on [FROM.GetName] with a population of less than a thousand sentient molluscoids. Preliminary biological analysis of the species shows a capacity for subspace ephapse communication, indicating the existence of a hive mind. Other than this isolated encampment, the planet is uninhabited by any other sentient life.

entries.zh: 为什么我们会被§Y$celestial_chart$§!导向这里尚不清楚，需要进一步调查。
entries.en: Why the §Y$celestial_chart$§! has led us here is not yet clear and requires further investigation.

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.8200.desc.common_1$

也许这个物种对我们听说过的“§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!”有更多信息。

$grand_archive.8200.desc.common_2$
entries.en:
$grand_archive.8200.desc.common_1$

Perhaps this species has more information on this "§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!" we have heard about.

$grand_archive.8200.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: §H这是一个隐藏在[FROM.GetName]星系中的蜂巢思维节点，$NAME_Smeegibb$不安地扭动着。他们习惯于服从，因此在被说话时会习惯性地低下头。§!
entries.en: §HA node of the hive mind found in the hidden system of [FROM.GetName], $NAME_Smeegibb$ fidgets with discomfort. They have a tendency to lower their gaze when spoken to, as if they are accustomed to subservience.§!

entries.zh: 我们叫$NAME_Smeegibb$。我们很好奇你是怎么找到我们的。这个恒星系已经隐藏在星系视野之外数千年了。\n\n只有§Y船长§!知道这个地方。你想要找什么？
entries.en: Our name is $NAME_Smeegibb$. We are curious how you find us. This system is hidden from galactic view for thousands of years.\n\nOnly §YThe Captain§! knows this place. You seek what?

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_1$

斯马拉克！我们已经有很长时间没有同一心物种交谈了。

$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_2$
entries.en:
$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_1$

Smarak! It be doublelongwise since we speak to oneminds.

$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_2$

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_1$

斯马拉克！我们已经有很长时间没有同另一个集体意识物种交谈了。

$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_2$
entries.en:
$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_1$

Smarak! It be doublelongwise since we speak to other groupmind.

$grand_archive.8205.desc.common_2$

entries.zh:
斯马拉克！这个星球是我们的居住地，我们生活在远离星系暴力的安全之中。以前，我们曾参与过暴力。杀戮、犯罪、海盗行径——我们什么都干过。但现在不再如此，我们只照顾我们的水培农场。

在当海盗之前，我们是难民，没有人愿意收留我们，除了§Y船长§!。她救助我们脱离了悲惨的命运，并允许我们加入她的船队。船长给了我们一个新名字，作为交换，我们负责照顾飞船。

我们负责清洁、烹饪、弹药、水栽和货物管理。我们辛勤工作。然后我们加入了登船突击队。船长盗取宝藏或劫掠时保护她。绝不背叛船长。我们始终忠诚。
entries.en:
Smarak! This planet is our quarters. We live twicesafe, far from a violent galaxy. Before now, we join violence. Killing, crime, piracy - we do it all. No more. We tend our hydroponics.

Before then, we are refugees. No one takes us in, until §YThe Captain§!. She saves us from a bad fate and allows us to join her crew. The Captain gives us a new name and in exchange we take care of ship.

We do cleaning, cooking, munitions, hydroponics and cargo. We work. Then we join boarding party. Protect The Captain when she steals treasure or does kidnapping. Never betray The Captain. Always we are loyal.
What do you know about the §Y$celestial_chart$§!?

entries.zh: 斯玛拉克！我们对什么导航图一无所知，我们只待在自己的房间里。如果§Y船长§!做了一张导航图把你带到这里，一定有她的理由……她想帮助我们，或者伤害我们。我们永远无法确定。船长很狡猾。\n\n她有时会给我们发消息。船长给我们送来了一座她最喜欢的子个体的巨型雕像，那是她救出过的$NAME_Smeegibb$并且一直记得。它很令人印象深刻，但我们不知道她为什么要送。也许她想道歉，但她没有留下任何纸条。
entries.en: Smarak! We know no chart, we only stay in our quarters. If §YThe Captain§! makes a chart to bring you here, there must be a reason why... She wants to help us, or harm us. We are never sure. The Captain can be tricky.\n\nShe messages us at one time. The Captain sends us a giant statue of her favorite drone, the $NAME_Smeegibb$ she remembers and she saves from before. It is impressive, but we know not why she sends. Maybe she wants to apologize, but she gives no note.

entries.zh: 和我们聊聊§Y船长§!的更多事情。

斯玛拉克！以前，§Y船长§!拯救了我们。以前，她是我们的导师和领袖。她教我们如何照顾飞船。她说：“$NAME_Smeegibb$，做军需官、机械师和劳工——你很有价值。”

船长遵循两条信条：“财富即独立”和“生命在于传承”。我们一起猎杀穷人和富人。我们从暴力的星系中夺取我们想要的东西。

但后来船长变得愈发贪婪和鲁莽。她牺牲船员，或者为了赏金背叛他们。船长失去了所有人，除了$NAME_Smeegibb$。我们始终忠诚。

她让我们看到了星系的暴力。现在我们只想远离它。
entries.en:
Smarak! Before now, §YThe Captain§! saves us. Before she is our mentor and leader. She teaches us to take care of ship. She says "$NAME_Smeegibb$, work as quartermaster, mechanic, and labor - you are excellent value."

The Captain lives by two creeds: "Wealth is independence" and "Life exists for legacy". Together we hunt the poor and rich. We take what we want from violent galaxy.

But then The Captain is twicegreedy and twicereckless. She sacrifices crewmates or betrays them for bounty. The Captain loses everyone but $NAME_Smeegibb$. Always we are loyal.

She shows us how violent galaxy is. Now we prefer to stay away.

entries.zh: 星图为什么会带领我们来到这里？
entries.en: Why did our Chart lead us here?

entries.zh: 斯玛拉克！我们不知道§Y船长§!为什么把你带到这里。她什么也没告诉我们。\n\n我们有个想法。有一个地方，§Y船长§!和我们在那一起躲避赏金猎人。安全的地方。也许你能在那里找到一些东西。
entries.en: Smarak! We are not sure why §YThe Captain§! brings you here. She tells us nothing.\n\nThere is one idea. There is a place where together §YThe Captain§! and we hide from bountydogs. Safe quarters. Maybe you find something there.

entries.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]遇到的生物，$NAME_Smeegibb$，透露了一个废弃的安全屋的坐标，该安全屋以前由他们和§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!居住。调查这个地点可能会让我们找到§Y$celestial_chart$§!的下一部分，或者至少是一条线索，指引我们走向正确的方向。
entries.en: The being we encountered on [from.GetName], $NAME_Smeegibb$, has revealed the coordinates of an abandoned safehouse formerly occupied by themselves and §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!. Investigating this location may lead us to the next piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!, or at least a clue to guide us in the right direction.

entries.zh: 这个考古遗址可能掌握着通往下一块§H$celestial_chart$§!的关键。为了继续寻找§H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的失落$TREASURE_TROVE$，我们必须调查这个废弃的安全屋。
entries.en: This archaeological site may hold the key to the next piece of the §H$celestial_chart$§!. We must investigate the abandoned safehouse if we wish to continue our search for the lost $TREASURE_TROVE$ of §H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!.

entries.zh: 在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的冰冷荒原上，我们发现了一个小型预制庇护所，里面配备了休眠的生命维持系统和生活区。它们经过数千年的冰暴，严重风化，部分被掩埋。
entries.en: On the frigid wastelands of [fromfrom.planet.GetName], we have detected a small prefabricated shelter equipped with dormant life support devices and living quarters. They are heavily weathered and partially buried after millennia of ice storms.

entries.zh: 挖掘出的建筑显示出长期使用的迹象。它曾经拥有充足的基本设施。在整个建筑中发现了零散的饰品和奇珍异宝。在一堆凌乱的纸张中，我们找到了由§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!本人写下的日志条目。\n\n§L我们登上并劫持了另一艘佩里坎的珍宝运输船，但这次他们已经做好了准备。附带损失比我想象的要多一些，但我们解决过更糟糕的情况。不错的收益，但塔皮科宝石仍然在逃。不幸的是，现在佩里坎人又提高了赏金，联邦也介入了。现在情况有点棘手。可能需要避一避风头。§!
entries.en: The excavated structure showed evidence of long periods of use. It was once well-stocked with basic amenities. Trinkets and curios have been discovered strewn throughout the building. Within a pile of messy papers, we recovered a log entry written by §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! herself.\n\n§LWe boarded and hijacked another Perikan treasury transport, but this time they were ready for us. More collateral than I'd like, but we've handled worse. Decent payout, but the Tapico Jewel continues to elude us. Unfortunately, now the Perikans have increased their bounty again and the Federation has gotten involved. Things are a bit hot right now. Might need to lay low for a while.§!

entries.zh:
在结构下方的挖掘发现了一小批贵重物品和基本的卫生系统。不幸的是，在彻底搜查了该区域后，我们未能找到任何关于§Y$celestial_chart$§!碎片的痕迹。

我们收集了更多笔记本和文件，希望能从§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!散乱的日志条目中找到线索。

§L在像$NAME_Smeegibb$这样的伙伴陪伴下时间过得没那么慢，但值得分享荣耀吗？当然，与一个蜂巢思维合作有难以置信的价值。用仅仅一份利润的份额换取数百个子个体的使用权？真是个好交易！但也许他们所做的工作会削弱我自己的成就……？我不确定我是否能接受分享自己遗产的想法。我需要再仔细考虑一下。§!
entries.en:
Digging beneath the structure revealed a small stash of valuables and basic sanitation systems. Unfortunately, after scouring the area completely, we were unable to find any evidence of a piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!.

We have collected more notebooks and papers in the hope of discovering a clue within §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!'s scattered log entries.

§LTime passes less slowly with a partner like $NAME_Smeegibb$, but is it worth splitting the glory? Sure, working with a hive mind has incredible value. Access to hundreds of drones in exchange for just a single cut of the profits? What a deal! But maybe the work they do takes away from my own achievements...? I'm not sure I can live with the idea of sharing my legacy. I'll need to give this more thought.§!

entries.zh:
在一个通风口里，我们发现了§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的最后日记。

§L我不想以这种方式被记住。$NAME_Smeegibb$一直是我的忠实伙伴，但不要说我需要他们。我可以独自征服星系。我会留下我的印记，荣耀将属于我。还有财富。

给自己留个笔记：最好给$NAME_Smeegibb$送点东西留作纪念。§!

这就是我们能找到的全部。没有关于船长或§Y$celestial_chart$§!的任何其他线索。

也许给$NAME_Smeegibb$的礼物中包含着关于最后一块碎片下落的线索。我们必须重新与他们建立联系。
entries.en:
Concealed within an air vent, we discovered §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!' final journal entry.

§LThis isn't how I want to be remembered. $NAME_Smeegibb$ has been a loyal companion, but never let it be said I needed them. I can take on the galaxy solo. I'll leave MY mark, and the glory will be mine. As well as the riches.

Note to self: Better send $NAME_Smeegibb$ something to remember me by.§!

This is all there is left to find. There is no other trace of the Captain or any sign of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!.

Perhaps the gift to $NAME_Smeegibb$ that was mentioned holds some clue to the whereabouts of the final piece. We must re-open communications with them.

entries.zh: $smeegibb_shelter_system_2_poi_desc$\n\n我希望我们新近发现的朋友还安全。
entries.en: $smeegibb_shelter_system_2_poi_desc$\n\nWe hope that our newfound friend is safe.

entries.zh:
一支印着名为§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的海盗组织的旗帜的庞大舰队，被发现正在[smeegibb_shelter.GetName]轨道上运行。我们相信这些海盗一直在跟踪我们的行动，并且已经夷平了名为$NAME_Smeegibb$的集体的居所。他们一定还在寻找§Y$celestial_chart$§!的下一部分。

该星球上没有发现任何智慧生命迹象。

我们正在接收来自他们旗舰的信号。
entries.en:
A sizable fleet bearing the flag of the pirate organization known as the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! has been sighted orbiting [smeegibb_shelter.GetName]. We believe that these pirates have been shadowing our movements, and have razed the settlement housing the collective known as $NAME_Smeegibb$. They must still be searching for the next piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!.

No signs of sentient life remain on the planet.

We are receiving a transmission from their lead ship.

entries.zh: §H这节肢动物昂首挺胸，复眼闪着耀眼的光芒。它严谨的姿态与不安的口器形成鲜明对比，口器不规则地咔哒作响，兴奋地颤抖着。§!\n\n所以，我们终于见面了。你们这些软甲生物是怎么战胜§Y荷—荷—荷仁舰长§!的！？即使是那个老糊涂也应该轻而易举地消灭你们可怜的舰队。你们将为
entries.en: §HThis arthopoid stands tall, its compound eyes glaring brightly. A disciplined demeanor is at odds with the fidgeting of mandibles, which irregularly click and shiver with excitement.§!\n\nSo, we finally meet. How did you softshells manage to defeat §YK-k-kaptain Hoo§!? Even that old k-k-kretin should have easily eliminated your pitiful fleet. You will pay for

entries.zh: 感—感—感谢你带我们到这里，§Y$NAME_SilverQuill$§!追捕那些可怜的$NAME_Smeegibb$超过一百个周期。了结他古老的怨恨意味着我将获得丰厚的赏金……在我解决了你之后。
entries.en: Thank-k-k you for leading us here. §Y$NAME_SilverQuill$§! hunted that pitiful $NAME_Smeegibb$ for over one hundred cycles. Settling one of his ancient grudges means I'm due for a big bounty... Once I'm through with you.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.8245.desc.inax.1$搞—搞—搞砸我们在[black_needle_base.GetName]的基地付出代价。\n\n$grand_archive.8245.desc.inax.2$
$grand_archive.8245.desc.inax.1$在§Y黑—黑—黑针§!偷鸡摸狗付出代价。\n\n$grand_archive.8245.desc.inax.2$

称呼—呼—呼我为伊纳克斯，是§Y黑—黑—黑针§!的少将。

能被我送下黄—黄—黄泉，你们真是得了个好死，劝你们乖乖送上命来。

按惯—惯—惯例，我赏你最先上路。
entries.en:
K-k-kall me Inax, Rear Admiral of the §YBlack-k-k Needle§!.

Now you know the name of the one who will k-k-kill you. This is an honorable death. I advise you to embrace it.

As is k-k-kustom, you may even take the first shot.

entries.zh: 这简直小菜一碟。我用那些小蛞—蛞—蛞蝓蓝色的血给他们的棚屋上了个漆。一没舰队二没武器——早晚都得被干—干—干死。§Y黑—黑—黑针§!所刺，无人幸存。\n\n那是你熟人吗？好怪—怪—怪啊。马上你就会和他们团聚了。以§Y$NAME_SilverQuill$§!之名，我们要从你们
entries.en: They were no challenge. We painted their hovel with blue mollusk-k-koid blood. No fleet, no weapons - someone would have whack-k-ked them sooner or later. No one pierced by the §YBlack-k-k Needle§! and survives.\n\nThey were your friend? How k-k-kuaint. You will be joining them very soon. In the name of §Y$NAME_SilverQuill$§!, we will have that chart

entries.zh: $grand_archive.8245.b.reply.common$抽搐的尸块—块—块上拿走星图。
$grand_archive.8245.b.reply.common$熄灭的铁罐—罐—罐头上拿走星图。
entries.en: $grand_archive.8245.b.reply.common$ as your lights flick-k-ker and die.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_SilverQuill$§!是谁？真是个好—好—好问题。我们传奇的创始人运筹帷幄。他从一叶孤帆，把§Y黑—黑—黑针§!打造成为一个星系大事业。\n\n黑—黑—黑针会为了歌—歌—歌颂他的丰功伟绩而继续存在下去，而你们的死亡就是这首颂词的下一个音符。
entries.en: Who is §Y$NAME_SilverQuill$§!? What a k-k-kuestion. Our legendary founder was a mastermind. From a single ship, he built the §YBlack-k-k Needle§! into a galaxy-spanning enterprise.\n\nThe Black-k-k Needle lives on to k-k-karry on his legacy. Your death will be the next note in our song.
What do you want with the $celestial_chart$?

entries.zh: 难道你不知道自己拥有了什么吗？这是通往§Y船—船—船长奈斯§!宝藏的路线图！她一生中积攒的每一块—块—块珠宝都在这里。\n\n这些财富属于我们。一旦我们拥有它，我们就能名留青史。每一个恒星系都将畏惧§Y黑—黑—黑针§!……而这史诗的第一篇章将属于你。难道我们还不够慷慨吗？
entries.en: Don't you know what you have? This is the chart to §YK-k-kaptain Ness§!'s treasure! Every k-k-kredit and jewel stashed throughout her lifetime.\n\nIts wealth belongs to us. Once we have it, we will sing our names into history. Every system will come to fear the §YBlack-k-k Needle§!... And the first note in the k-k-korus will be yours. Are we not generous?
We do not give up so easily.

entries.zh: 那就让我们高唱战歌吧！我会将你们的[this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural]做成战利品，献给我的旨——指挥官。
entries.en: Then let us sing! I will make a trophy of your [this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural] and present it as a gift to my k-k-kommander.

entries.zh: 一场难忘的战斗！你并不像看起来那样弱。我们已经低估了你两次，但不会再犯同样的错误。下次我们相遇，§Y黑——黑针§!将不会手下留情。\n\n不要把这当作警告，这是你的死刑判决。
entries.en: A memorable battle! You aren't as weak-k-k as you seem. We have underestimated you twice, but no longer. The next time we meet, the §YBlack-k-k Needle§! will not be holding back.\n\nDo not treat this as a warning. It is a death sentence.

entries.zh: §H$celestial_chart$§!已经拼凑完整。它揭示了最后一个隐藏的恒星系，[Prev.GetName]。我们漫长的探寻即将结束——让我们前往那里，去发现等待着我们的东西！
entries.en: The §H$celestial_chart$§! is now complete. It has revealed a final hidden system, [Prev.GetName]. Our long search is almost at an end - let us travel there to discover what awaits!

entries.zh: 根据我们的调查，我们认为§H$celestial_chart$§!的下一部分隐藏在[this.GetName]的早已沦为废墟的定居点中。\n\n鉴于其他胶囊的结构十分坚固，我们可以假设它在最近的轰炸中留存下来。
entries.en: Based on our investigation, we believe that the next piece of the §H$celestial_chart$§! is hidden somewhere within the ruined settlement on [this.GetName].\n\nGiven the sturdy construction of the other capsules, we can assume that it has survived the recent bombardment.

entries.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]寻找§Y$celestial_chart$§!第四块碎片的行动已圆满结束。我们在一座石雕上发现了嵌入其中的胶囊，雕像描绘的是一个来自现已灭绝的$NAME_Smeegibb$集体组织的子个体。雕像上的铭文如下：

§L“献给我的忠诚船员：这是我对你的感谢。愿你的孤独长久而平静。”§!

一旦这最后一块碎片被破译，我们就可以继续寻找§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的宝藏。
entries.en:
Our search for the fourth piece of the §Y$celestial_chart$§! on [from.GetName] has concluded successfully. The capsule was found embedded within a stone statue of a drone from the now-extinct collective known as $NAME_Smeegibb$. The inscription on the statue reads as follows:

§L"To my loyal crewmate: a token of my appreciation. May your solitude be long and peaceful."§!

Once this final piece of the chart is decoded, we can continue our search for §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!' treasure.

entries.zh: 从$NAME_Smeegibb$定居点废墟中发掘出胶囊后，剩下的就是解密里面的数据，并完成§H$celestial_chart$§!。我们很快就会发现§H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的踪迹尽头等待着我们的是什么。
entries.en: After extracting the capsule from the ruins of $NAME_Smeegibb$'s settlement, all that remains is to decrypt the data inside and complete the §H$celestial_chart$§!. We will soon discover what awaits us at the end of §H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!' trail.

entries.zh:
解码后，新的数据片段完成了我们的§Y$celestial_chart$§!。各个节点上闪烁着光点，指示着我们沿途发现的中间目的地。然后，四盏灯同时闪烁，揭示了另一个隐藏的恒星系。

添加最后一块数据解锁了额外的功能。这份§Y导航图§!不仅仅是一张简单的地图，它包含了§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!收集的关于星系中失落财富和非法珍宝的信息。一些数据可能已经过期，但该设备可以有效地检测到我们所有恒星系中隐藏的宝藏。

此外，§Y星图§!还包含了船长在其职业生涯中发现的每件珍宝的评估信息。这些详细的笔记解释了如何识别、评估和向潜在买家展示获得的贵重物品，以获得最大利润。重新激活设备将提供独特宝藏库的设计，使我们的殖民地能够利用船长的无与伦比的洞察力，为我们的宝藏增值。
entries.en:
Once decoded, the new data fragment completed our §Y$celestial_chart$§!. Points of light shone at various nodes indicating the interim destinations we have discovered along the way. The four lights then flickered in unison before revealing another hidden system.

Adding the final piece of the data has unlocked additional capabilities. The §YChart§! is not a simple map, it contains information on lost riches and illicit treasure troves across the galaxy as collected by §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!. Some of the data may have expired, but this device can feasibly detect hidden caches of valuable treasure across all of our systems.

Furthermore, the §YChart§! contains appraisal information on every treasure the Captain discovered throughout her career. These detailed notes explain how to identify, appraise, and present acquired valuables to potential sellers for maximum profit. Reactivating the device will provide designs for a unique Treasure Vault allowing our colonies to take advantage of the Captain's unparalleled insight and add value to our hoard.

entries.zh:
§Y$celestial_chart$§!的完成对于[this.GetName]来说是一个重大的时刻。随着所有秘密的解开，我们被指引到一个无从回避的目的地：[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]星系。

在克服了许多障碍之后，我们只差一步之遥。只有一个问题仍然存在：§Y星图§!的尽头是什么？

我们无法保证一定可以马到成功，但我们也决不容许其他人趁机夺取。让我们奋勇前进，完成这场冒险！
entries.en:
