The completion of the §Y$celestial_chart$§! is a momentous occasion for [this.GetName]. With all its secrets unlocked, we are pointed to one inescapable destination: the [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName] system.

After overcoming many obstacles, we are but one step away. Only one question remains: what lies at the end of the §YChart§!?

There is no guarantee of success, but we would not have it any other way. Let us strike forth to see this adventure through!

entries.zh: $TITLE$仔细分析着§Y$celestial_chart$§!，追踪隐藏的宝藏并评估珍贵文物。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ carefully analyzes the §Y$celestial_chart$§! to track down hidden caches and appraise valuable artifacts.

entries.zh: 随着[from.GetName]上的珍宝馆的建立，我们相信§Y$celestial_chart$§!有潜力为我们的经济做出重大贡献。
entries.en: With the establishment of the Treasure Vault on [from.GetName], we believe that the §Y$celestial_chart$§! has the potential to contribute significantly to our economy.

entries.zh: 随着我们不断地分配[from.GetName]上发现的$TREASURE_TROVE$中的资源，我们越来越明显地意识到，§Y$celestial_chart$§!有可能为我们的经济做出重大贡献。
entries.en: As we distribute the resources from the $TREASURE_TROVE$ discovered on [from.GetName], it has become clear that the §Y$celestial_chart$§! has the potential to contribute significantly to our economy.

entries.zh: 为了充分利用§Y星图§!的能力，我们设立了一个新的内阁职位，专门负责领导我们发现和收集宝藏的行动。
entries.en: In order to best take advantage of the §YChart§!'s capabilities, we have conceived a new Council position for an individual to lead our efforts in discovering and gathering treasure.

entries.zh: 为了充分利用§Y星图§!的能力，我们采取了措施，以增加资源分配，用于发现和收集宝藏。
entries.en: In order to best take advantage of the §YChart§!'s capabilities, we have taken measures to allow for increased resource allocation towards the discovery and gathering of treasure.

entries.zh: 这一定就是通往我们梦寐以求宝藏的那道星门。
entries.en: It must be this Gateway that will lead us to our long-sought treasure.

entries.zh: 地图将我们带到一个以前未探明的黑洞，以及一个被$NAME_Voidworms$寄生的恒星系。它们在附近一座废弃的星门安家，其中最大的几只像守护者一样绕着这处废弃的建筑盘旋。\n\n$grand_archive.8300.desc.common$如果我们要到达路线的终点，必须消灭$NAME_Voidworms$并修复星门。
entries.en: The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with $NAME_Voidworms$. Having taken up nest in a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.\n\n$grand_archive.8300.desc.common$ If we are to reach the trail's end, we must eliminate the $NAME_Voidworms$ and repair the Gate.

entries.zh: 地图将我们带到一个以前未探明到的黑洞，以及一个充满奇怪生物的恒星系。这些生物聚集在一个废弃星门的附近，其中最大的生物绕着这个废弃的结构盘旋，仿佛占领了此处。\n\n这些巨大的虫状生物不在我们关于太空兽群的数据库中。我们目前正在尝试建立通信。$grand_archive.8300.desc.common$如果我们要到达轨迹的尽头，我们必须处理这些生物并修复星门。
entries.en: The map has led us to a previously uncharted black hole, and a system infested with strange creatures. Having gathered around a derelict Gateway nearby, the largest of them circle the abandoned structure possessively.\n\nThese massive worm-like entities are not present in our databases of spaceborne fauna. We are currently attempting to establish communications. $grand_archive.8300.desc.common$ If we are to reach the trail's end, we must deal with these creatures and repair the Gate.

entries.zh: 什么都不能挡我们的道。
entries.en: Nothing will stand in our way.

entries.zh: 如果我们必须这样做的话。
我们按照§H$celestial_chart$§!指引，来到了[this.solar_system.GetName]星系中一个被虫群寄生的§H星门§!。必须先处理这些生物，才能重新激活星门，看看另一边有什么。
entries.en: We have followed the §H$celestial_chart$§! to an infested §HGateway§! in the [this.solar_system.GetName] system. These creatures must be dealt with before we can reactivate the Gate and see what is on the other side.

entries.zh: [this.solar_system.GetName]星系中虚空虫的尸骸显示出异常读数。我们的扫描仪似乎在一个垂垂死去的三头虫中探测到生命迹象。我们应该派遣一艘科研船去进一步调查。
entries.en: The remains of the Voidworms in [this.solar_system.GetName] are showing unusual readings. Our scanners seem to detect signs of life within one of decaying Troikas. We should send a Science Ship to investigate this further.

entries.zh: 在一具虚空虫的尸体中，发现了一群刚刚孵化的若虫。尽管它们的同类遭受了屠戮，但它们还是靠近了我们的飞船，并开始与我们的舰队并肩漂浮，以示恳求。\n\n$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$
entries.en: A clutch of nymphs were found nestled within one of the Voidworm carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.\n\n$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$

entries.zh: 在一具蛇形生物的残骸中，发现了一窝幼崽。尽管它们的同类遭受了损失，它们还是靠近了我们的飞船，并开始在我们的舰队旁边漂浮，以示臣服。\n\n$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$
entries.en: A clutch of younglings were found nestled within one of the serpentine carcasses. Despite the losses inflicted to their kin, they approached our vessels and began to drift alongside our fleet in supplication.\n\n$grand_archive.8310.desc.common$

entries.zh: 如果我们愿意，可以利用它们对我们的本能依恋：一旦成熟，这群太空生物将成为我们控制下的一支强大的有机舰队。
entries.en: If we so choose, we could use their instinctive attachment to our advantage: once matured, this clutch of spaceborne creatures could become an impressive organic fleet under our control.

entries.zh: 我们将获得一支§Y$@gateway_voidworm_nymph_reward_count|0$§2$epic$§!$voidworms_small_plural$组成的舰队§!。
entries.en: We will gain a fleet of §Y$@gateway_voidworm_nymph_reward_count|0$ §2$epic$§! $voidworms_small_plural$§!.

entries.zh: [FromFromFrom.System.GetName]的星门处于休眠状态。当接近这座古老的建筑时，§Y$celestial_chart$§!提供了一系列关于这项失落技术的知识。理解这种古老的交通方式可能会在其他冒险中证明有用。
entries.en: The Gateway in [FromFromFrom.System.GetName] is inactive. When approaching the ancient structure, the §Y$celestial_chart$§! provided a series of insights in this lost technology. Understanding this ancient method of transportation will likely prove useful in other ventures.

entries.zh: 一旦我们重新建立了系统之间的连接，地图就到此为止了。这张星图所隐藏的秘密很快就会揭晓。
entries.en: Once we have re-established the link between the systems, the map goes no further. Whatever secrets this chart holds will soon be revealed.

entries.zh: 研究完必要的技术之后，我们现在可以重新激活位于[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]的古老星门。\n\n$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$
entries.en: After researching the appropriate technology, we are now able to reactivate the ancient Gateway in [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName].\n\n$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$

entries.zh: 那些生物已处理完毕，现在只剩下重新激活位于[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]的古老星门。\n\n$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$
entries.en: With the creatures dealt with, all that remains is to reactivate the ancient Gateway in [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName].\n\n$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$

entries.zh: $NAME_Voidworms$已处理完毕，现在只剩下重新激活位于[gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName]的古老星门。\n\n$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$
entries.en: With the $NAME_Voidworms$ dealt with, all that remains is to reactivate the ancient Gateway in [gateway_to_ness_treasure_system.GetName].\n\n$grand_archive.8325.desc.common$

entries.zh: 作为§H$celestial_chart$§!上的最终目的地，[this.solar_system.GetName]中的休眠§H星门§!可能是通往某个非常重要的地点。
entries.en: As the final destination on the §H$celestial_chart$§!, the inactive §HGateway§! in [this.solar_system.GetName] likely leads to something of great importance.

entries.zh: 在激活了§Y$celestial_chart$§!路径终点处的星门后，我们发现了[ness_treasure_system.GetName]系统。天体的分布与我们在§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的航行日志中找到的草图相符。\n\n我们的漫长旅程即将结束。
entries.en: Having activated the Gateway at the end of the §Y$celestial_chart$§!, we have revealed the [ness_treasure_system.GetName] system. The distribution of celestial bodies matches sketches we found in §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!'s logbook.\n\nOur long journey is almost at an end.

entries.zh: 我们沿着§H$celestial_chart$§!指引的路线走到了尽头，一路击退了海盗和怪兽。现在，通往彼岸的通道已经开启，剩下的就是去探索星门那一头了。
entries.en: We have followed the §H$celestial_chart$§! to its end, fending off pirates and monstrous creatures. The Gateway is now active, all that remains is to discover what lies on the other side.

entries.zh:
我们被跟踪了。

现在，我们在[ness_treasure_system.GetName]遭遇了一支强大的§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!舰队。与我们上次遭遇相比，他们的队伍规模显著扩大，包括退役的军舰和改装了高级武器的民用船只。看来他们已经集结了大部分预备舰队来应对这次对抗。舰队中央是他们的旗舰，一艘巨大的$titan$级战舰。

虽然他们的编队已做好战斗准备，但大多数舰船尚未启动武器。看来他们打算谈判。

我们正在接收来自旗舰的通讯。
entries.en:
We were followed.

We are now confronted by an imposing §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! fleet in [ness_treasure_system.GetName]. In comparison to our last encounter, their ranks have swelled significantly to include decommissioned military ships and civilian vessels retrofitted with high-grade armaments. It appears that they have assembled the bulk of their reserve fleets for this confrontation. At the center of the fleet lies their flagship, a massive $titan$ class vessel.

While their formation is battle-ready, most ships have not yet primed their weapons. It seems they intend to negotiate.

We are receiving a transmission from the flagship.

entries.zh:
§H尽管身材矮小，这位海盗船长却散发着威严。他的眼睛在盘算着，仿佛在解一道复杂的方程式，将我们仔细评估。§!

终于见面了。$NAME_CobaltQuill$，§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!号船长，我们家族的荣耀，也是$NAME_SilverQuill$创始人的后裔，向您致敬！您多年来一直是我们的一根刺——但我还是讲道理的。我带着一个提议而来。

我们会为您的完整星图支付丰厚的赏金，并允许您带着你们无足轻重的性命离开。

如果您拒绝，我们将别无选择，只能强行夺取我们想要的东西。我们的海军实力占优，并且我们也渗透了您帝国的所有关键设施。只要我一声令下，您就会彻底崩溃。
entries.en:
§HDespite his small stature, this pirate captain emanates gravitas. His eyes are calculating, weighing us up as if part of a complex equation.§!

At last we finally meet. $NAME_CobaltQuill$ at your service; Captain of the illustrious §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! and humble descendant of our founder, $NAME_SilverQuill$. You have been a thorn in my side for a great many years - but I'm reasonable if nothing else. I come to you with an offer.

We will give you a significant bounty for your completed chart and allow you to leave with your meaningless lives intact.

If you refuse, we will have no choice but to take what we want by force. Our naval superiority notwithstanding, we have also infiltrated every place you hold dear. A single command of mine is all that keeps you from total ruin.

entries.zh: 尽管你造成了诸多困扰，但我愿意提供丰厚的赏金，以换取§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!完整的遗物。\n\n如果你接受这份慷慨的提议，我准备原谅你过去的所有过失。我们之间没有必要继续这场冲突。或者升级……
entries.en: Despite the frustrations you have caused, I am willing to provide a significant bounty in exchange for §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!'s completed relic.\n\nIf you accept this generous offer, I am prepared to forgive all past misdeeds. There is no need for this conflict between us to continue. Or escalate...

entries.zh: 关于[this.GetName]，我无所不知。你的供应链、资源库的位置、空间站的分布，一切都记录得清清楚楚。
entries.en: I know everything there is to know about [this.GetName]. Your supply chains, the location of your resource silos, the distribution of your stations: everything is meticulously accounted for.

entries.zh: 我的人已经进行了研究，我完全清楚如何瓦解你的帝国。我会让你的人民陷入饥荒，偷走你的补给，并摧毁剩余的一切。当然，这取决于你是否愿意给我想要的东西……
entries.en: My people have done the research, and I know exactly how to take you apart. I will starve your people, steal your supplies, and destroy whatever remains. That is, of course, unless you give me what I want...

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

我一直在关注你们领导层中的每一位值得信赖的个人，以及他们的亲人……

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$
entries.en:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

I have eyes on every trusted individual within your leadership, as well as their loved ones...

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

我正在跟踪你们集体中的每个主要节点，并在新节点创建时接收到通知。

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$
entries.en:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

I am tracking every major node within your collective and are alerted whenever a new one is created.

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

我已经侵入了你的位置矩阵，能够追踪你网络中每个主要节点的位置。

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$
entries.en:
$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_1$

I have a backdoor into your location matrix, tracking the position of every principal node in your network.

$grand_archive.8410.b.reply.common_2$

entries.zh: 何必多此一举和我们谈判？
这种规模的破坏行动可不便宜。船舶维护、工资、贿赂，这些东西都很昂贵，大手大脚花钱可不会带来暴富。等待你们的毁灭规模巨大，按下开关就能实现，这其中有很大的机会成本。\n\n有更好的地方可以花我的辛苦赚来的钱。来吧，让我们避免更多无谓的流血。拿着你们新获得的财富，离开这里，让专业人士来做海盗。
entries.en: A sabotage operation of this scale doesn't come cheap. Ship upkeep, wages, bribes; these things are expensive, and I didn't get rich by spending when I don't have to. There is a significant opportunity cost for the sheer scale of destruction that awaits you at the flip of a switch.\n\nThere are better ways to spend my hard-earned money. Come, let us avoid more meaningless bloodshed. Take your newfound wealth and leave the piracy to the experts.

entries.zh: 这不仅仅是钱的问题，对吧？
entries.en: This isn't just about the credits, is it?

entries.zh:
五千年前，我的祖先，伟大的$NAME_SilverQuill$，是$NAME_CaptainNess$的副手。他忠心耿耿地为她服务多年，可最终得到了什么回报？

背叛！

她将他交给了当局，并独吞了赏金！当然，没有任何监狱能够囚禁强大的$NAME_SilverQuill$。

在一次大胆的逃脱后，他从灰烬中崛起，将他的杂牌军锻造成如今站在你面前的传奇$NAME_BlackNeedle$。他发誓要报复背叛他的$NAME_CaptainNess$，将毕生精力投入到掠夺她的宝藏，并用自己的成功掩埋她的名声。

我只是在完成他的遗愿。这张星图是夺回我们应得之物的关键。

现在，请把它交出来。
entries.en:
5000 years ago my ancestor, the great $NAME_SilverQuill$, was the First Mate of $NAME_CaptainNess$. He gave her years of loyal service, and how was he repaid?

Betrayal!

She handed him over to the authorities and pocketed the bounty! But of course, no prison could contain the mighty $NAME_SilverQuill$.

After a daring escape, he rose from the proverbial ashes, forging his motley crew into the legendary $NAME_BlackNeedle$ that stands before you today. Swearing revenge against the traitorous $NAME_CaptainNess$, he dedicated his life to looting her treasure and burying her legacy under the weight of his own success.

I am simply finishing what he started. This chart is the key to reclaiming what is rightfully ours.

Now please, hand it over.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的首领提出了一项提议，他们愿意支付巨额赏金来换取§Y$celestial_chart$§!。如果我们接受了这个交易，就等于将§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!宝藏的关键拱手相让。\n\n拒绝他们的提议将会招致他们的怒火。这些海盗渗透到我们军队序列中的程度尚不清楚，但他们威胁要从内部彻底瓦解[this.GetName]。这些威胁是否只是虚张声势，还有待观察。
entries.en: The leader of the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! has made a proposition, offering us a significant bounty in exchange for the §Y$celestial_chart$§!. If we took this deal, we would be handing over the key to §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!'s treasure.\n\nRejecting this proposal will invoke their full wrath. The extent to which these pirates have infiltrated our ranks is unknown, but they have threatened to completely dismantle [this.GetName] from the inside out. Whether these are but empty threats remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 失去§Y$celestial_chart$§!\n获得你的最大$r_energy$的§G+$@max_credit_mult|0%$§!\n获得一艘来自§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的舰船
entries.en: Lose the §Y$celestial_chart$§!\nGain §G+$@max_credit_mult|0%$§! of your maximum $r_energy$\nGain a ship from the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!

entries.zh:
我们以一笔巨额$MONEY$和一艘名为§Y针眼§!的非凡军舰作为报酬，给出了§Y$celestial_chart$§!。我们可以认为我们与§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的争端已彻底解决。

我们避免了与他们全部舰队进行重大交战，并阻止了一次对星系规模的蓄意破坏企图。

最好还是让海盗们继续做他们的海盗勾当。
entries.en:
We handed over the §Y$celestial_chart$§! in exchange for a large sum of $MONEY$ and an exceptional military flagship known as §YThe Eye of the Needle§!. We can consider our dispute with the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! to be settled once and for all.

We have avoided a significant engagement with the full force of their fleets and prevented a sabotage attempt on a galactic scale.

Better that we simply leave piracy to the pirates.
All ships are ejected from the $TREASURE_TROVE$ system.

entries.zh: 这个结构已经被海盗掠夺过了，里面没有任何值钱的东西
entries.en: This structure has been looted by pirates and contains nothing more of value

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!发起了全面攻击，给我们带来影响广泛的混乱。生产线停产，发电机烧毁，重要的行政基础设施被迫下线。货物消失，研究站的数据被清空，矿井坍塌速度是正常速度的五倍。\n\n这场全方位的破坏是数千名歹毒的参与者协同作案的结果。一个庞大的破坏者网络潜伏在我们之中，他们似乎总是领先我们一步。
entries.en: The §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! has launched an all-out assault, unleashing widespread chaos. Assembly lines have ground to a halt, generators have burnt out, and essential administrative infrastructure has been taken offline. Shipments are disappearing, research stations have had their data wiped, and mines are collapsing at five times the typical rate.\n\nThe devastation is total; the result of insidious handiwork of thousands of malevolent actors working in tandem. A vast network of saboteurs is hidden among us and they seem to be one step ahead of us.

entries.zh: 来自§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的大量破坏分子潜伏在我们之中，在[owner.GetName]各地造成广泛破坏。除非我们消灭这些破坏分子，否则破坏将持续下去，直到我们的补给线崩溃。
entries.en: A vast network of saboteurs from the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! is hidden among us causing widespread disruption across [owner.GetName]. Unless we eliminate the saboteurs, the damage will continue until our supply lines collapse.

entries.zh: 我们目前不会采取任何特殊行动。
entries.en: We will take no special actions here.

entries.zh: 清除潜伏在我方内部的卧底特工势必会造成一些不可避免的附带损害。
entries.en: Hunting down the agents hidden in our ranks will result in some unavoidable collateral damage.

entries.zh: 可以采取相应措施重建我们的基础设施，希望通过消耗战来抵御破坏性攻击。
entries.en: Responsive measures can be taken to rebuild our infrastructure in the hopes of outlasting the sabotage attack by attrition.

entries.zh: 我们将清除黑针破坏分子，并阻止他们增援奈斯船长藏宝地的封锁力量。
entries.en: We will clear out the Black Needle saboteurs and prevent them from reinforcing their blockade around Captain Ness's Hoard.

entries.zh: 我们的基础设施将遭到无法修复的破坏，黑针将增援对奈斯船长藏宝地的封锁。
entries.en: Our infrastructure will be damaged beyond repair and the Black Needle will reinforce their blockade around Captain Ness's Hoard.

entries.zh: 我们截获了§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!在我们殖民地使用的隐藏通信频率。在解密他们的信息后，我们已经能够识别出我们队伍中的所有叛徒和破坏分子。
entries.en: We have intercepted a hidden communications frequency used by the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! throughout our colonies. After decrypting their messages, we have been able to identify every traitorous conspirator and saboteur within our ranks.

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

他们的特工一直秘密地在我们的操作系统中传播恶意软件，制造了一个由叛乱单位构成的休眠军队，潜伏在我们系统各个位置。

这个歹毒的重新编程计划已经走得如此之远，以至于腐化了[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，§Y[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]§!。
entries.en:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

Their operatives have been covertly spreading insidious malware within our operating systems, creating a sleeper army of rebel units occupying various positions across our systems.

The malicious reprogramming scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], §Y[traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName]§!.

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

他们的特工一直在居住地释放分离性信息素，导致我们许多工蜂产生了潜在的偏差。一旦被迷惑住，海盗们将我们的工蜂重新安置到休眠特工的舱室，他们目前正在破坏我们的基础设施。

这个庞大的计划已经发展到腐蚀[root.GetName]中最重要的独立节点之一，§Y[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]§!。
entries.en:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

Their operatives have been flooding habitats with dissociative pheromones, causing many of our drones to develop an underlying deviance. Once disillusioned, the pirates reorganized our drones into pods of sleeper agents who are currently tearing down our infrastructure.

The extensive scheme has gone so far as to corrupt one of the most significant independent nodes in [root.GetName], §Y[traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName]§!.

entries.zh:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

我们已经得知他们的特工多年来一直在招募心怀不满的公民，为这次大规模袭击做准备，他们利用潜伏的间谍网络和各种随时准备背叛我们的线人。

其中一名叛徒已暴露，正是§Y[traitor_leader.GetClass][traitor_leader.GetName]§!，这构成了重大的安全风险。我们必须处理这个阴谋家，同时保持一定程度的稳定。公众得知这种程度的腐败将对我们的政府造成严重后果。
entries.en:
$grand_archive.8520.desc.common$

We have learned their operatives have been recruiting disgruntled citizens for years, preparing for this extensive attack with sleeper cells and a variety of assets ready to turn against us.

One of the traitors has been revealed to be §Y[traitor_leader.GetClass] [traitor_leader.GetName]§!, which presents a considerable security risk. We must deal with this conspirator while maintaining some sense of stability. Public knowledge of this level of corruption would have serious repercussions for our government.

entries.zh: 每个有人居住的行星都会有§R100§!£pop£§H人口§!被消灭。
entries.en: §R100§! £pop£ §HPops§! are killed in every populated planet.

entries.zh: 对偏离的单元进行重编程。

entries.en: Following the discovery of [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] allegiance to the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! pirates

entries.zh: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetName]已被处决。\n\n[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]死亡的具体情况尚未公开。
entries.en: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetName] has been executed.\n\nThe exact circumstances of [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] death have been kept discrete.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetName]已得到充分的纠正。\n\n不幸的是，这种再教育过程给[traitor_leader.GetName]留下了持久的负面影响。
entries.en: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetName] has been sufficiently corrected.\n\nUnfortunately, this re-education process has left a lasting negative impression on [traitor_leader.GetName].

entries.zh: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetName]已得到充分的纠正。\n\n不幸的是，这次重新同化过程给[traitor_leader.GetName]留下了持久的负面印象。
entries.en: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetName] has been sufficiently corrected.\n\nUnfortunately, this re-assimilation process has left a lasting negative impression on [traitor_leader.GetName].

entries.zh: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetName]已被充分重新编程。\n\n不幸的是，这种重塑过程给[traitor_leader.GetName]留下了持久的负面印象。
entries.en: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetName] has been sufficiently reprogrammed.\n\nUnfortunately, this reformatting process has left a lasting negative impression on [traitor_leader.GetName].

entries.zh: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[root.GetName]愤怒的市民集结起来进行抗议。这群义愤填膺的暴民冲进[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]的家中。[traitor_leader.GetHeSheCap]后来被宣布当场死亡。
entries.en: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, furious citizens of [root.GetName] gathered in organized protests. The vigilante mob stormed [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] home. [traitor_leader.GetHeSheCap] was later pronounced dead at the scene.

entries.zh: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$，[traitor_leader.GetHeShe]发布了一份公开声明，对[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]的行为表示深深的悔恨。这场磨难似乎对[traitor_leader.GetHisHer]的领导能力产生了持久的影响。\n\n尽管过去犯下种种错误，但[root.GetName]的人民似乎愿意原谅[traitor_leader.GetName]。
entries.en: $grand_archive.8525.desc.common$, [traitor_leader.GetHeShe] released a public statement expressing a deep regret for [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] actions. This ordeal seems to have left a lasting effect on [traitor_leader.GetHisHer] ability to lead.\n\nDespite their past deeds, it seems like the people of [root.GetName] are willing to forgive [traitor_leader.GetName].
[traitor_leader.GetName] gains a level of Negative Traits

entries.zh: 不幸的是，我们无法阻止§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的破坏行动。他们的破坏者已经彻底破坏了我们的后勤基础设施，重建供应链将需要数年时间。他们在我们的恒星系中传播的腐败规模太大，无法得到缓解。\n\n然而，这不会阻止我们以我们的名义夺取§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!。我们只需要在战斗中击败海盗，宝藏就会属于我们。
entries.en: Unfortunately, we were unable to thwart the devastating operations of §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!. Their saboteurs have damaged our logistics infrastructure beyond repair, and it will take many years to rebuild our supply chains. The corruption they've spread throughout our systems is on too grand of a scale to be mitigated.\n\nHowever, this will not stop us from claiming §Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! in our name. All that we must do is defeat the pirates in battle, and the treasure will be ours.

entries.zh: 尽管§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!竭尽全力破坏我们的基础设施，我们依然得到恢复并稳定了局势。他们的特工已被击败，剩下的就是与他们在[hoard_system.GetName]集结的舰队对抗，并以[root.GetName]的名义夺取§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!。
entries.en: Despite the extensive efforts of the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! to sabotage our infrastructure, we have recovered and stabilized. With their agents defeated, all that remains is to confront their amassed fleet in [hoard_system.GetName] and claim §Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! in the name of [root.GetName].

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的军力根本无法与我们强大的军队抗衡。他们集结的舰队已被击败，无法再支持对我们恒星系的破坏行动。现在，我们可以在[root.GetName]的名义下夺取§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!。
entries.en: The §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! could simply not compete with the might of our military. With their amassed fleets defeated, they can no longer support the sabotage efforts within our systems. We are now free to claim §Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! in the name of [root.GetName].

entries.zh: 在对[root.GetName]的恒星系进行大规模破坏性攻击后，$NAME_BlackNeedle$仍然维持着对§H$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!的封锁。他们已经耗尽了大部分资源，现在处于脆弱状态。如果我们在这里击败他们，他们的整个组织必然会崩溃，让我们可以自由地夺取宝藏。
entries.en: Following extensive sabotage attacks on [root.GetName] systems, the $NAME_BlackNeedle$ have maintained their blockade around §H$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!. They have exhausted much of their resources, and are now in a vulnerable position. If we defeat them here, their wider organization will surely crumble, allowing us to freely claim the treasure.

entries.zh:
奈斯的孩子们……真是讽刺。

是她选择了你——你知道吗？

数百种物种任她挑选……她却选择了你。也许她看到了你身上的特别之处，也许这只是一场纯粹的偶然。无论如何，我们都走到了这一步。

你赢了……暂时。不要轻视这场胜利。你已经树立了强大的敌人——我们，§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!我们不会宽恕，也不会忘记。

就像我的祖先一样，我们会坚持下去。我们会一点一点地重建我们失去的一切。即使需要一千年，一百万年——我们也会回来，夺回你从我们手中夺走的一切。

$NAME_BlackNeedle$将永远存在！永远！
entries.en:
Ness's children... how ironic.

She chose you - do you know that?

Hundreds of species to choose from... and she chose you. Maybe she saw something special in you, or maybe it was complete chance. Either way, here we are.

You win... for now. Do not dare take this victory lightly. You have made a powerful enemy in us. The §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! does not forgive, and we do not forget.

As my ancestors did before me, we will persevere. We will rebuild what we have lost piece by piece. Even if it takes a thousand years, a million years - we will return and reclaim everything you have stolen from us.

The $NAME_BlackNeedle$ will live on forever! Forever!

entries.zh:
§H$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!近在咫尺了。

尽管它看起来被遗弃了，但建筑物的许多系统仍在运行。考虑到§H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的传说性质，我们应该警惕预料之外的安全措施。

这个宝库的唯一入口在其中央舱口处有一个凹槽。我们可以将§H$celestial_chart$§!插入这里，打开这个神秘的设施。
entries.en:
§H$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! is ours to take.

Despite its abandoned appearance, many of the building's systems are active. Given the alleged nature of §H$NAME_CaptainNess$§!, we should be cautious of unexpected security measures.

The singular entrance of the treasure trove has an indent carved into its central hatch. We can insert the §H$celestial_chart$§! here to open this mysterious facility.

entries.zh:
§Y$celestial_chart$§!是钥匙，而宝库是它的锁。我们把它插入巨型结构的主舱口。

星图启动，内部追踪着一道单一的的光束，指向我们旅程中经过的每一颗恒星。古老的机器发出咯吱咯吱的响声，我们很快便进入了内部。

来自一千个世界的难以置信的宝藏，在地板和墙壁上堆积如山。精致的雕像与用贵金属打造的攻击武器并列。精美的珠宝悬挂在古老化石的末端，复杂的装置堆积成一堆，毫无秩序。

金属的脚步声从中央走道传来。一只充满液体的类人生物机器，举起双臂投降，向我们走来。它的语音电路发出噼啪声，启动了：

§L“所以……你最终还是找到了我的星图。你真聪明。”§!
entries.en:
The §Y$celestial_chart$§! was a key, and the vault was its lock. We inserted it into the main hatch of the megastructure.

The chart activated, internally tracing a singular beam of light to each star along our journey. Ancient machinery groaned to life, and we were soon inside.

Incredible treasures looted from a thousand worlds line the floor and walls in abundance. Delicate statues are juxtaposed against assault weapons forged in precious metals. Fine jewelry hangs from the extremities of antique fossils and complex devices are piled up in an orderless heap.

Metallic footsteps ring out from the central walkway. Arms raised in surrender, a fluid-filled humanoid machine approaches us. Its voice circuits crackle into activation:

§L"So... you found my chart after all. Aren't you clever?"§!

entries.zh:
§H尽管她的机械形态限制了其表达能力，但被称为奈斯船长的机器却用一种自鸣得意的眼神看着我们。她的金属身体没有丝毫磨损的迹象，仿佛刚组装不久。她的语气既耐心又居高临下，仿佛在对一个地位低于她的人说话。§!

我想应该做个自我介绍，尽管你可能已经猜到我是谁了。

我叫桑达·奈斯，或者至少以前是。曾经的“星海海盗女王”，现在是这堆冰冷螺栓的主人。

§H机器停顿了一下，观察着我们的形态。§!

我已经很久没有见过你们这种生物了。看起来你们这些原始人已经长大成人了！

我必须说，我对你们能来到这里感到非常惊讶。
entries.en:
§HDespite the limited expressions available in her robotic form, the machine known as Captain Ness regards us with a certain smugness. Her metallic body shows no sign of wear and tear, as if only recently assembled. Her tone is patient yet patronizing, as if addressing one below her status.§!

I suppose some introduction is in order, though you may already have guessed who I am.

The name's Saanda Ness, or at least it was. Former "Pirate Queen of the Galaxy" and current occupant of this cold pile of bolts.

§HThe machine pauses for a moment, taking in our forms.§!

It's been a long time since I last saw your species. Looks like you primitives are all grown up!

I must say, I'm quite impressed you've made it here.

entries.zh: 永生可不是便宜货。我花了几百万能量币，请了[fallen_empire.GetRealName]的科学家帮我转移意识，而且没引起警觉。他们干得还不错，但我现在跳起舞来可没以前那么好了。\n\n$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$
entries.en: Immortality doesn't come cheap. I paid some scientists from [fallen_empire.GetRealName] a few million credits to transfer my consciousness without raising the alarm. They did a fair job, but I can't dance as well as I used to.\n\n$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$

entries.zh: 永生可不是便宜货。我花了几百万能量币，请了$NAME_Curator_Order$的科学家帮我转移意识，而且没引起警觉。他们干得还不错，但我现在跳起舞来可没以前那么好了。\n\n$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$
entries.en: Immortality doesn't come cheap. I paid some scientists from $NAME_Curator_Order$ a few million credits to transfer my consciousness without raising the alarm. They did a fair job, but I can't dance as well as I used to.\n\n$grand_archive.8570.a.reply$

entries.zh:
§H机器启动了一个控制台，露出墙上隐藏的一个密室。一个古老的冷冻舱里，躺着一位有机生物的遗骸。§!

我在这里。一个无用的装饰品，但我有点怀旧。我看起来不错，对吧？

我确认一切就绪后，锁上了这个保险库，然后休眠了几千年。下一件事，你就打开了门，我们现在正在进行这场对话。感觉就像昨天我躺下睡觉一样……
entries.en:
§HThe machine activates a console, revealing a chamber hidden in the wall. Within an ancient cryo-pod are the remains of an organic being.§!

Here I am. A useless ornament, but I'm a bit sentimental. Looked good, didn't I?

Once I checked that everything was in place, I locked up this vault and powered down for a few thousand years. Next thing I know, you've opened the door and we're having this conversation. Feels like only yesterday I laid down to sleep...

entries.zh: 你这些宝藏是从哪里来的？
entries.en: Where did you get all of this treasure?

entries.zh:
大部分都是偷来的，或者用其他不义之财换来的。我曾经从星海的所有大人物那里偷过东西。货船、巨像武器，你随便说，我都劫持过。我的逻辑是，如果我能这么容易地从你那里拿走东西，说明你根本不在乎，不配拥有它。

有时候事情会变得……很糟糕。你看到了乙特人发生了什么。那件事让我大开眼界。

玩玩闹闹，直到不再有趣……
entries.en:
Stole it, mostly. Or traded it for other ill-gotten goods. I ripped off every major player in the galaxy once upon a time. Cargo ships, Colossus weapons; you name it, I've hijacked it. My logic was that if I could take something so easily from you, you didn't care enough to deserve it.

Things would sometimes get... messy. You saw what happened to the Ytterites. That one was an eye-opener.

It's all fun and games until it's not any more...

entries.zh:
如果说是因为我孤独，你会相信吗？

§H机器的语音电路发出应该称之为笑声的咯咯声。§!

我拥有了所有这些财富，但为了什么？最终能给我带来什么？我意识到我想要的不是财富，而是传承。但是，你无法偷走传承——那么如何创造一个呢？

好吧，我是这么打算的。我找到了几个最有希望的原始物种，并在他们的世界中播下了宝藏——当然还有地图。第一个拼凑出我的藏宝图的人将通过考验，并有资格继承我毕生的基业。于是……我们就在这里碰面了。

也许你们一族能做到我做不到的事情，并将所有这些付诸实践。
entries.en:
Would you believe me if I said I was lonely?

§HThe machine's vocal circuits crackled with what might have been laughter.§!

I had all of this treasure, but for what? What does it get me in the end? I realized it wasn't riches that I wanted; it was a legacy. But, you can't steal a legacy - so how do you create one?

Well, this was my shot at it. I found a few of the most promising primitive species and seeded their worlds with treasure - and the map of course. Whoever pieced together my chart first would pass the test and be worthy of inheriting my life's work. So... here we are.

Maybe your kind can do what I could not, and put all of this to good use.

entries.zh: 我已经告诉过你们，我要把火炬传下去。我并不擅长花钱，只会赚钱。\n\n不过，我不能把钱随便给任何人。他们必须足够聪明才能来到这里；一支我能为之骄傲的队伍。一支我能与之分享我的故事的队伍……
entries.en: I've told you, I'm passing on the torch. I'm not good at spending money, only taking it.\n\nI couldn't give it away to just anyone, though. They had to be clever enough to reach this place; a crew I could be proud of. One I could share my story with...

entries.zh:
好吧，既然你诚心诚意地发问了……

§H机器启动了一个控制台，一系列数字记录被投射到墙上。§!

整个藏宝库都是我的自传。我花了很多钱雇佣了一支作家团队，记录下我生命中所有可以记住的时刻。我认为他们做得还不错。

§H图像切换到一个海盗船员的驾驶舱画面，船长奈斯的生物形态在指挥。机器的语音电路发出一声短暂的噼啪声；那是一声叹息。§!

我曾经是星系中最令人恐惧的海盗。我让大型企业破产，勒索星球，并将整个帝国夷为平地。任何愚蠢到敢于反对我的人，要么被我的[root.GetSpeciesOrganName]刺穿，要么被卖掉换取赏金。我自己的赏金？天文数字。
entries.en:
Well, since you asked...

§HThe machine activates a console, and a series of digital recordings are projected across the wall.§!

This entire vault is my biography. I paid a great deal to a team of authors to record every moment of my life that could be remembered. They did a fair job of it, I think.

§HThe images shift to a cockpit image of a pirate crew, the biological form of Captain Ness in command. A short crackle escapes the machine's voice circuits; it has the weight of a sigh.§!

I was once the most feared pirate in the galaxy. I've bankrupted mega-corporations, ransomed planets, and reduced entire empires to rubble. Anyone foolish enough to oppose me got a blade in their [root.GetSpeciesOrganName] or were sold off for a bounty. My own bounty? Astronomical.

entries.zh:
§H各种抢劫、盗窃和惊险逃脱的数字记录，伴随着史诗音乐的投影，在屏幕上播放。§!

起初，我精心挑选目标，并为自己的行为寻找正当理由，认为他们罪有应得。每一次行动都比上一次更刺激。这是一个循环：计划、妖魔化、抢劫、然后庆祝。问题是寻找“坏”目标太耗时了。我需要拓宽视野。

最终，如果我想要什么，我就直接拿走。我喜欢看着数字上涨，我的战利品的价值和我的宝藏的价值。我在世界上留下了自己的印记，我将永远不会被遗忘。其他一切都不重要。
entries.en:
§HDigital recordings of various hold-ups, heists, and daring escapes, all set to heroic music are projected.§!

At first, I picked my targets carefully and found some justification as to why they deserved it. Each job was more exciting than the last. It was a cycle: planning, demonizing, robbing, then celebrating. The problem was that looking for "bad" targets was too time-consuming. I needed to expand my horizons.

Eventually, if there was something I wanted, I'd just take it. I enjoyed watching the numbers go up; the price of my bounty and the value of my hoard. I was leaving my mark on the world and I'd never be forgotten. Everything else was unimportant.

entries.zh:
§H乙特人的家园已经成为一片废墟。§!

然后，乙特星事件发生了……你看到了吧？我还记得广播里传来的哭喊声，那是他们最后生命的消逝。事情已经走得太远了。是时候改变了。

在我的职业生涯中，我发现了一个规律：历史会淡忘，教训会被遗忘，总会有新人来接替你的位置。我只是想选择接替我的人。

那就是你。你们[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]通过了考验。接下来会发生什么，就取决于你了。
entries.en:
§HThe Ytterite homeworld is displayed in ruin.§!

Then the Yterrite incident happened... You saw it, right? I still remember the cries on the radio as the last of their lives were snuffed out. Things went too far. It was time for a change.

There was a pattern I discovered over my career: History fades, lessons are forgotten, and someone new takes your place. I simply wanted to be able to pick who came after me.

That's you. You [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] passed the test. What happens next is up to you.

entries.zh:
§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!包含着难以置信的财富。然而，我们必须考虑以我们的名义宣称它所带来的后果。

她宝藏中的每一笔信用都是非法获得的。获取这些资源将意味着我们容忍$NAME_CaptainNess$的过度犯罪行为，以换取物质财富。

话虽如此，许多被$NAME_CaptainNess$伤害的人早已不在人世。宣称这笔财富不会造成新的受害者。此外，我们已经消灭了§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!，从而使星系变得更加安全。经过漫长的危险旅程，我们理所当然地应该得到丰厚的回报。

我们必须决定如何处理它。
entries.en:
§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! contains an incredible bounty of wealth. We must however consider the consequences of claiming it in our name.

Every credit of her treasure was earned illegally. Taking these resources would represent a tolerance of $NAME_CaptainNess$'s excessive criminality in exchange for material wealth.

That said, many of those wronged by $NAME_CaptainNess$ are long gone. Claiming this wealth would create no new victims. Furthermore, we have decimated the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! and thus made the galaxy a safer place. Having traveled this long path fraught with danger, we arguably deserve a sizable reward for our efforts.

We must make a decision on what to do with its contents.

entries.zh:
§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§!是终极的藏宝地，我们很高兴能获得它的战利品。

这是打败了§Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§!的应得奖励——为[this.GetName]三呼万岁！

让我们清理这个金库。所有[This.Species.GetHandNamePlural]准备就位！
entries.en:
§Y$NESS_GRAND_ARCHIVE$§! is the ultimate treasure trove, and we are pleased to claim its booty.

A hard-earned reward for taking down the §Y$NAME_BlackNeedle$§! - three cheers for [this.GetName]!

Let's clear out this vault. All [This.Species.GetHandNamePlural] on deck!

entries.zh: 夺取我们辛苦赚来的战利品。
将可以溯源的物品归还给其合法所有者。
entries.en: Return traceable items to their rightful owners.

entries.zh: 将这笔财富布施给整个星系。
entries.en: Distribute this wealth among the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: §H现在被称为§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的机器对我们清空她的珍宝库的速度印象深刻。§!\n\n去吧，你应得的。这笔财富里包含着许多血汗和泪水。别在一个地方花光了。
entries.en: §HThe machine now known as §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! was impressed at how quickly we emptied her vault.§!\n\nGo ahead, you deserve it. There's a lot of blood, sweat, and tears in this treasure. Don't spend it all in one place.

entries.zh: §H现在被称为§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的机器对我们想要归还她辛苦赚来的宝藏感到不安。§!\n\n真是令人失望。所以某个第十五代继承人会得到他们祖先的旧首饰。好吧，希望你们能把剩下的东西用在更有价值的项目上。尽管你们最近干了些蠢事，但我相信你们会把这件事做好。
entries.en: §HThe machine now known as §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! was perturbed at our desire to repatriate some of her hard-earned treasure.§!\n\nHow disappointing. So some fifteenth-generation heirling will get their ancestor's old jewelry. Well, hopefully you'll use whatever's left on a worthier project. Despite recent evidence, I trust you to get this right.

entries.zh:
§H现在被称为§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的机器得知我们要把她的全部积蓄都送出去，感到十分厌恶。§!

这就是你的计划？免费送给所有人？他们做了什么值得得到这些？真是浪费！

我对你原本抱有更高的期望……至少让我指挥一些你的舰队，让我可以再试一次曾经的海盗生涯。
entries.en:
§HThe machine now known as §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! was disgusted when she learned that we would be giving away her entire hoard.§!

This is your master plan? Free stuff for everyone? What did they do to deserve any of it? What a waste!

I thought better of you... at least give me command of some of your fleets so I can try this all over again.

entries.zh: §H现在的问题是该如何处理$NAME_CaptainNess$本人。作为一名经验丰富的舰船驾驶员，她经历过无数危险遭遇，将成为我们军队中优秀的指挥官。或者，她也可以在我们队伍中担任更具保障性的角色，培训下一代飞行员。§!
entries.en: §HThe question remains of what to do with $NAME_CaptainNess$ herself. As an experienced pilot who has survived a multitude of dangerous encounters, she would be an excellent asset to our military as a Commander. Alternatively, she could take a more supporting role within our ranks to train our next generation of pilots.§!

entries.zh: §H或者我们也可以她关起来，以此向我们的公民表明，任何罪行都不会逍遥法外。她将有足够的时间反思自己的所作所为。§!
entries.en: §HThat is unless we simply incarcerate her to set an example to our citizens that no crime goes unpunished. She would have a long time to think about what she's done.§!

entries.zh: §H唯一剩下的决定是关于$NAME_CaptainNess$本人。作为一名强大的独立思想者，她可以成为一名独特的指挥官，提供出敌不意的创意策略。或者，我们可以将她的丰富战斗经验融入我们的集体知识中，并利用它来进一步加深我们对战争的理解。\n\n或者我们也可以干脆将她囚禁起来，以表明在[this.GetName]中不容忍背叛和犯罪行为。§!
entries.en: §HThe only remaining decision is to do with $NAME_CaptainNess$ herself. As a powerful independent mind, she would make for a unique asset in a Commander role, offering creative strategies that could catch opponents off-guard. Alternatively, we could integrate her vast combat experience into our collective knowledge and use it to further our wider understanding of warfare.\n\nThat is unless we simply imprison her to make it clear that deviance and criminality are not to be tolerated within [this.GetName].§!

entries.zh: 我们可以让你担任一名舰队指战员。
entries.en: We could use you as a pilot.

entries.zh: 获得一位等级10的§Y不朽舰队司令§!
§Y我们将把你的知识融入我们的意识。§!
entries.en: §YWe will integrate your knowledge into our consciousness.§!
§YHelp us in training our new pilots.§!

entries.zh:
就这样了？

你只是把我抛弃了？

真令人失望……我想我该走了。

祝你好运，我想。
entries.en:
That's it, then?

You're just casting me aside?

How disappointing... I guess I'll be on my way.

Good luck out there, I guess.

entries.zh:
你这个脑袋空空的傻屌！我给你整个世界，你却只给我一副新的镣铐？你不配得到我给你的东西！你甚至不配为我擦靴子！

愿这[this.GetName]上留下一块黑斑，诅咒你们所有人！

愿你们的[this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural]在虚空中枯萎，愿你们的名字被人遗忘。
entries.en:
You empty-minded echo! I offer you the world and all I get is a fresh pair of cuffs? You don't deserve what I've given you! You don't deserve to clean my boots!

A black spot on the [this.GetName], a curse upon you all!

May your [this.species.GetRemnantNamePlural] wither in the void and and your name be forgotten.

entries.zh: 名为§Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§!的机器俘虏被发现在她的牢房里停机。我们相信她故意导致了电路的严重故障，关闭了关键系统，并从她转移的意识中删除了所有存储的数据。在她牢房的墙壁上发现了一条潦草的留言：\n\n§L与你同归于尽……§!
entries.en: The captive machine known as §Y$NAME_CaptainNess$§! was found deactivated in her cell. We believe that she had purposely caused a critical malfunction in her circuits, shutting down crucial systems and erasing all stored data from her transferred consciousness. A message was found scribbled on her cell walls:\n\n§LTo the void with you...§!

entries.zh: 现在是时候开创自己的命运了。没有星图可循，星辰将成为我们的指引。\n\n我们将取得什么成就？我们将如何被铭记？
entries.en: Now it is time to forge our own destiny. With no chart left to follow, the stars themselves will be our guide.\n\nWhat will we achieve? How will we be remembered?

entries.zh:
这场冒险已经结束。寻找§H船长奈斯§!的宝藏的任务已经完成。

$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$

这才是[this.GetName]故事的真正开始。
entries.en:
This adventure has come to an end. The quest for the Treasure of §HCaptain Ness§! is complete.

$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$

This is where the story of [this.GetName] truly begins.

entries.zh:
他们会怎样讲述这段冒险故事！我们发现了奈斯船长的隐藏宝藏，没有人能阻挡我们。

$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$

高高地挂起[this.GetName]的旗帜，现在我们的故事才真正开始！
entries.en:
What tales they will tell of this adventure! We discovered the hidden treasure of Captain Ness and let no crew stand in our way.

$grand_archive.8600.desc.common$

Mount the jack of [this.GetName] high and proud. Now our story truly begins!

entries.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功捕获了第一批野生太空兽群，我们相信只要投入足够的科学资金，就可以克隆出更多这样的生物。
entries.en: With our first successful capture of wild Space Fauna in [from.solar_system.GetName], we believe it possible to clone more of these creatures with the proper scientific investment.

entries.zh: 在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功克隆出首例太空兽群。\n\n我们对异星生物学的深入研究表明，我们可以进一步增强这些生物的生理机能，如果我们选择这样做的话。这将使我们能够为生物舰队配备专门的战斗组件。
entries.en: The first successfully cloned Space Fauna has been created in [from.solar_system.GetName].\n\nOur research into xenobiology indicates even more can be done to enhance these creatures' physiologies, should we choose to do so. This will allow us to outfit our biological fleets with specialized combat components.

entries.zh: §G+$@opinion_return_traceable_items_tier_1_value|0$§!£opinion£所有未同我们交战的非灭绝政体帝国。
entries.en: §G+$@opinion_return_traceable_items_tier_1_value|0$§! £opinion£ Opinion with every non-Homicidal Empire we are not at war with.

entries.zh: §G+$@opinion_return_traceable_items_tier_2_value|0$§!£opinion£所有未同我们交战的非灭绝政体帝国。
entries.en: §G+$@opinion_return_traceable_items_tier_2_value|0$§! £opinion£ Opinion with every non-Homicidal Empire we are not at war with.

entries.zh: 获得每个帝国的§Y1§!个外交支持。
获得每个帝国的§Y2§!个外交支持。
多年的阴谋诡计和离奇冒险造就了一位从不空手而归的领袖。
entries.en: Years of skulduggery and outlandish exploits have created a leader who never leaves with less than she came for.

entries.zh: 古代海盗女王的意识在一个机械化的躯体中存续。她曾在许多星球播下宝藏。
entries.en: The consciousness of an ancient pirate queen in mechanical form. She seeded many worlds with treasure.

entries.zh: 让我们携手铸就经世美名。
我们的§H[fromfrom.GetClass]§!§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!在[fromfromfrom.GetName]战斗中被[from.GetName]俘虏。他们要求支付赎金以交换[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的性命。
entries.en: Our §H[fromfrom.GetClass]§! §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! has been captured by [from.GetName] during the battle in [fromfromfrom.GetName]. They have demanded ransom in exchange for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] life.

entries.zh: 正如先前通报，我们的指挥官[fromfrom.GetName]被[from.GetName]俘虏，他们愿意接受支付赎金以换取[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的生命。
entries.en: As previously reported, our Commander [fromfrom.GetName] has been captured by [from.GetName] who are willing to accept payment in exchange for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] life.

entries.zh: [fromfrom.GetName]将被释放并回归我们的队伍。
entries.en: [fromfrom.GetName] will be released and return to our ranks.

entries.zh: 由于[from.GetName]拒绝支付[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的赎金，敌军指挥官[fromfrom.GetName]仍被我们扣押。[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的命运将如何？
entries.en: Following the unwillingness of [from.GetName] to pay for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] return, enemy Commander [fromfrom.GetName] remains in our custody. What is to be [fromfrom.GetHisHer] fate?

entries.zh: 我们在战斗中俘获了一名敌军指挥官。我们已与$COUNTRY$联系，要求支付赎金以换取他们的安全返回。
entries.en: We have captured an enemy Commander in battle. We have contacted $COUNTRY$ to request a ransom in exchange for their safe return.

entries.zh: 我们已收到[this.GetName]支付的赎金，以确保其指挥官[fromfrom.GetName]安全返回。
entries.en: We have received a ransom payment from [this.GetName] for the safe return of their Commander [fromfrom.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们已经夺取了一艘敌舰。它现在正驶往我们的首都，很快就可以投入使用。
entries.en: We've commandeered an enemy vessel. It is now en route to our capital and will soon be available for use.

entries.zh: $SYSTEM|Y$星系发生冲突后，太空兽群的残骸正在腐烂。我们可以从它们的残骸中回收$FLEET_SIZE$的生物物质。
entries.en: Space Fauna debris are decaying after a skirmish in $SYSTEM|Y$. We can salvage a $FLEET_SIZE$ amount of biomatter from their remains.

entries.zh: 控制的克隆有机§Y太空兽群§!可以被复活。
entries.en: Controlled cloned organic §YSpace Fauna§! can be reanimated

entries.zh: $SYSTEM|Y$中的已故太空生物已复活，现在可以作为我们军队的组成部分，由我们进行控制。
entries.en: The deceased spaceborne creatures in $SYSTEM|Y$ have been reanimated and can now be controlled as part of our military.

entries.zh: $SYSTEM|Y$星系发生冲突后，太空兽群的残骸正在腐烂。\n预计将有 $FLEET_SIZE$ 只生物被重新复活。
entries.en: Fallen Space Fauna is decaying after a skirmish in $SYSTEM|Y$.\nThe amount of creatures that will be reanimated is $FLEET_SIZE$.

entries.zh: 太空兽群舰船部件是通过研究关于各种太空兽群的特殊项目获得的。在作为太空兽群§H变异§!时，所有的增益也同样生效。例如但不限于以下部件：\n—§H$SPACE_WHALE_WEAPON_1$§!\n—§H$AMOEBA_STRIKE_CRAFT$§!
entries.en: Space Fauna Ship Components are those obtained by researching special projects on various Space Fauna. Any bonus applied to these will also be applied when equipped as a §HMutation§! on Space Fauna. Examples of these components include, but are not limited to:\n- §H$SPACE_WHALE_WEAPON_1$§!\n- §H$AMOEBA_STRIKE_CRAFT$§!

entries.zh: ['concept_space_fauna_ship_component', 太空兽群舰船部件]伤害
['concept_space_fauna_ship_component', 太空兽群舰船部件]射速
entries.en: ['concept_space_fauna_ship_component', Space Fauna Ship Component] Fire Rate

entries.zh: 切换是否隐藏已被更先进技术淘汰的变异。
entries.en: Toggle whether to hide mutations that have been made obsolete by more advanced technologies.

entries.zh: 选择一个变异，将其放入可用的槽位。
entries.en: Select a mutation and place it by moving it into an available slot.

entries.zh: 这个变异是§Y专有的§!，不能在同一款设计中应用多次。
entries.en: This mutation is §YUnique§! and cannot be applied more than once per design.

entries.zh: §R一个生物体中不能同时存在多种这种变异。§!
entries.en: §RYou cannot have more than one of these mutations in an organism.§!

entries.zh: §G打开联邦舰队的§H太空兽群设计器§!§!！
entries.en: §GOpen the §HSpace Fauna Designer§! for Federation Fleets§!!

entries.zh: §R仅限联邦领袖国才能设计太空兽群的突变。联邦中必须有一名成员拥有§Y人工繁育§!技术。§!
entries.en: §ROnly the Federation leader can design mutations for Space Fauna. One member of the Federation must have §YArtificial Breeding§! technology.§!

entries.zh: §H联邦舰队§!是联邦主席国控制的特殊舰队。它们在§H联邦$CREATURE_DESIGNER$§!中进行设计，在设计之中可以使用联邦各国最顶尖的科技。联邦舰队不需维护费用，但总量不能超过§H联邦海军容量§!，每个成员至少贡献其自身§Y$PERC|0%$§!的§H海军容量§!。如果太空兽群舰队规模超过§H联邦海军容量§!，额外的生物将被分配给联邦主席国。
entries.en: §HFederation Fleets§! are special fleets that are controlled by the Federation President. They are designed in the §HFederation $CREATURE_DESIGNER$§! and can use any technology available to any member of the Federation. Federation Fleets cost no upkeep, but cannot exceed the §HFederation Naval Capacity§!, to which each member contributes at least §Y$PERC|0%$§! of their own §HNaval Capacity§!. If Space Fauna fleets grow to exceed §HFederation Naval Capacity§!, extra creatures will be given to the Federation President.

entries.zh: 太空兽群飞船可以配备定制组件，类似于设计合金制造的飞船。
entries.en: Space Fauna Ships can be outfitted with customized components, similar to designing vessels that use alloys.
§R$TRIGGER_FAIL$ Unique mutations cannot be applied more than once ($MUTATION$).§!

entries.zh: §H独特变异§!\n独特变异是强大的变异，只能应用一次，有时会限制在特定种类的太空兽群身上。通过克隆和狩猎可以发现更多独特的变异。
entries.en: §HUnique Mutations§!\nUnique Mutations are powerful mutations that can be applied only once and can sometimes be limited to a specific kind of Space Fauna. More Unique Mutations can be discovered from cloning and hunting.

entries.zh: 死亡时，对附近敌人造成一定比例的船体和护甲伤害。
entries.en: Upon death, inflict a percentage of this creature's hull and armor as damage to a nearby enemy

entries.zh: 这种太空兽群尸体不能被复活。
entries.en: This Space Fauna carcass cannot be reanimated.
Number of max hull points are $COMPARATOR$ $NUM|Y$
Number of max hull points are NOT $COMPARATOR$ $NUM|Y$
Number of max armor points are $COMPARATOR$ $NUM|Y$
Number of max armor points are NOT $COMPARATOR$ $NUM|Y$

entries.zh: 当此生物死亡时，舰队中随机抽选一只生物恢复其§Y$@unique_mutation_restorative_enzymes_gain|0%$§!的船体和护甲。
entries.en: When this creature dies, a random creature in the fleet regains §Y$@unique_mutation_restorative_enzymes_gain|0%$§! of its Hull and Armor.

entries.zh: 死亡后，舰队中随机抽选一只生物会恢复一部分船体和护甲。
entries.en: Upon death, a random creature in the fleet regains a portion of Hull and Armor

entries.zh: 深空中大型生物的主要能量来源是星光的力量。它们离明亮的恒星越近，发展速度就越快。
entries.en: A main source of energy for large creatures in deep space comes from the power of starlight. The closer they are to brighter stars, the faster they develop.

entries.zh: 用能量代替维护费\n\n在恒星轨道时的生长速度：§G+$@unique_mutation_starborne_growth_speed|0%$§!
entries.en: Replaces upkeep with Energy\n\nGrowth speed when orbiting a star: §G+$@unique_mutation_starborne_growth_speed|0%$§!

entries.zh: 船体和装甲受到伤害会提高射速：§Y$@unique_mutation_berserker_glands_fire_rate|0%$§!，持续 $@unique_mutation_berserker_glands_days|0$ 天
entries.en: Hull and Armor damage taken increases fire rate by: §Y$@unique_mutation_berserker_glands_fire_rate|0%$§! for $@unique_mutation_berserker_glands_days|0$ days

entries.zh: 在我们对新克隆生物进行训练的过程中，一只受伤的太空变形虫使用了一种新技术击败了对手。变形虫的鞭毛能够从训练伙伴的天然防御中吸取营养和物质，用它们来修补自身盔甲上的漏洞，并恢复战斗力。\n\n对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示太空变形虫生物学的一个新元素，可以对其进行增强，从而开发出一种新的物种特异性突变。
entries.en: During our training process of newly cloned organisms, an injured Space Amoeba used a novel technique to defeat its opponent. The Amoeba's flagella were able to siphon nutrients and materials from its training partner's natural defenses, using them to patch holes in their own armor and regain fighting strength.\n\nAdditional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Space Amoeba biology that can be enhanced to develop a new species-specific mutation.

entries.zh: 最近克隆的一支缇扬奇舰队被观察到正在进行交流，反复发出复杂的叫声。这些几乎无法察觉的声音似乎给附近的所有其他生物带来了安慰和平静。\n\n对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示缇扬奇生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。
entries.en: A recently cloned fleet of Tiyanki were observed communing together, repeatedly emitting a series of complex vocalizations. The barely detectable sounds seemed to bring comfort and calm to every other creature nearby.\n\nAdditional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Tiyanki biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

entries.zh: 我们注意到一些虚空虫在成熟时会形成小的囊肿状生长物。进一步观察表明，带有这些难看水泡的样本通常比它们的同类更具繁殖力。\n\n对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示虚空虫生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。
entries.en: We have noticed that some of our Voidworms tend to develop small cyst-like growths as they reach maturity. Further observation showed that specimens with these unsightly blisters are typically more fertile than their counterparts.\n\nAdditional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Voidworm biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

entries.zh: 由于过度投喂，我们记录到了一只克隆岩居兽发生了剧烈的呕吐。从其胃部喷出的消化液作为浓缩抛射体非常致命，即使在离开该生物的躯体很长时间后还保有放射性。\n\n对这一现象的进一步研究揭示了岩居兽的生理学中有一种新的元素可以用来增强物种特有变异过程。
entries.en: As a result of overfeeding, one of our cloned Cutholoids was recorded violently ejecting the contents of its stomach. The resulting digestive fluids proved to be quite deadly as a concentrated projectile, maintaining their radioactive qualities for significant time outside of the creature's body.\n\nAdditional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Cutholoid biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

entries.zh: 在战斗测试中，一些我们的晶体实体在被摧毁后完美地分裂成两半。这些碎片保持着重要的生命迹象，并继续存活了一段时间。
entries.en: In combat testing, a number of our Crystalline Entities have split perfectly in two after being destroyed. These fragmented halves have maintained vital life signs and continued to live for a short time.

entries.zh: 我们从$NAME_Elderly_Tiyanki$身上提取的遗传物质为我们提供了一些独特的见解，这将使我们能够进行一项实验性突变项目，该项目可以应用于任何太空兽群。
entries.en: The genetic material we have recovered from the $NAME_Elderly_Tiyanki$ has provided some unique insight that will allow us to proceed with an experimental mutation project that could be applied to any Space Fauna.

entries.zh: 我们从$NAME_Voidspawn$身上提取的遗传物质为我们提供了一些独特的见解，这将使我们能够进行一项实验性突变项目，该项目可以应用于任何太空兽群。
entries.en: The genetic material we have recovered from the $NAME_Voidspawn$ has provided some unique insight that will allow us to proceed with an experimental mutation project that could be applied to any Space Fauna.

entries.zh: 我们对[From.GetShipCategoryName]的克隆工作取得了基因突破。将这些生物独特的解剖结构与我们在基因操控方面的专业知识结合起来，或许可以创造出一种独特的变异体。
entries.en: Our [From.GetShipCategoryName] cloning efforts have resulted in a genetic breakthrough. It might be possible to combine these creature's unique anatomy with our expertise in gene manipulation to create a unique type of Mutation.

entries.zh: 太空变形虫变异计划完成
我们关于§Y空间变形虫§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的新细胞器：可部署的§Y$tech_unique_mutation_space_amoeba$§!。\n\n这些共生生物能够从附近物体中汲取能量并将其返还给宿主，从而增强生存能力和再生能力。
entries.en: Our experimental mutation project on §YSpace Amoebas§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting new organelles: deployable §Y$tech_unique_mutation_space_amoeba$§!.\n\nThese symbiotic organisms are able to drain energy from nearby objects and return it to its host, enhancing survivability and regeneration.

entries.zh: 我们对§Y缇扬奇§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：§Y$tech_unique_mutation_tiyanki$§!\n\n我们已经将这些生物在它们群体中用于交流的自然振动放大到可持续的最大水平。这将产生一个可控的场，增强附近其他生物的组织。
entries.en: Our experimental mutation project on §YTiyankis§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting enhancements: §Y$tech_unique_mutation_tiyanki$§!\n\nWe have amplified the natural vibrations these creatures use for communication within their herds to the maximum sustainable level. This results in a controllable field that strengthens the tissue of other nearby creatures.

entries.zh: 我们对§Y虚空虫§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的繁殖周期变异：§Y$tech_unique_mutation_voidworm$§!\n\n我们已经能够提高这些生物用来轰炸宿主星球的寄生囊肿的繁殖能力。结果是产生的若虫产量增加。
entries.en: Our experimental mutation project on §YVoidworms§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting variations of their reproductive cycles: §Y$tech_unique_mutation_voidworm$§!\n\nWe have been able to increase the fertility of the parasitic cysts these creatures use to bombard their host planets with. The result is an increase in yield of generated nymphs.

entries.zh: 我们对§Y岩居兽§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：§Y$tech_unique_mutation_cutholoid$§!\n\n我们已经找到方法能将其巨大消化系统改造为发射高初速长射程弹药的武器。不幸的是，这一显著的生物学改造会导致它们无法再吞噬敌方舰船了。
entries.en: Our experimental mutation project on §YCutholoids§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: §Y$tech_unique_mutation_cutholoid$§!\n\nWe have found a way to repurpose their massive digestive system to fire high velocity, long-range projectiles. Unfortunately, this significant biological modification will mean they are no longer able to engulf enemy fleets.

entries.zh: 晶态实体变异计划完成
我们关于§Y晶态实体§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：§Y$tech_unique_mutation_crystalline_entity$§!\n\n通过对它们晶体基因的这种修改，每个生物在遭受严重创伤时能够分裂成两个独立的个体。这将极大地提高它们的战斗能力。
entries.en: Our experimental mutation project on §YCrystalline Entities§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: §Y$tech_unique_mutation_crystalline_entity$§!\n\nWith this modification to their crystalline genetics, each creature is capable of splitting into two independent organisms in the event of severe trauma. This should drastically improve their combat capabilities.

entries.zh: 我们已经从[FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName]所在的[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中获得了该生物的遗传物质。\n\n虽然我们目前无法克隆这种生物，但我们仍然可以从其独特的生物学特性中提取宝贵的见解。
entries.en: We have recovered the genetic material of the [FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName] we encountered in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName].\n\nThough we lack the understandings to clone such a creature, we may still be able to extract valuable insight from its unique biology.

entries.zh: 我们使用$NAME_Elderly_Tiyanki$的遗传物质进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：§H$restorative_enzymes$§!\n\n族母遗传物质中存在的修复酶可以在其他生物的类似腺体中复制。这将它们的结构组织转化为再生材料，在爆炸时紧密编队中会非常有用。
entries.en: Our experimental mutation project using $NAME_Elderly_Tiyanki$ genetic material is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: §H$restorative_enzymes$§!\n\nThe restorative enzymes present in the Matriarch's genetic material can be reproduced in similar glands on other creatures. This transforms their structural tissue into regenerative material, which would provide quite useful in tight formations upon explosion.

entries.zh: 虚空孳孽变异计划完成
我们使用$NAME_Voidspawn$基因材料进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的发现：§H$starborne_biology$§!\n\n这些生物的组织对星光反应强烈，可以被鼓励在其他生物体中生长。这需要少量能量来维持，但在最亮的恒星附近，它们的生长速度会大幅提高。
entries.en: Our experimental mutation project using $NAME_Voidspawn$ genetic material is complete, and has yielded an interesting discovery: §H$starborne_biology$§!\n\nThe tissue of these creatures reacts strongly to starlight, and can be encouraged to grow in other organisms. This demands a small amount of energy to maintain, but vastly improves their growth rate near the brightest stars.
§RRemoves the Ability to Engulf smaller ships§!

entries.zh: 神经芯片可以植入太空兽群的神经系统，以影响它们在舰队战斗中的行为。
entries.en: Neurochips can be inserted into Space Fauna nervous systems to influence their behavior in fleet combat.

entries.zh: 人工推进器可以整合到太空生物中，前提是要考虑能量供应和与神经运动中心的连接。
entries.en: Artificial thrusters can be integrated into spaceborne organisms with appropriate considerations for energy supply and connections to neural motor centers.

entries.zh: §H解锁功能：§! 太空兽群推进器升级
entries.en: §HUnlocks Feature:§! Thrusters upgrades for Space Fauna

entries.zh: 穿越超空间航道对星际生命来说可能很危险，但我们能够增强它们的生存能力。
entries.en: Traveling across hyperlanes can be hazardous for spaceborne life, but we are able to enhance their capabilities.

entries.zh: §H解锁功能：§! 太空兽群超空间引擎升级
entries.en: §HUnlocks Feature:§! Hyper Drives upgrades for Space Fauna

entries.zh: 利用我们已开发的技术可以增强太空生物的多样感官器官，而对生物体造成的伤害最小。
entries.en: The diverse sensory organs of spaceborne life can be enhanced by our developed technologies with minimal harm to the organism.

entries.zh: §H解锁供能：§!太空兽群传感器升级
entries.en: §HUnlocks Feature:§! Sensors upgrades for Space Fauna

entries.zh: 我们可以开发专门的神经芯片，来影响参与大规模舰队战斗的太空兽群的行为。
entries.en: We can develop specialized neurochips to influence the behavior of space fauna involved in wide scale fleet combat.

entries.zh: §H解锁功能：§!太空兽群战斗计算机升级
entries.en: §HUnlocks Feature:§! Combat Computers upgrades for Space Fauna

entries.zh: §S首选栖息地：§!$HABITAT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$生物在其首选栖息地中，维护费用降低 50%。
entries.en: §SPreferred Habitat: §!$HABITAT$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$Creatures in their preferred habitat have 50% reduced upkeep.

entries.zh: 太空变形虫是孤独的掠食者，对遇到的任何东西都具有攻击性。它们依靠被称为“鞭毛”的半成形后代，擅长追捕猎物。
entries.en: Space Amoeba are lone predators, aggressive towards anything they encounter. Supported by partially-formed spawn known as "flagella", these creatures are adept at chasing down their prey.

entries.zh: 缇扬奇，也被称为“太空鲸”，通常是温顺的生物，以大气气体为食。这些生物极具协作性，野生群体在严格的等级制度下组织。
entries.en: Tiyanki, also known as "Space Whales", are typically docile creatures that graze on atmospheric gases. These creatures are extremely collaborative and pods in the wild are organized under a strict hierarchy.

entries.zh: 虚空虫是一种寄生生物，为了繁殖，必须将其孢子降落到有适量生物质的居住世界。成熟的个体会形成被称为“三头虫”的形态，并在黑洞附近建造巢穴来庇护和抚养幼虫。
entries.en: Voidworms are parasitic organisms that must deposit spores on inhabited worlds with suitable biomass in order to reproduce. Mature individuals form mating trios, known as "Troikas", and will construct nests near black holes to shelter and raise their young.

entries.zh: 岩居兽是一种居住在小行星内巨型有机体，它们利用外壳来保护柔软的身体。该生物会将猎物整个生吞，用放射性的消化液来慢慢消化。
entries.en: Cutholoids are massive organisms that inhabit asteroids in order to provide suitable protection for their otherwise soft bodies. This creature swallows its prey whole, using radioactive digestive fluid to slowly consume its prey.

entries.zh: 晶态实体是一种独特的硅酸盐生命体，能够在太空中自由移动。每个实体的颜色并非由年龄决定，而是反映了它们潜在的内部电荷。
entries.en: Crystalline Entities are a unique form of silicate-animate beings that can freely propel themselves through space. The hue of each entity varies not due to age, but as a reflection of their latent internal charge.
